review_text: First and only visit to a Nang on a transit back in Oct No complaints overall easy navigation not crowded amenities were up to expectations considering it to be only rd largest airport in Vnam Immigration was surprisingly nice asked me for a CS survey which I was delighted to do Staff was also friendly put me on priority queue to my connecting flight international to domestic Fast and efficient everything was done quickly Would love to fly there again as soon as I get the chance

Manchester to Tripoli Airbus A Plane was a little old and tired looking Only passengers on board and I was the only one in Business Class Seats were OK food was fine The flight took off on time and arrived in Tripoli on time Based on costs and timings this was very good value compared to British Airways

Check in smoothless immigration great lounge perfect When you arrive at the gate here comes the security check All Xray staff do NOT take care of your stuff You fold your jacket you find it in a wreck when you pick it up Put your expensive bag in a tray they take it out and put it directly on the conveyor belt Really this is not acceptable for Singapore I have a stars not for all airport staff but security staff They need to care more

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Thank you to the flight attendants of flight hx today Monday the th I left my phone in my seat on my flight and my phone made it to my next gate very quickly because the staff not only were wonderful but they care enough to not just put my phone in a box I thank you from the bottom of my heart

Mumbai Airport never fails to impress me from the dedicated drop off options or the overall efficiency It is my favourite major airport to travel from I am more impressed with arrival facilities but even departure is as good as it gets Only fundamental issue is its very overcrowded

I have never expected that a smallscale airport can be able to provide outstanding and extensive services to travellers The airport was very clean and tidy and everything in the terminal was well organised Incredibly large number of facilities including an observation public bath A wide choice of restaurants was available and the prices were reasonable The sky deck was very large and great for phototaking Airport signs were very clear and staff were always eager to help travellers Convenient access to the city centre The airport gave us a great impression upon our first visit to Nagoya

PKZ Airport is a small regional airport that is served mainly by Lao Airlines It has an international connection to Bangkok but mainly to other airports in Laos Small single floor airport with Departures at one end and Arrivals at the other end There is a CafeViewing place upstairs which provides very good views of the runway and apron where you can watch the few planes come and go In the main part of the airport is a Money Change booth and a couple of souvenir shops selling gifts books postcards etc and a Lao Airlines Office and the Airport SecurityInformation The Checkin Counters are in a room off the main Departure Entrance which has some seating just by the Passport ControlSecurity which lead into the Departure Lounge which has a very small but stocked ShopDuty Free No alcohol or cigarettes on sale which has some last minute souvenir opportunities There are also toilets in both Departure and arrivals areas and the main part of the airport Processing times very quick as flights are typically ATR sized less than people at a time The airport is very user friendly and things work well

Small quiet regional airport with small turboprop aircraft from a single airline There is no separate security screening staff have always been exceptionally helpfull Late arrivals for departures are handled efficiently The cafe is an offshoot of a nice respected cafe in the city serving exceptional coffee There is little point trying to fly from the bigger airports of Ballina or the Gold Coast The planes might be bigger there but flight times to Sydney are the virtually the same you are less comfortable waiting in those bigger airports Mother nature is the only downside with early morning fog causing some concerns but has never really affected me when I have wanted to travel

My flight was to Milan from Toronto and return Checkin was fast the crew were polite and efficient on the ground and in flight For the most part both of my flights were on time just on the way back there was a delay of hours but Expedia had informed me through email days prior of my flight I was pleasantly surprised regarding the meals served on board to and from Italy not only you can choose from a menu but the food was delicious Also I found that choosing the option to pay for checked baggage on Air Italy site was much cheaper than paying at the airport I paid in Canadian dollars instead of euros I usually fly with Air Canada but Air Italy was much cheaper in comparison The only thing that I would appreciate is that when choosing the option to pay for my checked bag online that it would indicate checked baggage included at time of booking The flight was smooth and very pleasant I will definitely fly with Air Italy again in the near future
This airport has beautiful views of the tarmac and a nice and comfortable lounge with easy check in and very friendly staff The food is amazing with an amazing variety of restaurants

I came from Bangkok to Doha and transited for hrs and then to my homeland Cairo I was frustrated to stay that long transit time but once i stayed there I enjoyed it so much The internet coverage and speed is awesome Perfect atmosphere perfect cleaning perfect toilets Unforgettable experience Thanks to each and everyone who participated at this huge well maintained entity

This is my second trip using this Airport This is a far superior experience when compared to the main international airport KLIA especially at the immigration Department The staff are friendly and helpful It took us less than minutes to clear immigration and custom The airport is clean and free wifi is provided I would highly recommend this airport if you are travelling within Malaysia or South East Asia

Beijing to Pyongyang Comparing an intraEuropean flight of hours and this flight practically no differences clean aircraft nice stewardesses punctual simple food good and attentive service a normal standard

This was my first flight with Jazz and all in all I was quite pleased The flight to Montreal was short and agreeable The crew spoked both French and English which makes a plus for the flight To my surprise the economy seats were equipped with personal IFE with the whole Air Canada inflight program Food consisted of a cookie and a drink which is more than enough for a one hour flight The only downside of the flight was the delay created by bad luck The aircraft was already late already and during taxi when we were about to align on the runway the tower decided to change of runway making us hour late On our arrival at Trudeau the crew make sure that the passengers going on another flight about to depart left the aircraft first

Toronto to Paris via Reykjavik with WOW air The plane was smaller than any trans Atlantic flight that I had flown in the past but the boarding process was so smooth Although food is available for sale the crew were very friendly

Travelled last month from Subang to Penang Flight was great Flight attendants were friendly and welcoming No in flight entertainment but there were magazines Only serve Peanuts fresh baked bread a mineral water and a wet towel for each passenger Baggage allowance was also ok as the limit was Kg Price was also cheap as I only paid RM for a one way flight One my return flight to Subang there were only passengers and the flight still continued even thought not even of the plane was full I would recommend the Airline to people who want to travel in Malaysia

The airport itself is small and easily accessible The downside is the airport security staff The staff who greeted us first were pleasant and friendly but the ones conducting inspections and overseeing direct searches of people and luggage are gruff at best and grumpy at worst I think they need some training on how to be polite and respectful to passengers This isnt the first time that we experienced this kind of behaviour on the security line The washrooms are limited and in need of cleaning and an upgrade They could also use at least one area for passengers with pets so the animals can relieve themselves as seen in many other airports
Clean efficient airport small but with nice stores A variety of airlines and it is never busy
Chiang Mai to Yangon return and pleasantly surprised by the standard fairly new aircraft and meal service for minute flight Flight attendants were somewhat offhand Reasonable leg room in economy

Entire flight was smooth however boarding time was a little confusing and the assigned gate they suddenly changed it so it caused more confusion I ordered prebook meal it tasted good but the food itself was somehow cold For me airlines baggage policy was highly favorable as I was able to check in kilos regardless of number of luggage

It was a good easy flight on a nice modern clean plane The meal was satisfactory a couple of hot dishes as well as salad dessert and bread served along with wine or beer The IFE was decent a good screen and reasonable selection of movies and TV series The service was friendly but nothing outstanding My only gripe is the lack of communication from the cockpit for some reason they didnt switch off the seatbelt sign for nearly hours Whilst it was a bit bumpy it wasnt excessive so I wish they had communicated why this was the case Otherwise it led me to believe that we were constantly expecting something worse

Ohrid St Paul international airport was in terms of size like a trip with the time machine The aircraft is parking literally in front of the Arrivals door where passengers are directed to the Passports control There were only desks working out of which for an airport with flights daily can be considered a good performance Nevertheless despite the size the airport is well organized and clean showing the travelers how flying was at the past times when holding an airline ticket was considered a luxury As an improvement for the administration I think that a shuttle bus from airport to the city roughly km Distance would be to consider synchronized with the flying schedule

I have been to many many airports all over the world and Little Rock is one of my favorites It is small but modern and clean There are never long lines and the personnel are always helpful and friendly After being away from home for months I always look forward to the simplicity and comfort of LR airport I like that baggage claim is after you meet up with the people waiting to get you as well
Very convenient airport as it is not very large Signs are clear getting to and from the airport is easy too Shops are available post office included The terminal is clean

Experienced CMN last month arrival from Paris Orly with RAM and continuing to Muscat with Oman Air Had to retreive my luggage pass immigration and recheckin again All was very smooth and from the time the plane landed I was outside less than min later very impressive Agents were all polite and efficient The secret is like everywhere else Be patient respectful and polite and everything will be fine Will not hesitate to use this Airport again

Decided to fly direct from Brisbane to Dunedin rather than via Christchurch then driving I had previously flown into Dunedin over years ago and the differences were huge from then until now It is a small airport for a small city so it is compact but effectively laid out International flights arrive at an annex that is connected to the main terminal building by a corridor There are no Smartgates at immigration but it only receives a single international flight at a time it was also good that all three counters were manned for quick processing To get to the rental car office you have to leave the terminal turn left and reenter the annex building which was quite a cold walk on a late night flight For the return trip it was a very busy morning with several domestic flights departing near the same time as my international flight thus international passengers were held in the main terminal area until those domestic flights were processed before being allowed through for screening However there is only a couple of vending machines at the international gates with a small duty free so it is better to not rush through

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

BirminghamShuttlesworth Airport is absolutely exceptional across the board Modern well laid out and astonishingly clean Good facilities throughout Parking easy and close to the terminal The modernization of all the facilities done smoothly I live miles away close to another commercial airport but gladly drive the three hour round trip to fly from BHM as I will in April
Brilliant little airport with thoughtful touches such as free snacks and water Only downside was the open air departure lounges so no air conditioning ie humidity very high

Since my last review Karlsruhe airport has improved beyond expectations Regular flights to more destinations and vastly improved bus services to Baden and Rastatt Eating and shopping facilities need to be improved especially on Sundays when the duty free shop and gate one bar are generally closed

Karachi to Gwadar Travelled with this airline after I had travelled on a short a domestic flight early September Flight in general was smooth and scenic Ground staff were also pleasant and helpful I see some betterment in overall operations particularly in terms of punctuality

My recent experience of flying through Tuscon reminded me that in the contemporary climate flying through smaller American airports is generally a lot more pleasant than megaairports A case in point was the security screening I have some metal in my leg that occasionally triggers the metal detector and it happened while going through security at Tuscon The TSA person that dealt with me went through the standard procedure for dealing with this sort of thing this wasnt the first time for me but they also managed to be human about it in stark contrast to what Ive encountered at some other airports where the TSA person I was dealing with might as well have been a robot I would agree that the dining options at Tuscon arent the greatest but I was still able to get something satisfying to eat We even had some entertainment courtesy of the Arizona Air National Guard also at Tuscon airport who were doing training flights in their Fs and treated us to an impromptu airshow There is much to be said for flying through smaller airports In general the experience is faster and less stressful than their larger equivalents

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station
I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time The staff were friendly and helpful Only water coffee and tea were complimentary which is no issue on such a short flight

On the whole SSA is everything youd expect a mediumsized airport to be Its spacious well signposted and safe Checkin is usually fast except for charter flights to Europe security is fast and friendly domestic arrival also fast and efficient The one major problem at SSA are the long queues at customs in the afternoon when several international flights arrive pretty much at the same time If you dont carry a Brazilian passport expect to stand in line for over an hour There are just enough shops and food amenities SSA is still thankfully first and foremost an airport not a shopping mall If you are taking a bus from the city centre to the airport or vice versa be aware that traffic in Salvador is horrendous and the journey at peak times will take at least two hours

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

Very clean and big airport Nice facilities Good open space Lots of shops and restaurants and fast food services including MDS and KFC All of it was pretty much airside The queue in Security wasnt that bad Nice airport and a lot of air conditioning

Decided to fly this route to mainland China instead of my usual HKG Flew from TSAKNH return on what seemed to be a new Embraer E This airline is the domestic offshoot for China Airlines and the English language version of their website is a simple cut and paste from the international airline However the baggage allowance for domestic Taiwanese flights is only KG so I had to really point out that the English information states KG and after some trouble I was able to fly without having to pay extra Despite that the actual flight to and from Kinmen was quick comfortable and care free Only a snack and water was served on the flight but it was only minutes long so it was not an issue I was pleased to have been given the Emergency Exit row on both flights too handy being the taller westerner that I am Except for the baggage allowance issue I can not find fault with them

What a fantastic little airport after leaving Paris CDG behind and all its filth it was such a welcome sight to arrive in a clean modern organized airport What a shame that more airlines dont fly into Pau The staff in the airport were also extremely helpful and polite Much nicer airport than Toulouse which is not far away

Arrival at this airport was simple with its connection to the Hanover SBahn suburban train system Hanover airport is a convenient size not an overwhelming number of gates but large enough to have plenty of connections Checkin today with Swiss Airlines went smoothly we were asked for our destination visa but not grilled and luggage was processed without difficulty Security checking was slow today probably because of Middle East tensions but security personnel were good humoured and friendly Cafes and shops on the land side closed before pm there are limited shopping possibilities on the air side but one good cafe
I really love this airport It is small and very quick Regular security is quicker than TSA Pre The Airport has nice entertainment and its a nice regional airport

Dhaka to Singapore Good food good seating and comparatively better ground services at Dhaka Staff on board are just okay though My travel ticket price was high though Worst inflight entertainment service

DUD is a small but efficient airport with everything you need Landed from Wellington bags out very quickly The airport is quite far from city centre mins cost nearly dollars by Taxi and dollars by super shuttle Departure is well organised checkin sufficient airline lounge is located upstairs security check right before you board

BUR is a no frills no wow no stress airport and those are the best things about it Easy to park with valet getting through security is usually a breeze and there is little fog to cause delays Theres a Peets coffee and the cafe is overpriced but decent Do you really expect fine dining on what is primarily a short haul airport basically an SWA airport Other than the charming s air about the place you get on and off the planes old school style with stairs and with SWA can enter through the front of back of the plane the latter to avoid the slow pokes SWA boarding lines are well organized If I were to complain the rest rooms are smallish and Terminal B for United is too small Seating can be somewhat tight close to boarding time Baggage claim is usually reasonably fast but there are only two carousels so dont dawdle If you are going to the westside or even downtown youre in for a long cab ride but most travelers live in one of the nearby valleys and if youre a tourist its close to Universal Studios Theres a train within walking distance that will take you downtown or to Ventura County during limited times Overall a very good travel experience because it is easy and stress free

I would like to share my positive experience with Egypt Air as this Airline have really exceeded my expectations Friendly and professional cabin crew with delicious catering Highly recommended and for sure will fly Egypt Air again

This is a comparatively new airport in Tunisia and I have nothing but praise for it It is clean smart and well organised Check in and Security were quick and once through to airside a really good duty free shop and a bar Great views from the glass fronted terminal although the view of some aircraft can be obscured by the piers Everything ran smoothly and just a pleasure to travel through this airport

I am pleased to commend Mdm Novia for her exceptional professionalism during our recent flight cancellation on November After our Citilink flight from Pontianak to Jakarta was canceled Novia managed all the necessary arrangements for our next flight with outstanding efficiency and kindness Her assistance made a challenging situation much easier and we are very grateful for her dedication and hospitality She truly goes above and beyond in her service

Traveled to Manaus many times found the airport good with easy access to car park Staff nice security not too long a queue shops etc are standard airport stuff Would recommend early arrival and double check all documentation you need to travel Stop to look at the turtles outside the terminal in their own pond

Needs a proper restaurant Toilets are not up to the hygiene standard and are very congested I am muslim and offer regular prayers but call is very loud need to maintain at comfortable listening Needs further variety of fast food international chains to have a quick meal

This is a very small airport on an island You have to get a ferry and a bus to reach it both free of charge It is in a lovely setting surrounded by trees The facilities are very limited with only one very small cafe no shops but that is all part of the charm

KigaliParis th Dec on one of their A aircrafts Checked in online smooth but is unnecessary and does neither add value nor gain time I chose an entire seatrow for free due to my Gold Status with Rwandairs Dream Miles Program Marburg declarations forms have to be filled prior to enter the airport Checkin slow minutes per pax but they managed to checkin luggage onwards with other airline Dream lounge in Kigali is a pleasure with panorama windows over town Catering options varied a bit sparse the best hot snacks appear not to reach the lounge easily only on firm request I suspect that they are consumed by lounge staff have seen indications hereof Wines are subpar No sparkling wine offered Flight on time full on time Seafood meal preordered and given Generous catering They gave me on early request an entire row onboard for better sleep Blankets earset and pillows given Very affordable ticket USD tr purchased months before departure Extremely good value for money Miles given

I specifically chose to fly with TransNusa to try out flying on the COMAC ARJ of which the carrier currently operates two of these aircraft at the moment and is also the first airline in the world outside of China to operate this small commercial jetliner Thankfully there wasnt much of a negative experience everything from checkin to boarding to the inflight experience was prompt and precise even if it werent spectacular As TransNusa opts for a singleclass layout the aircraft has a capacity of passengers seated in rows of The smaller capacity of the aircraft meant that boarding and disembarkation was completed fairly quickly and smoothly Arguably the only sore point of the flight was having to use a bus to board the aircraft instead of using an aerobridge TransNusa includes kg of checked bags as part of the basic air ticket so thats a nice gesture to have Despite having to land in heavy rain at KLIA the entire journey was uneventful and decently pleasant and it suggests that the COMAC ARJ will prove a contender in the regional small commercial jetliner market in the years to come

Manila to Legazpi DRP on Christmas Day Flight was full but went smooth Checkin was a breeze Mabuhay Lounge food was OK though I was hoping for some extra flare on this special day Wasnt a problem though Flight took off slightly ahead of schedule Bags first to arrive at DRP due to Elite status Ticket price was reasonable for this season

Flew Stockholm to Tehran with Iran Air I had good flight with the new fleet of this airline minute delay but the cabin was new and clean with good seat distance and very tasty food Iranian film and music and route information was provided I recommend flying with Iran Air on international routes because of the nice cabin and good meals for the value of money

Check in in Bangkok swift and friendly lounges and boarding in Bangkok and Hong Kong always top notch Service and catering on both flights good What annoys me with flying economy on CX is their unwillingness to credit any Avios in non CX One World programs I was willing to pay a higher fare to get my points but there isnt any which credits points in Economy That is the reason to make me think twice to fly Cathay again in Y in the future

Quick flight with good service and friendly staff Checkin was efficient Aircraft was clean and welcoming Only negative was the arrival at a station where bussing brought us back to the terminal rather than an airbridge

Baku to Kiev with Buta Airways I have to say after travelling for years this was definitely the best Low Cost Carrier I have ever flown with On time and sharp Plus you get free water and a free sandwich But saying that for a ml beer is and a pizza Incredible value you money I had flown them for a min flight so was interested to see what a hour flight would be like But it was absolutely perfect

Another really good experience First leg Madeira to Ponta Delgada flight on a Q turboprop Flight left early and arrived early Polite check in staff in Madeira checked both our carry on and checked luggage all the way to Toronto OK snack and non alcoholic beverage service on a hour flight Second leg Ponta Delgada to Toronto on an Airbus On time departure and arrival Good unique Portuguese meal pasta with tuna bacon and chorizo two passes of the beverage cart Both flights had courteous and professional cabin crew for planes that were full lots of announcements from the flight deck about possible turbulence A better entertainment system would have been welcome for the second hour flight
The folks at Delta and Sky West were great They took great care of daughter and her room mate on their way home for spring break They made a special trip to get our bags at the Elko Airport
Newquay airport is excellent apart from the abysmal state of seating in the main departure lounge Seating all torn and very scruffy It has been like this for a long time Unacceptable

Berlin to Dusseldorf Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings This A was a different configuration then the first flight Legroom was less and was just enough for me m crew were smiling and good The flight delayed by minutes

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

After standing at passport control for over hour It was our turn Seconds earlier a couple appeared in another queue next to ours My partner who speaks the language perfectly pointed out that there was a queue Also someone else in the queue pointed it out as well The passport officer told us to go back over the red line And told this couple to come forward Not military not late for the same flight as us Cant believe that someone should get preferential treatment at passport control

This is the first time in over a year I used this airport and I have to say that I am not disappointed Its facilities are fair very clean pleasant to stroll through and spacious The staff is pleasant and professional

There in December Jan and Mar times very quick handling of luggage etc comfortable waiting area and free internet No queues for Immigration desk One point that is minor if you dont know where the bus to Rotterdam centre is located you may have a problem however I took a taxi and then it takes only minutes Its much more agreeable than the big airports like Toulouse Orly JFK or even Schiphol also in the Netherlands

Travelled late Marchearly April Completely empty extremely clean overlooking the runway walking distance from town checkin queue was non existent for me travelling to London Car hire is fine quality food available but all very cosy and empty of huge hordes of people The best airport Ive been too

Astana is a small international airport that is well connected to Europe via Frankfurt London Paris and Amsterdam through Kazakhstans Air Astana The airport has only one terminal for Domestic and International flights A new terminal is being constructed next to the existing facility which is planned to be opening in spring The arrivals and baggage reclaim is small Immigration quite smooth and officers were friendly but remember to fill in your immigration card with a blue or black pen not with a red one as it is not accepted I had almost no queues Taxi pickup at the terminal is not wellorganised and taxi recruiters can be annoying The central hall for departures is quite spacious and there is sufficient seating around the checkin area Checkin areas are small and somewhat oldfashioned but work fine Friendly ground staff Short queuing time at checkin passport control and security Emigration passport control is fine There are few FB and retail facilities at the international departure gates There is plenty of seating at the end of the concourse close to the small cafe in the back Transferring between international flights is quick and easy Passengers do not have to pass immigration only security screening It took me only minutes from arrival gate to departure gate FB and retail facilities are limited especially in the departure are after immigration Food choice is limited Very good wifi while waiting for checkin or for your flight Password can be obtained via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean Remote arrivals and departures via bus in winter when temperatures can go below Celsius can be cold and slippery but also a very interesting experience When the new terminal will be opened in I assume less aircraft will be handled via busses

It was five and half hours flight They served only one breakfast After that they didnt offer anything unless we asked for a snack or drinks They should have offered another light meal two hours after breakfast Otherwise everything is perfect

Checked in amazing helpful staff her name was Nikki at London Heathrow Airport she was friendly and amazing service also told me my flight was delayed which I did not know and made sure everything was okay Highly recommend

I read a huge amount of negativity about this airport prior to my trip there it was a five hour transit stop going from London to Bangkok I was certainly concerned reading all the previous reviews However I didnt experience any real issues The airport is very large so easy to find a quiet spot there are plenty of power outlets and getting online is extremely simple you just log on and take a pic of your passport Granted you wont be able to do very much online unless youve got one of the VPNs that work behind the great China firewall but if you have an iPad with a couple of movies downloaded the time will soon pass There was a reasonable amount of shops open both for coffee and souvenir shopping The train that youll need to take to get to your gate is frequent clean and fast Overall Ive been to more interesting airports but my message would be dont stress out reading the negative reviews I had no issues whatsoever

This was an unexpected surprise due to my family thinking that we were going to fly Ryanair however in my opinion it was a pleasant surprise I have a really bad fear of flying so an incredibly nice cabin crew member sat next to me and told me that she loved flying and how long she had done it for and how safe it was She also said that she really enjoyed flying and the turbulence was enjoyable The seats were nice and the crew was amazing I didnt get any food but I loved this low cost airline

What great TSA staff have at St PeteClearwater Airport The lines moved smoothly and additional lines were opened when it became crowded The food court consists of one small shop where the food is OK Looking forward to going through this airport again on Sunday

Chongqing Airport is one of the biggest in Southwest China The new terminal is just km away from the old terminal and is well connected by metro line The airport terminal is very spacious and well designed that incorporates with many new technologies Mine was a direct flight by Hainan Airline to JFK The departure area has all sort of restaurants and shops which makes the last minute shopping possible Facilities are very clean and well put My only concern is the long waiting time at the border control

Recife Airport is definitely the best airport I have been through in Brazil The scenery coming in to land is impressive The architecture of the building is very modern and excellent use is made of natural lighting There is an excellent observation deck on the second floor with a good selection of restaurants and shopping outlets The first floor is departures and the ground floor is arrivals Selection is good landside and even airside there are enough options for an early flight including a hour coffee shop Security is extremely tough Be prepared to take off belt shoes wallet etc Checkin machines strategically placed and few queues although my departing flight was at am maybe the situation is different during the day I arrived at lunch time though and no problems either Excellent connections into Boa Viagem and downtown via bus Aeroporto Opcional passes in front of airport very frequent daytime only Taxis are also readily available a trip to Boa Viagem Beach shall be about R which is about USD The airport deserves more international traffic as Recife is a major tourist hub Current flights only to Frankfurt Condor Panama City Copa and Lisbon TAP A tip if you are flying out of Recife be sure to take some bolo de rolo with you Its a local delicacy a kind of guava cake
Always on time Professional cabin crew Perfect weather and an overall pleasant flight Thank you FlySafair

Guayaquil Airport is modern and clean but if you arrive on a domestic flight there is no transit You need to go out and do checkin and security Arrivals can be crowded and staff are not that friendly The one smile that I got was from the girl selling chocolates at the store inside

During the monthlong trip around Mongolia we flew MIAT three times twice on domestic routes UBNMoron UlgiiUBN and then the exit flight to Narita Japan On domestic flights we flew the CRJ jets small but quite comfy with basic but professional services good on time performances and speedy luggage delivery The exit flight to Narita was also on time crew was very professional and attentive food was ok and the only thing missing on the almost hr flight was the entertainment which was not working on our phones Overall we were quite happy with MIAT
What a delightful surprise The best service good food excellent entertainment Very spacious seating Very good price for the ticket Its my new favourite airline I will seek it out in future for sure

I arrived in Nur Sultan Airport from Novosibirsk Russia and left to go to Almaty The Immigration control was quite fast and no problems in getting a day Visa on arrival The airport is relatively new and modern Security was efficient and effective I had a couple of hours between flights and wanted to recharge phone and computer There was plenty of seating but there were very few places and none adjacent to a seat where I could charge my computer I watched it from about metres away The airport has all the things that interest some people money exchange tourist souvenirs etc I seldom shop in airports

Used this airport multiple times for international and domestic arrivals and departures Nice and clean Airport staff are friendly Provides jet bridge at almost every flight In my opinion it needs more coffee shops eateries and lounges Parking spot is located conveniently close to the airport entrance

Shinchitose airport is really effective A lot of souvenir shops and wonderful musiam in the airport A brand new international terminal will be open in Great hotels and various amusement things are worth of expecting
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

Great experience at arrival Very friendly staff welcoming all the way Quick check of Thailand Pass with no waiting time as smooth through immigration The bags already on belt when we came to arrival hall

Very cramped space for legs I am and you cant get enough space for legs so I put my right leg in corridor Arm support cant be lowered and not just on my seat I was flying with Delta Qatar and Turkish intercontinental but this plane was just overloaded with seats Entertainment choice ok Food was ok but also much better on other companies wine also ok Ladies and men cabin crew were great Funny and polite very useful must say one of the best Ive met

It is absolutely unfair to give only one star to this airline the Tupolev plane is in good condition and perfectly clean the crew are efficient pleasant and helpful and last but not least it is always on time you can find many airlines much worse than that for instance Air China on the same route The route flown is the no route of Air Koryo linking DPRK to Beijing and this entitles you to some patriotic videos on the overhead screen The buns served are not too bad and drinks are acceptable for such a small trip All in all a good experience

Passenger assistance is the best we have experienced very polite helpful and well organised thank you very much airport clean good to see it as drinking water fountain also impressed free bottles of water on arrival on inbound flight

PBHCCU CCUPBH Y class Check in staff at Paro very helpful friendly smiling Cabin crew similarly accommodating and friendly Clean cabin decent space for Y class Light refreshments and sandwiches veg or nonveg served on this short minute segment Every flight has been spot on time or slightly early Good announcements from cockpit to point out Himalayan peaks when near Paro Competitive prices A good alternative inout of Bhutan from Drukair

I flew from Blantyre airport a number of years ago and was struck by just how quaint the whole set up was It is a very basic airport not far off the common tin shack analogy that comes with most African airports There is very little to do and there is just a bar to distract you The best thing about Blantyre airport is the Duty Free shop A selection so limited it is almost refreshing Malawi Gin Whisky JW Cane spirit macadamia nuts coffee and nick nacks I bought to W light bulbs that had been turned into paraffin lamps Wonderful

Although a low cost airline Shaheen Air was quite nice although the airport checkin was pretty bad with only one line and the agents taking forever The flight had a gate change times and we had a one hour delay announced at the last minute before boarding was to finish The flight attendents were very friendly during the flight and the aircraft was decent also the meal some chicken mayo bun with a chicken leg along with marble cake was pretty delicious and filling The plane was leased and originally from SpanAir so the cabin had grey leather seats but it was comfortable though Also a nice touch from Shaheen Air was the pretakeoff water which was provided and newspapers in English and Urdu

Flying from Saint Petersburg to Prague Rossiya is providing an excellent service punctuality in time Professional cabin crew working so hard they accept Aeroflot points highly recommended I believe the company should be at least categorized as a Star airline

What a lovely little airport the whole experience seemed organised with little to no queuing areas as passengers seemed to just self manage to the different areas of the airport From check in to departure the airport was very clean with little wrong on this front I found myself very impressed with the smiling security team as I went through pre security and main search area as well Arrivals was good as well with clean arrivals area straight from the plane I was really impressed with this airport when comparing to some of the UK airports it has a much higher standard Wifi runs on a free voucher system which worked a treat very easy with no need to sign up Shopping is not great as there is just a duty free shop and FB is limited and expensive Overall a very good airport

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism
Beautiful new terminal with excellent check in security and facilities very impressed

Tbilisi to Baku Everything went smoothly here Boarding was quick and on time We were pushed back on time which also meant the flight left on time It was only a short hop of mins I will see how they are again when I fly hours plus on my next flight Overall No issues Airline very smooth and would recommend

I dont know what all the fuss was about Bad reviews about security dirty airport unfriendly staff no seating I experienced none of that In view of the negative reviews we arrived hours before take off and were through security in five minutes Very cheerful efficient and friendly staff Bought some items at duty free and the lady there was extremely pleasant and helpful Plenty of seating Good food and drink offers and both the airport and toilets were very clean Boarding process straightforward and stressless On return our plane landed about minutes behind schedule This unfortunately coincided with other flights landing at the same time so passport control was very busy but it only took about minutes to get through The staff there were smiling at I understand why passengers complain but its also useful to get positive reviews sometimes I hope my next experience of Leeds Bradford will be as good as this one

Modern airport departure and arrival were quick efficient and smooth This not a big nor busy airport so there is never any big queues Immigration police cordial and friendly Almost feels like there is too much airport staff for volume of passengers particularly when departing staff in the multiple cafs looked bored I appreciated the clean toilets and multiple drinking water fountains where you could fill up water for free Duty Free felt was the biggest letdown very generic and poor Not much local Dhofari or even Omani products I think it could be better used to sell the country and region one final time before visitors leave instead of overpriced cheap souvenir tat or the usual generic Toblerone you can find at any airport in the world Even local products like the luxury Amouage perfumes were at the usual price with no deals which was a shame

Beautiful state of the art equipment but some poor organisation despite lots of friendly staff Nobody tells you the procedure join this queue then shuffle along only to be told you should have gone to the luggage weighin queue first Weigh luggage then rejoin back of check in queue Told to go to security shuffle along for a bit then someone asks for departure card Leave security queue go to desk where you collect and fill departure card then rejoin back of security queue Suggest check in desk staff give you a departure card so you will know to fill it in before going through security Takes a while to shuffle through that and go through immigration departure check then security check All took about one and a half hours At gate we were divided into groups Not enough seats for group although most passengers are in this group Infrastructure is very impressive and no doubt they will eventually streamline procedures Sign posting would be a good start Shopping and dining facilities are mostly not yet open so I cannot comment on this aspect yet So first taste of new terminal not half bad Clean spacious excellent kit friendly staff but poor procedures
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

Ms Terri V who was the boarding agent for my flight provided phenomenal customer service when it was needed most When I realized that my lay over time from my connecting flight to my final destination was tight she was able to move me up four rows with no extra charge She was friendly patient and wanted to do what was right for the customer given my situation when many others may have not cared as much She is someone other boarding and TSA agents should emulate not just here in San Antonio but around other airports as well

Even though it is small this is one of my favourite airports Its a minute walk from the plane to the terminal baggage is normally on the belt as soon as you arrive in and the best part is the cafe not only is it cheap but they have excellent hot bacon rolls and the fresh cakes are excellent too If only public transport links were better though I have been told the National Express service to London will soon call at Kent International

A very big shout out to Jude and Liz at the checkin service desk as well as Tup the client manager on the flight I happened to leave a bag containing a priceless religious item at the checkin desk as we were running late for the flight And in my haste I left the bag at the desk I totally forgot about it and would have been extremely devastated and upset if I realised I left it behind Once we boarded the plane and settled in a very kind Tup and other staff member came up to us and returned the bag to us I can only guess that Liz and Jude realised I was a religious Jew and made the effort to return the bag to us on the plane before it took off My wife and I were so touched by this extremely kind gesture We spoke to Tup during the flight and expressed our gratitude but I wanted to leave this note of thanks to Jude and Liz too We always try and fly Rex your staff are friendly and happy so different to the other airlines we have flown on domestically And this incident just reinforces the good vibes we get when flying Rex

Tanahmerah to Korowai Batu This route is a governmentsubsidized one operated with tiny aircraft carrying only about a dozen passengers No advance booking possible but Dimonim staff were helpful in getting us on a flight the same day Departure time was uncertain but we eventually got on the plane Once aboard it was a great flight offering sweeping views of the rivers and rain forests below Cheap too

A very pleasant airport Modern spacious very quiet the building has good acoustics to dampen internal and external noise Tasty food free drinking water you need to bring your own bottle Also interesting in the general area of the terminal you can spend time in the Flyport an interesting educational area about aerospace Efficient service smiling and helpful staff All in all highly recommended

A very small airport but well run It has stands which are all a few steps from the terminal building It is no where near Oslo miles south approx hours away The terminal building is a single storey with Checkin Desks on one side arrivals in the middle with belt and Security Scanning on the other side On the Land Side there is a cafshop supplying hot and cold snacks and other things and a seating area It is very small so everything is within easy reach but if more than plane is in at a time it could get busy Outside there is lots of car parking and car rental options along with transport to the local railway station for trains to various points including Oslo If you are visiting Oslo City Centre think carefully before using this airport if you want to access the locality it is a small friendly place

Albrook Panama City to Bocas del Toro After reading comments about this airline I was a bit worried but our flight with Air Panama was really okay Checkin at the airport was quick there were no lines My bag was kg so I had to pay dollars for the kg overweight Totally fine There are no infoscreens at the small airport of Albrook but as there are only leaving a couple of flights a day its obvious when boarding starts The flight left at so right on time The fokker used for this flight is old but seatpitch was okay for this minute flight to Bocas After a loud and bumpy take off the crew handed out some crisps and a soda After minutes of cruising with some wonderful views at the rainforest and Caribbean beaches the pilot started decent into Bocas airport After a soft landing and a short taxi to the small apron our luggage appeared within minutes We really enjoyed this flight in this old air Panama fokkerairplane

I fly weekly for business and flew in and out of GreenvilleSpartanburg for the last quarter of and a bit of Its a small airport with only one runway and one long concourse with arbitrary A and B separation The major airlines serve GSP but flights are limited I mostly flew on American which only seems to connect via Charlotte an mile flight First being so close to a major hub like CLT caused almost weekly delays as my flight was often held on the tarmac by CLT airtraffic control so we could fit into the traffic pattern I never actually missed my connections in Charlotte but did have several walkjogs across the airport to reach my gate while the final groups were boarding But GSP itself is nicely maintained with superfriendly staff They offered TSA PreCheck when I flew in and out I got to know the Avis rentalcar staff by name and theyd give me free upgrades Best of all if you use GSP you have to order a tuna melt from the snack counter on the lower level outside security They mix the tuna salad from scratch in front of you and make the besttasting tuna melt Ive ever eaten

This is the first time in over a year I used this airport and I have to say that I am not disappointed Its facilities are fair very clean pleasant to stroll through and spacious The staff is pleasant and professional

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze

Short hop from Nice to Calvi Hardly any people onboard Crew were not particularly friendly or welcoming but we were served a cookie and soft drinks Landed smoothy although slightly delayed due to a missed approach However tickets were cheap and luggage included All in all a decent experience

Moroni to Moheli Turned out to be a pretty decent airline Online booking worked well checkin and boarding was fine and the plane looked well maintained Its a very short flight just minutes or so so i didnt expect much but they still managed to hand our a bottle of water and some biscuits which i though was very nice Both flights on time

The airport is a charming little place up on the Sunshine Coast There are only about flights a day going to Sydney and Melbourne It has recently been upgraded and expanded the gate area is much bigger and has food outlets and toilets It opens up on to the runway and provides nice views Its an easy airport to handle as it isnt too big to get lost in but isnt so small so as to feel cramped The butterfly sanctuary between checkin and security which must be walked through as it is on the pathway is a lovely touch and provides a unique atmosphere The ground staff are very friendly If heading up to the Sunshine Coast it is often cheaper and quicker to fly direct rather than to Brisbane and by far it is an easier airport to use

We flew from Dubrovnik to Athens and then Athens to Zagreb on Croatia Airlines They were on time within minutes for both flights You drop your bag on the tarmac and they load it into the belly of the plane And then you pick it up directly from the tarmac after the flight so there is very little chance for lost luggage which I like They allow a smaller carryone bag as well They did not weigh our bag or try to charge us for anything extra We were allowed to pick our seats for no charge The seats are standard and comparable to Southwest airlines for leg room and space We were served water and drinks on both flights For the price we paid it was a great deal Some people might be nervous about flying a propeller plane but it was a very smooth flight in both directions with almost zero turbulence and a very smooth landing If you had to fault them for one thing it would be nice to have some in flight entertainment Other than that it was a perfect flight Definitely recommend

Ground service is terrible compared to in the air Manual checkin process with no computers This airline seems to be the only one to have a lounge in the domestic terminal in Yangon Airconditioned and friendly associates offering a cheese croissant No bathroom inside so that was a drag People in Lotus class got a private van to the plane which was nice compared to cramming onto a bus Onboard the flight was pretty good The front of the plane is much quieter compared to the back Their inflight magazine was pretty decent and the english grammatically correct Even on short flights they gave you food On my YGNMDY flight which was about minutes they served a full breakfast Seats were pretty comfortable on par with United A first class seats I dont really see the need for inflight entertainment on such short flights
A decidedly mediocre airport Winnipeg and Quebec City are similar in size but are far advanced in terms of services on offer design and overall experience What happened in Halifax Depressing and sad

BMAMMX one way The flight was comfortable with professional and friendly staff The free food and drinks served onboard were top quality The central location of Stockholm Bromma was very advantageous for our city break but checkin and boarding was a hassle Checkin closes minutes before departure which means that half the passengers were cramming at the check in desks in the last minute Free seating onboard the plane resulted in more cramming after the security because everyone wants a good seat It was a real circus In my opinion min checkin deadline instead of min and allocated seats instead of free seats would have been optimal

Departed from Bangalore to London on BA from the new T in Bangalore Terminal is clean fresh and very green There is a green wall and several waterfalls Not what I had been expecting in India Both security and immigration very efficient and egates used to enter the airport Admittedly it was am when I entered the airport and therefore very quiet Not all the concessions airside are open yet but many are Choice of several places to eat and a decent duty free area Most pleasantly surprised

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

The cabin was too warm which made this short flight rather uncomfortable also it was a rather turbulent one They served a good sandwich with complimentary drinks which in my opinion is a very nice gesture Legroom was premium as were the seats

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

Flight departed early Warm welcome by FA in business cabin Nice hot lunch served on first segment between Delhi and Kathmandu Printed menus New signature predeparture drink offered Clean airy cabin Regular updates from captain As usual spectacular landing in Paro

I wouldnt want to be a cheerleader for Ryanair So many things can go wrong But when things go right as they did on this trip I think it should be said that the airline provides a good service at a reasonable cost Most of the annoying announcements have gone and by paying a few pounds extra you can get a seat up front and take an extra bag on board The cabin crew were efficient and friendly particularly on the return flight where they were smiling and looked happy to be there

Berlin to Dusseldorf Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings This A was a different configuration then the first flight Legroom was less and was just enough for me m crew were smiling and good The flight delayed by minutes

I want to make a sincere gratefulness to your information service staff I recently lost my passport on Feb and boarding pass before the security check Since it was late at night and the information kiosk on departure lobby was closed I called the hotline a kind lady staff name as Kuje who checked for me again and again if any lost report She also suggest me to contach to related staff THE PASSPORT WAS FINALLY FOUND Thank you Kuje San I hope this message could be read by you Cheers from Hong Kong

I very much enjoyed flying with SAS Very attentive and cheerful staff ontime departures and landings free coffee and tea service incl refill clean and modern planes A delightful experience My only little complaint is the ticket fare but after all it was in highseason and ok for such a good service

There were no drivers for wheelchair passengers We waited and waited In the end I went to desk twice The young lady on the computer was very irritable and no help I as a very old lady was beginning to panic as my flight EZY to Luton was due to depart in half an hour I think they got a lady staff from Security to wheel me to Departures I was nearly the last to board my plane Come on Palma Airport you need to improve organisation of Special Assistance The lady that wheeled me to Departures was lovely and helpful

Clean plane totally indifferent crew but what is absolutely amazing is that on such a long flight the flight attendants did not distribute a single drop of water to passengers except to those will to pay for overpriced items not even the cheapest low cost airlineand this was not a low cost would do better

Es una aeropuerto pequeo pero moderno tiene todo lo accesible que se necesita para un viajero es rpido en lo que es migracin las malestas llegan rpido al recogedor todo limpio hay WiFi gratis conectores por muchas partes muy amable el personal buena seguridad lo Malo son los precios de las tiendas todo esos precios desorbitados pero en lo que respecta al aeropuerto muy bueno anunci de vuelos pantallas todo modern It is a small but modern airport it has everything that is needed for a traveler it is fast in what is migration the baggage arrives quickly to the pickup everything is clean there is free WiFi connectors for many parts very friendly and good security personnel Bad things are the prices of the stores with those exorbitant prices but in regards to the airport very good announcements with modern screens for flights

The terminal is Sovietstyle and a little big for just or flights a day to Moscow and the occasional charter Checkin was slow with initially only one desk open but the service was friendly and efficient when eventually obtained With a blizzard on the tarmac it was unsafe for the bus to drive out to the plane Stumbling across the whipped up snow and ice is not something for the fainthearted The early offer of an onboard drink was appreciated

Small functional airport which is a bit drab for a holiday destination like Langkawi Clean but a bit rusty A decent common hall with shopping and eating before check in after baggage claim but next to nothing to do on the airside Still more pleasant than KLIA or Subang
Good airport nice shops and the seating is comfortable great restaurants very respectful staff and flights always on time

Flew internal flights in Burma with this local airline Surprisingly new plane pretty much on time and with very pleasant crews Also served a good snack gave out towels although flights were only about minutes Was a bit reticent about using them but very pleasantly surprised

Convenient location only mins from the Mosque Excellent modern facilities Nice simple elegant layout with steelwork reflecting date palm trees Convenient location of cafetarias toilets and prayer rooms Friendly staff and security personnel Clean and tidy Ample seating facilities

Bornholm to Copenhagen The flight on halfanhour was smooth and on time Very relaxed boarding and in the air you are offered coffeetea and a piece of chocolate by smiling crew Seats OK aircraft clean and announcements informal Danish as also often experienced on ofter Scandinavian carriers DAT now serve several routes inside Denmark and have always been ontime Tickets on this route however somewhat expensive compared to earlier days

A small airport right in the east of the city center with a convenient metro connection readily available The terminal itself is small but well organized and has enough small shops for food and beverages Security queuing times late in the evening were nonexistent border control only inbound was equally fast Best airport if youve to be in London itself

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane

Corpus Christi is fine small airport In remarkably good shape and well kept Very simple and easy to navigate TSA security was a breeze no lines and all staff were actually very firendly Not much offering presecurity but couple of shops and restaurants post security Easy to get to just west of downtown

BrusselsAleppo DamascusBrussels Cheapest tickets to Syria direct flights from Brussels to Aleppo and Damascus friendly crew adequate food Although older Airbus they were clean and looked well maintained and a lot of legspace
Its easy to get around very friendly people and easy to get bags and leave Always a good experience and they have free wifi so never a problem with communication

Janakpur the capital of Madhesi province in Nepal has the IATA code JKR and the provincial government has recently revamped the airport with a total overhaul new building replacing the old one that means an entirely new terminal but the same old runway It may rank as as the best airport operating domestic flights only in Nepal Belts for luggage handling big hall with sufficient seating facilities restaurant inside and a nice departure lounge Toilets arent clean People are too introvert security personnel needs to improve on behavioural front Not long queue for departure Basic facilities for other things parking enough for passenger load

The airport is very small and virtually all of its flights are internal Swedish flights Firstly the airport doesnt open until am on Sundays if you show up earlier you will be waiting outside until it does which in winter in Sweden will not be much fun Secondly the first shuttle bus from Stockholm city centre to Bromma doesnt leave Stockholm until am on Sunday and it takes about minutes By contrast shuttle buses to Arlanda leave every minutes all day These factors are well worth bearing in mind for arrivingdeparting Bromma The lounge is also closed on Sundays The airport has a small selection of coffees and cakes and a very small and not particularly extensive souvenir shop possibly because the primary users are Swedish people on internal flights

Quito is a really nice new airport about km from the city there is very little available around it The airport has free wifi which is always a bonus As it seems with all airports now the prices of small things like coffee etc are expensive My experience with the new airport was excellent not so though with the employees of American Airlines at Quito Airport beware

Surabaya airport is a very quick and efficient airport On arrival the visa on arrival queue was very short immigration there was a short wait of about minutes by the time I was done with both the bags had already arrived Probably one of the quickest experiences for me from exiting the aircraft to curbside Similar experience on departure quick efficient checkin with Cathay Pacific short lines at security and immigration The terminal is spacious and has a lot of natural light from the full height windows on either side the restrooms were very clean Food options are limited to a Burger King and Starbucks the duty free has a good selection for a small airport The premier lounge which was in a temporary set up was the only disappointment Chose to sit at the Starbucks instead Free wifi at the airport is also quite good

Berlin Tegel is a very unique airport both is positive and negative ways After arriving at Berlin Tegel and disembarking the aircraft we had to queue up on the jetbridge as the customs checkpoint was right after the jetbridge A very interesting concept Right after that was a small baggage carousel then out of the departures area This meant that there was basically no departures area We had to wait quite some time for our baggage When we returned to to the airport our checkin process was pretty smooth and the lounge was easily accessible There was a huge observation deck which spanned the roof of a terminal offering beautiful views of the runway and tarmac a good place to spend the time However you have to go through a small security check and buy a ticket before entering Every two gates had its own departure area with seats and its own security checkpoint This meant snaking queues into the public area each time a flight was boarding and it was hard to walk around with baggage because there was little space Inside the tiny departures area there was insufficient seating and insufficient space for the boarding queue Everyone was squeezed at the gate and there was absolutely no order or anything No queues set up

Im a native Sudanese born and raised in Sudan who travels a lot around the World Whenever I visit my beloved Sudan I always feel sad twice The first time is when I arrive at KRT Arrival Terminal This terminal was opened in It was as it is now small with two halls handling maximum of two airplanes at any time But it was nice clean artfully designed and the staff members seemed to be happy working there Unfortunately since then nothing has changed improved or fixed as in some cases and its been getting worse and worse every time I see it The second time I feel sad is when I leave Sudan Not only because Im leaving home but because of the waiting battle at KRT Departure Terminal where bureaucracy is at its highest level This terminal was born more than sixty years ago and never raised Its still small and always seemed very crowded even with one airplane passengers You always have to have extra money with you for the unannounced new fees or stamps Sudan has just signed a peace accord ending more than years of civil war in the South The oil money has started fueling the economy and a new state of art airport is being planned in the east side of the River Nile in Omdurman Hopefully this new airport will be opened soon Theres more than ten millions Sudanese who leave outside Sudan And always willing to visit their family no matter what sometimes twice a year The great generous and passionate people of Sudan deserve much more than what they have now

No frills quick easy safely and clean flights from Dagestan to Moscow The airplane was clean the staff in nice uniforms professional They packed us quickly flew us safely the baggage was out sooner than I made it to the carousel Only a glass of water for the whole flight but it is only hours Nothing to complain about would fly again and recommend

There are substantial and ongoing improvements to Freetown Airport They have been rebuilding the terminal building around the old structure for the last few months Departure and arrival procedures are now quite painless compared with the hot and basic conditions before The check in area is large and clean and I did not have to queue for long They could still do with increasing the air conditioning in that area though Security is good and immigration is using new computers and biometric systems The departure lounge is now quite big and comfortable There are a few well stocked duty free shops The original restaurant is still available as well as a new one upstairs The new one is not well signposted Overall a big improvement FNA now compares favourably with other airports in Africa
Wonderful crew on this very short flight The aircraft comfort better than the ATR which is the main BW commuter No service on this minute hop but all in all great value and on time

We use Toulon four or five times each year to travel via Paris to wherever just wish Air France would link TLN to CDG instead of just to ORY which then requires about minutes for the bus transfer between the two Its a small and very quiet airport with about seven or eight flights per day maybe ten at weekends therefore everything is all very laid back Air France checkin is always super efficient with two or three staff in front of the check in area security a breeze and on the CRJ most of the year its a nice meter walk in the sunshine to board at an apron stand Drinks and eats in the terminal and departure lounge are half the price of Nice and Marseille Enough facilities for a couple of flights at the same time but this rarely happens so no queues or crowds anywhere

The service was good everything that I ordered came in a minute or less and all my needs were attended to Free snacks of hot fudge and tea Fast and there were no delays not late for take off or landing Really recommend thanks for a great flight I am really happy

SCAT has a very poor reputation but I had no problems with them Check in was performed by a handling agent in Almaty and as usual with any airline there it was perfunctory but efficient I had selected my seats previously online with no issues The flight started to board a little late alongside an Air Astana flight departing minutes later to Astana resulting in many passengers going to the wrong gate and being turned back there This is more an airport issue than an airline one though The flight pushed back around minutes behind schedule The aircraft although rather old felt comfortable and the crew were very efficient They managed to serve candies before take off a boxed meal and a drink followed by tea and coffee and more candies before landing all for a hour minute flight Baggage was included in the ticket price and the onboard service was friendly The price was less than many European low cost carriers would charge for their most basic service Their low safety ranking nearly put me off but according to their website they are working on getting accreditation so this reassured me and I am glad I flew with them

I used Olympic Air to fly from Athens to Paros and return The aircraft used was an immaculately clean ATR that despite its year of age seemed brand new It seems the airline is really focusing on maintaining the cabins pristine The cabin crew consisted of flight attendants on each leg groomed to perfection and showcasing exceptional customer service skills A very short flight of roughly and we were offered water and sweets This is quite the rarity these days and highly appreciated treated as a guest and not simply as just another passenger Flights departed with a slight delay due to the air traffic restrictions but made up most of the time lost during flight Bags arrived on time and very prompt I would definitely recommend this legendary brand and i am so happy to see it operating in such high standards even on such short flights

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

A small airport with a modern purposebuilt terminal with direct raillink from the city With only one flight to serve on a Sunday afternoon service all round should have been and was excellent Plenty of seating although that in the bar was a bit utilitarian

Best domestic airline on the globe Nothing else need be said but I will Thailand not famous and more infamous for service quality but this little gem of an airline ticks every box and its exceptional quality is unequalled in the industry for any airline let alone a budget one

Our flight from Dusseldorf to Paris came in late Boarding went fast and according to our onward tickets in Premium Economy we had SkyPriority status Airportstaff in Dsseldorf was great professional and well informed about the connecting time in CDG The flight was without any specials Friendly crewmembers and a nice plane I havent expected a snack on this short flight but CoffeeTea and a Croissant served right after take off Seats on this plane offering enough legspace A good flight with HOP

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

Dusseldorf to London City Very nice flight including free Snacks and drinks Legroom was okay and staff was friendly but seemed a little stressed due to a huge amount of hand luggage in this flight Inflight magazines were old

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

Airport conditions are fairly reasonable given the recent difficulties Do try to have your visa in good order before arriving Visa on arrival is only possible if it has been arranged in advance and takes some time to issue at the airport Apart from that the arrivals process is OK Just follow everyone else Departing is also not too bad However as has been pointed out the signs are all in Arabic so it can be difficult to know where to go Check in is a little chaotic Finding the departure lounge may not be that easy Staff are actually quite helpful and polite There are a few shops and a basic business lounge Wireless internet is available and works quite well

Stavanger is a comfortable and bright regional airport Arrival is hasslefree with short walking distances and quick luggage delivery Departure is easy too with selfservice checkin machines Although I flew on a busy Sunday afternoon waiting time to clear security control did not exceed mins However the departure lounge clearly lacks seating areas An airport bus connects the airport with the city centre every mins note that it only accepts cash and no credit cards

Tehran to Cologne with Iran Air A wonderful airline with good service The flight took hours and we had meals breakfast with breads and a lot of other things and lunch was chicken with saffron rice and a small salad yogurt and a cake Drinks were also for free My seat had enough space and it was comfortable A small delay of minutes but that was because some passengers were late

Pleasant surprise Planes were new and clean Staff was attentive and efficient Flights were on time We prebooked meals which were quite nice We booked during holiday season so tickets were on the more expensive side but all in all good value Would fly with them again
