Airport on Arrival no problem We hired a car and having found the car hire desk we were directed to the car pick up point which turned out to be a considerable distance away No shuttle service You just have to leg it If it had been raining we would have been soaked Cant imagine what it must be like for people in wheelchairs or families with pushchairs plus luggage Car hire needs to be closer to the terminal or shuttle service provided Departure was not good We had to leave our bags to be scanned go to the other side for Security check which meant leaving our bags and personal belongings unattended When called for our flight we were herded into a holding pen not enough seats stood for minutes while members of staff called out peoples names to re check their flight details this was done in a very unfriendly and unapologetic manner Took the shine off what had otherwise been a very pleasant trip to this beautiful island

The airport is clean nicely compact and easy to navigate once on the property It has clearly been renovated in the relatively recent past and that is seen in how spacious the security area now is and how modern the architecture now is Checkin was quite easy and hasslefree Security is quite timeconsuming tedious trudge if you dont have TSA PreCheck but if you do have PreCheck youre pretty much golden There are several pretty nice stores and restaurants postsecurity nothing fancy nothing even particularly Texan but satisfactory However I cant bring myself to particularly like this airport Unless the much nastierinalmosteveryway Bush airport across town which has friendly personnel the people that work at Hobby seem to have taken on a mission to be snarky and powertrippy toward passengers From shuttle bus drivers to ticketing agents from TSA personnel to store clerks and from restaurant employees to gate agents hardly anybody at Hobby seems to appreciate the fact that they actually work at a fairly beautiful modern airport If Bush employees can have a positive attitude so too should Hobby employees but maybe thats asking for too much Furthermore this airport does have some of the worst signage Ive ever seen at least approaching the airport and within the terminal presecurity the quality of the signage is great but the directions can be confusing Also the economy parking lot fills up easily and often forcing unfortunate drivers to park in the parking garage adjacent to the terminal which costs something like USD daily All in all this airport has a lot of the aesthetic measures on point but the management there seem to fail to remember that airports always serve as introductions to cities and regions Are snarky and powertrippy personnel who they really want to represent Houston and Texas I really want to like this airport but I just cant What a shame
Tu Moscow St Petersburg Creature comforts not up to modern aircraft standards but superb real experience Food quite good and service good Do it before the Tus become a thing of the past
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

Im a Connecticut resident and use Bradley a halfdozen times a year Terminal A is perfectly serviceable nothing fancy but it does the trick Luckily most carriers use it Terminal B which I understand will be closed at the end of cannot be demolished fast enough It is an eyesore with next to no services I guess its only advantage is for people who wonder what air travel used to be like in the s and s They can see firsthand in Terminal B I wish BDL had service to longer haul hubs like DEN and SLC but I guess there isnt enough demand Nonetheless Im perfectly happy using the airport Its smaller size means fewer delays quicker deplaning and some breathing room

Clean plane totally indifferent crew but what is absolutely amazing is that on such a long flight the flight attendants did not distribute a single drop of water to passengers except to those will to pay for overpriced items not even the cheapest low cost airlineand this was not a low cost would do better

Not a shining example of modern airport technology but it works Arrival was quite easy since by the time our visas had been processed the queues had gone Departure very easy with short queues The only downside would be the fact that smoking seems to be allowed everywhere and ashtrays are not in use Hence the cafe is rather uncomfortable Everyone was very friendly and helpful

Dhaka to Coxs Baza Booked a discounted ticket more than a month ago Didnt expect too much Just on time departure arrival Thats what I got Boarding luggage handling was smooth Cabin crew wasnt exactly cordial but professional enough It was a min ride but the captain was able to make it bumpy despite clear weather Cheese sandwich cake was good enough for a shorts haul flight like this but as expected no IFE Aircraft was manufactured in so common for local Bangladeshi carriers But the seats were good pitch even for a Dutch national who flew alongside me was well over Hope for a similar experience with Regent next time

Domestic Terminal is older than the International Terminal and was clearly the airport in the past Only few in and out on domestic flights The planes are parked on the apron and usually passengers walk to and from Arrivals is through the single gate to the Baggage Spur not a circular belt so things can pile up if there is a lot of luggage There are toilets before the Arrivals Hall The whole terminal is a single story with Arrivals at one end and Departures at the other end There are no facilities in the Departure Lounge after Security Within the terminal there are a couple of shops selling snacks and souvenirs and a Money Changing booth The whole experience is pretty good not many flights and a generally relaxed friendly attitude You would not believe you were in the Capital City
Windhoek airport is small but clean and really well organized The only restaurant at the check in area is situated at the Arrival area food is fresh and delicious Facilities are quite good

I was transiting with Air China in Beijing Capital Airport Terminal Most international flights operate from Concourse TE but some use TD In my cause both arrival and departure were from TE On transit passengers need to go through document and security and customs check The walking times are not really long and mostly travelators are available There are transfer service checkpoints one from each side of the concourse The crowd is not really well organized and staff is not really helpful Not everyone speaks English which is quite frustrating when you actually need to communicate with airport or security staff Arriving early in the morning get ready to spend h queuing for transit Other than that I have to note that Terminal is very modern by its looks and layout The ceiling is high which makes it seam like the airport is free and spacious Walking distances are not too long Most gates are accessible in less than minutes of calm stroll Between TE TD and TC there is an automated people mover train which is easily accessible after security I didnt use it but I located its station and observed it a little There are few restaurants which in my opinion are quite reasonable priced Early in the morning only few Chinese restaurants and Western cafes were opened The food is actually quite delicious I would note good availability of seating spaces Some are equipped with universal power outlets and USB chargers If you want to use WiFi better use WiFi kiosks as SMS sometimes doesnt go through Be aware that you wont be able to use most messengers and social networks Also it was nice to have drinking fountains within short reach from most seating areas I would suggest considering Beijing Capital Airport as transit hub for Asia Clean and modern airport with all the necessary facilities for longer transits

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too

LimaCusco and three other internal flights within Peru All flights on time and quality of aircraft pilots as in landing and take offs was exceptional Aircraft were almost new As all were clean including the toilets which cannot always be taken for granted on an aircraft that is subjected to multiple take offs and landings during the day FAs very professional A very good experience

Tibet Airlines offered great service and comfortable seating with ample legroom Chengdu to Lijiang is a relatively short flight of hour but crew were very accommodating They had inflight entertainment showing on screens in both English and Chinese Water only served on this flight but would recommend Tibet Airlines

We were initially a bit disappointed when Etihad did not use its own aircraft on the route between Abu Dhabi and Jakarta but used wetleased Wamos equipment However the entire experience was good Clean and spacious plane with pleasant configuration so ideal if you are traveling with people The staff was professional and friendly They carried out very thorough safety checks before departure and landing The only real downside was the entertainment Little choice and that should really be different no flash path information Furthermore only praise for Wamos A Basic experience on time and comfortable

Victoria Airport on arrival the terminal was easy to find clean and well laid out Friendly and helpful staff who went out of their way to guide you checkin was a breeze and no surprises with our luggage Even the customs staff shared some humour with us On the other side of security it was just as impressive with clean well laid out waiting areas and washrooms Water fountains available that you could fill up your water bottle from and not have to pay the rip off price for bottled water like at other airports We will definitely use this airport again in the future

Small airport by international standards Immigration and customs smiling and welcoming Departure easy with only one aircraft departure tax has to be paid and quite rigorous security procedure but done with typical Cook Islands good nature Walk from terminal to aircraft across tarmac necessary Could be a wet one in a tropical downpour

I am so impressed with Air North The last time I flew with a different airline I remember waiting ages for drink service that only came around once and paying something ridiculous for a small snack But Air North blew that experience out of the water Complimentary food and drinks are one thing but this was only a hour flight and they kept us busy the whole time serving drinks a lovely sandwich a cookie and then more drinks I was positively full at the end of the flight And when I complimented the cookies oatmeal chocolate chip served warm the very lovely stewardess Keely got me and my sister my travelling companion a few for the road She gave us good tips for visiting the Yukon too The airline was clean flight was smooth and service was fantastic I wish Air North flew everywhere they would be my first choice every time

Why do we always want to fly the big airlines VLM has the efficiency of a budget airline the service of a high value airline and the punctuality of a German airline They have friendly staff and after landing you are out of the airport in minutes Moreover book well in advance and you have a very attractive fare
On time departure Excellent value and they gave a meal on a hour flight We arrived mins early Staff was professional Bags delivered in a normal amount of time

For departures Algiers new airport is fairly spacious functional and the staff is friendly I might have been lucky but I found the police controls and security to go fairly quickly Shops are limited but I found them sufficient also they are open very early and close late The choice of restaurants is limited to for each hall and they are of the same provider They offer reasonable selections of light eating and drinking On arrivals I find it inadequate to have to walk down stairs after coming off the plane I did not see an elevator available The wait for the luggage is too long I was told it was due to the luggage scanner being undersized for the traffic One important deficiency is the absence of English signs they are all in French and Arabic only A shame for a brand new International airport Over all I was satisfied mainly due to efficiency at departure and the feeling of space which is lacking too often in aging European airports
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

Flying from AEP to IGU in Prem Economy I was nervous about what to expect on Aerolineas I have to say that I was really pleasantly surprised once we got on the plane Check in at Business was a breeze Security and Boarding was polite chaos They had two flights going to two locations boarding at the same gate at the same time However the premium economy was great simple but worth the extra The seats were comfortable and clean think that armchair type of seats you use to get in business class Service on this flight was friendly on others it was nonexistant They provided a sandwich and soft drinks The best thing though is on every Aerolineas flight my bags were on the carousel as I arrived there They have some amazing expedited system to get premium bags off which is great
Great service safety standard met Comfy seat and nice snacks The staffs in all aspects are very kind and very helpful Sad it will merge with Thai Airways

Easy access by bus or taxi Two terminals International on the right Domestic on the left as you face them but only metres apart Signs in English as well as Russian although all announcements are in Russian as you would expect How many of the staff speak English may be a good question one who does is the AviaNova manager Easy layout to navigate in domestic terminal although there is not much space for the checkin queues so they snake around the room However the staff for my flight anyway were very efficient and the queue moved quickly Security check was quick and easy Airside has an expensive cafe and coffee shop as well as a newsstand and gift shop Plenty of comfortable seating WiFi is available good signal but every site I tried came up with Security Certificate not issued by Trusted Source so theres possibly some bug in their software I didnt do any more than just log in Bussed to plane only complaint as with so many of these airports is that you go upstairs to a departure lounge and then have to walk back down for the bus

Heho to Yangon Another very good flight same ATR aircraft no seat numbers given but all very easy boarding Plenty of space seating and inflight snacks given with coffee or Tea One member of crew not happy but not the end of the world At I had no problem with the seat space in fact better than many European airlines

Excellent small airport which is newly built few flights in the afternoon when it is at its busiest It is located way out of town hence you need to have pre booked transport to reach the town as no public transport is available The building is air conditioned which is a relief from searing heat The washrooms needed a bit of TLC The shopping was expensive as is the case at any international airport Food options are plenty Aircraft turn around time is quick Overall a good airport WiFi is free for one hour

Ive been in CCS many times and the improvements made to the airport are incredible Very friendly and helpful staff Still it is not a modern airport but manageable considering the amount of passengers The only bad thing is that they are not paying attention to the security and when you are in the arrivals hall a bunch of people come and ask you if you want a taxi or maybe you want to buy the local currency I undestand this due to the political situation the country is facing but as I always say it could and must be better

I flew into and out of Moscow Sheremetyevo Airport in December for the first time and was quite impressed with arrivals and maybe a little less so with the departure process Arriving and clearing customs and security and getting bags was all pretty straight forward and easy enough and efficient Signage for me was great and easily navigated to the bag carousels and also found an ATM before exiting to take out some cash Plenty of food options once exiting and then I easily followed signs to the Aeroexpress train from the airport to Moscow Belorussky about a min walk through terminalI bought my train ticket online prior and scanned the barcode and all worked fineSo transport to and from the airport is easy on the way back I took a Yango ride and it pulled up easily right in front of terminal On the way departing security is pretty tight but to be expected you go through two screening stations and again check in pretty seamless except for the fact your Departure Terminal indicated on the board may not be the one you finally need to go to as I found out Ended up having a fairly decent walk from one terminal to another Once that finished then we headed to the aerobus as is common in Europe to be driven to the plane waited for about mins with open bus doors for late passengers in Moscow winterthen the drive started and instead of a couple of minutes it turned into about minutes driving from one aide of the runway around the end and over to the opposite apron to the plane But for me all an adventure but just be prepared for a bit of a walk and maybe an extended bus ride Overall a nice clean airport that was very functional and not overly crowded when I went through and easily accessible and a good range of eateries and amenities

Vnukovo Airport Waiting for baggage almost hour now and havent get it yet No extra infornation from airport officials In combination with absence of smoking rooms everything becomes socalled great Ill consider another airport the next time Though ceiling is ok

I was browsing airfares for a late November trip and I stumbled across a business class fare on JAL for much less than it usually sells for Approx USD for TorontoChicagoTokyoBangkok return YYZ ORD was on AA Considering I usually pay about for economy with my extra golf bag this seemed like a no brainer and I pulled the trigger on that fare the very next day That decision was the correct one Ive just returned from the trip which is an annual one and Ive never crossed half the globe and had it feel so easy A fully lie flat bed all the way except TorontoChicago and a completely private one at that The food was great the service was great the lounges were great check in priority and fast track immigration in TokyoBangkok It was as easy as travel can be Ive flown JAL in economy before and even then I thought it was a superior experience than our local option Air Canada which continues to disappoint every time I recall even in economy the seats were wider fewer total seats across instead of and the meals were better Well business exceeded expectations even after YouTube reviews had set them sky high I have no reservations about wholeheartedly recommending them If I were to nitpick and I was fully expecting it as everyone seems to mention it is that the cabin is kept too warm So I packed shorted and a tshirt for sleeping in It was manageable

Very Crowded check in and long security lines However once past security it was a very clean and nice airport Not enough seats in the gate area however Just know where you are going and leave plenty of time before your flight

Tulsa International Airport is in my opinion one of the easiest airports to navigate Its not super large and everyone is very friendly We were able to ride a free shuttle to our car as it was about degrees when we arrived The man driving the shuttle was very nice and took us all the way to our car It was very convenient and nice

Stavanger is a comfortable and bright regional airport Arrival is hasslefree with short walking distances and quick luggage delivery Departure is easy too with selfservice checkin machines Although I flew on a busy Sunday afternoon waiting time to clear security control did not exceed mins However the departure lounge clearly lacks seating areas An airport bus connects the airport with the city centre every mins note that it only accepts cash and no credit cards

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options
Its not crowded Its very new and clean airport Sign and directions are easy to follow Before my departure time I really enjoy spending time Ankara airport Esenboga

I pass thru Miri airport at least once a month now that I work here It is nice and clean and all counter staff courteous and efficient do visit the lounge as they accept paying walk in customers Also a recent addition that is quiet welcome are the massage chairs

Flew Mahan Air economy class from Dubai to Tehran IKA with Mahan Air A felt safe the aircraft was clean and comfortable Cabin crew service was friendly and efficient Quality of food and beverages non alocholic were of good standard Would recommend this airline to everyone

Es una aerolnea fantstica el personal es muy amable el precio muy asequible Me gustara que hubiera vuelos a ms lugares A Gran Canaria solamente hay dos vuelos a la semana desde mi lugar de residencia estara mejor que hubiera mas Its a fantastic airline the staff is very friendly and the prices are very affordable I wish there were flights to more places There are only two flights a week to Gran Canaria from where I live more would be better

I am a big fan of this airport It has only four or five checkin desks and lots of plants and pine furniture in the small departure hall It feels quite homely The staff at check in and at the small cafe have always been pleasant when I have flown from here I have also flown from Vasteras when the weather conditions have been dreadful very cold and heavy snow and everything at the airport and the shuttle bus from Stockholm have functioned with typical Swedish efficiency

Flew Air Niugini because of the B very nice cabin in a xx configuration Took seat A bulkhead seat very comfortable with heaps of leg room Staff were amazing and very attentive food was OK entertainment was enough for this flight of approx hrs

Singapore airport is magnificent and extremely wellmaintained with its facilities gardens waterfalls etc but arriving in the country has been made very difficult for Nordics There is no one at the immigration department upon arrival you first have to fill out a variety of information in English on a small computer which can take up to an hour If the machine accepts everything be happy There was no one to assist you in the queue of dozens of people at the machines And if you are accepted you go to another automatic machine where you present your passport and other necessary documents Your bag has been spinning for a long time waiting for you to pick it up from the belt When leaving the country everything seemed to be OK but then the departure security check began which was anything but friendly The border control officers who were clearly enjoying it gave orders and ripped off the jackets of older people who did not obey at the same second A militarystyle manly arrogant woman took my passport and boarding pass away because they noticed my diabetes pills everything was drugs to them Then I was ordered aside and subjected to various tactile tests with a digital device They couldnt didnt care to read prescriptions Overall it had the feel of being in the military chain of command

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much

Travelling in and out of Launceston Airport proved a pleasant experience Since the terminal is still fairly new everything seemed to be in very good working order Facilities were very good having large coffee shops and well stocked souvenirgift shop selling real Tasmanian and Launceston branded items Check in and customs were hassle free No time lost waiting for luggage or taxis

BudapestVenice Marco Polo Malev put me on this Moldavian Airlines flight without warning of a code share Proved to be a fairly pleasant flight in the end Food consisted of a chocolate bar and a glass of Hungarian red wine On the way back the flight was a little late arriving and they clearly rushed everyone on without having time to clean up The connection between Malev and Moldavian airlines is confusing The pilot thanked us for flying with Malev but the stewardesses were in Moldavian uniforms and the plane was clearly Moldavian

Staff all very helpful in particular a lady from the special assistance team She went above and beyond what a lovely lady who clearly is very devoted to her job role We would choose to fly from Eindhoven airport again as our experience was so smooth and professionally handled Thank you such a small thing to say I hope this gets back to the whole team

Use the airport regularly and its great parking facilities are next to the terminal so no need to go on a five mile cross country slog with children in tow nor wait for a packed shuttle boss and try and cram all luggage and children on board As stated before the airport is small and basic understatement but then again I dont use airports to sit in or spend all my holiday money in shops before i even depart the UK something which I think happens at many of the larger airports A very short walk from the terminal the interim passenger facility as it is more technically known to the plane and then you are away on your flight Coming back is so easy as well the arrivals area is a seperate building from departures If two planes arrive at the same time then I am under the impression that one has to wait for a short period of time foir the arrivals area to clear However after disembarking getting through passport control and getting to the baggage claim belt we were waiting for about two minutes and then hey presto the bags started coming through Again a very short walk to the car park ever present taxis and an hourly bus service tofrom the railway station and city centre are also available and we were offhome within minutes of landingat a bigger airport just down the A I have been waiting for minutes just for the baggage carousel to start revolving All in all it is basic but it does exactly what it says on the tin its a building well two buildings for passengers getting to or arriving from a city by air and it does this with minimum of fuss and least amount of time In some ways it is a good alternative for any inbound passengers wishing to avoid the congested London Airports the bus to the railway station and frequent trains to the centre of London could have you in the capital very easily Heres hoping for the new terminal an increase in services and more airlines I know I shall be a regular user of Coventry Airport and so shall my friends family and colleagues for many years to come

Very small but friendly efficient airport Not a great deal to do and not many shops particularly airside but staff are always remarkably friendly and helpful which makes a change from most other airports I visit
This airline has impressive cabin staff and a very efficient ground staff never need check in more than minutes before my flight even in Tokyo

The airport is wellorganized secure and clean with nearly all services available The crew at Air Mauritius is extremely professional and they go above and above to execute their jobs in a courteous and professional manner Nishi the travel consultantpassenger service is amazing in terms of customer service and taking care of passengers with a smile and enthusiasm

Friendly ground staff at checkin Immigration a breeze Duty free shop limited though Smoking area present in departure lounge Some restaurants available for those feeling peckishat cut throat prices considering the price VIP lounge looked cozy enough didnt go in Departure area great for plane spotting All in all a clean facility well run not overwhelmed yet

It was my first time in Yemen and flying Felix Airways The flight was only min but it was enjoyable The staff were friendly and the plane was in a good shape in addition to a comfortable seat and a nice route
Small but good airport the usual Japanese quality clean efficient good staff Places to shop and eat and have lots of charging spots Its so convenient to reach from the city center
This is a really nice airport the arrival and departure terminal are separate which is very convenient The airport hotel was amazing

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time

We flew out of Manchester Airport on th January under very trying weather conditions The journey to the airport at am was quite fraught what with fogsnowice Our taxi driver did a great job even getting us to the airport with a challenging journey We were frankly impressed to walk into T just after am to find any number of Jet ground staff waiting to greet us I have no idea what they had to go through to get to the airport but they would all have had a snow day excuse not to turn up I asked the girl at the check in if we would actually be going to Barcelona for my husbands th and she said course you will with a broad smile Boarding was pretty much on time but then we had to sit for a while for deicing which pushed us back hours Not a problem looking at what was outside the plane Good flight outbound Crew very amenable Do wish they would look at the in flight menu now we travel a few times a year with Jet and are not mad on the food or drink offerings Maybe a refresh Inbound flight to Manchester was what you could call challenging We arrived at the airport just over hours early to find that the plane was still on the runway in Manchester The airport was closed due to snow and so it remained there for over hours Jet sent us a euro voucher each attached to our boarding passes for refreshments We looked around but a basic sandwich in the terminal was over euros This voucher should be at least euros now At last we saw the plane had left Manchester and it made good time landing We had a wave from the pilot on boarding which cheered us up We were about hours late but no compensation as weather and not airline related fair enough Just before landing at Manchester we were advised from the flight deck that a wave of fog had moved in over the airport We then completed or circular routes around the moors waiting to land Having never experienced an ILS landing in fog before it was frankly amazing considering that there appeared to be no visibility at all from the aircraft When we landed we couldnt even see the terminal buildings from the plane and the runway markings came into view just as the plane touched down So Jet did a fantastic job getting us to Barcelona in the worst weather conditions in many years and despite airport closure and fog got us back into Manchester and on the ground Thats what the pilots get paid for they probably should be paid rather more Our quibbles about the in flight food pale into insignificance when youre not on a summer flight to Greece

Flew Waterford to Birmingham on th January Nice little airport staff very friendly Small cafe before departure excellent coffee and light snacks Security and boarding very well handled An enjoyable experience
Very comfortable and the staff were really nice our flight was not delayed it was wonderful flying with HiSky as it was my first time flying with them and had a wonderful experience

My first time flying with Malindo now Batik Air Fabulous experience smooth checkin luggage included Friendly attentive staff Much more comfortable seats that either Air Asia or Jetstar Good pricing I have already booked another flights Impressive economy airline for the price you pay

I returned this week from Tyumen to Munich Another B this time with vintage business cabin and seats As I was alone in the section I missed the Europeanstyle seats that would have allowed me to completely lie down instead of sitting with a recline Crew were smiling and helping with more polyglot aptitudes than during my preceding flight Excellent tasty lunch with Sardinian I checked red wine Takeoff and landing right on time I shall not hesitate to fly with UTair again

Portlands airport feels slightly dated not run down by any means but still pleasant and functional enough A lot of construction taking place at this time in the checkin area I guess in an effort to modernize the airport and expand passenger capacity The terminals themselves again are a little dated but still nice enough and functional TSA PreCheck operates smoothly here even where there are a lot of PreCheckers in line Personnel whether theyre working at checkin for TSA in a restaurant or at the boarding gate are usually super bubbly but still professional helpful and polite PDX is neither stellar nor bad its aboveaverage but with a lot of potential And its better than SeaTac

When I landed in Anchorage late at night the first thing I noticed was how busy the terminal was I was really hungry after a long hour flight from LAX so the first thing I did was grab something to eat from Cinnabon one of many restaurants at this airport Baggage claim experience was smooth Taxi was readily available outside for transportation to hotel While returning back I had a very smooth checkin and security experience If you enjoy watching beautiful scenery and planes Anchorage will not disappoint As you walk around the terminal you will notice many photo opportunities both inside and outside the terminal

I agree entirely with Fernando Immigration staff also very helpful as well as friendly and efficient Only problem now is the collapsed bridge on the road to Caracas A diversion has been made but is only two lanes and is operated on a tidal system Can add an hour or two to the journey

Ive used within China different airlines Air China Spring Airlines Shenzen Airlines and Kunpeng Airlines Clearly the best one was Kunpeng Airlines Although the flight had a delay of hours bad weather at the airport from which the airplane came information at the airport was good boarding really fast after the airplane arrived Nevertheless it was clean inside and the crew was very friendly As it was a short flight only minutes I expected less or no service onboard Was surprised that they offer a drink and a small meal The airplane itself seems to be a new one

Birgi Airport has recently had a makeover so new there were no arrival or departure boards In many respects it reminded me of Pisa Aeroporto before it got too big On arrival I was nearly the victim of a potential scam Unlicensed taxi drivers gather around the door to the arrivals hall They spot your name on a card being held by a genuine tour company As you come into the arrivals hall they call out your name and when you acknowledge them they claim to be your pre booked taxi Fortunately I noticed my name on a card being held by representatives from the genuine company I had booked with For departing flights eat before you set out for the airport At checkin there is just one very small snack bar and shop Panini and water just over EUR and not a great deal of seating Everything was clean and new but facilities are extremely minimal with only vending machines for refreshments after security Waiting in the gate area the seating is insufficient to cope with the number of passengers I thought it was also very warm but probably not so for your average Sicilian Access to aircraft is by descending several flights of stairs and then crossing the tarmac on foot

Very little queueing times in both the domestic and international terminals Jacksons International has just undergone some big renovation work and is looking excellent with great shopping and cafs Jacksons Domestic still needs a bit of work especially in the departures hall but I understand plan are afoot A pleasant airport to transit
Yangon to Lashio in November ATR plane Allocated seating and good snack served with excellent customer service Would fly with them again any time

The airport is very big so you better arrive early if you have international flight Immigration queuing might take more than an hour and duty free is very far away from lounges and gates so you might have to choose between duty free or visiting the lounge Staff are generally friendly even under pressure

Our flight was on time checkin was smooth The staff on board were friendly I highly recommend this airline despite several negative reviews I think it is much better than many European low cost airlines Il nostro volo stato puntuale il checkin stato veloce Il personale a bordo stato cordiale Consiglio vivamente questa compagnia aereanonostante le diverse recensioni negative penso sia molto meglio di molte low cost europee

Monday th April what an absolute disgrace hours to get through security after being told minutes lifts out of order another reserved for staff when you escaped the great long queues conveyor belts working out of very little staff available On return hour wait for luggage an absolute disgrace A final comment I will never use Birmingham again and yet only minutes from home and have used this airports many many times and many times had problems but no more East Midlands much better
Good airport international terminal T is nice spacious clean The only problem I see is the fact that the interdiction of smoking is not always respected

ODSIEV on a new ATR having small screens for the safe announcements and you can see some comics during the hour minutes flight Flight was full but service was ok they offered refreshment Staff were very friendly and we were on time Overall very nice experience

Still a well organized airport We use the new international section Clean and simple to use Good staff security and customs Just expect that more international flights will be available soon from Qubec

Ive been in CCS many times and the improvements made to the airport are incredible Very friendly and helpful staff Still it is not a modern airport but manageable considering the amount of passengers The only bad thing is that they are not paying attention to the security and when you are in the arrivals hall a bunch of people come and ask you if you want a taxi or maybe you want to buy the local currency I undestand this due to the political situation the country is facing but as I always say it could and must be better

Just had to leave this review on th May returned from Rhodes and my flight was delayed two hours Just after midnight left baggage reclaim to go to my car I had a flat battery and was unable to get into my car It was exceptionally cold and all I was wearing was shorts and a tee shirt I returned to the terminal where I met the staff at the parking desk At this time the terminal was empty and they were locking up The staff came out and helped me gain entry to my car but I had a two hour wait for the Green Flag breakdown The staff waited with me almost an hour and had to go home leaving me alone in the car park freezing cold but not before he returned to his office made me a hot cup of tea and brought it to me in my car A beautiful act of kindness and one I will never forget
Special appreciation to the cabin crew Sonika I was super impressed with her fluency in announcements all three different languages and it was just amazing to hear her out

Airport on Arrival no problem We hired a car and having found the car hire desk we were directed to the car pick up point which turned out to be a considerable distance away No shuttle service You just have to leg it If it had been raining we would have been soaked Cant imagine what it must be like for people in wheelchairs or families with pushchairs plus luggage Car hire needs to be closer to the terminal or shuttle service provided Departure was not good We had to leave our bags to be scanned go to the other side for Security check which meant leaving our bags and personal belongings unattended When called for our flight we were herded into a holding pen not enough seats stood for minutes while members of staff called out peoples names to re check their flight details this was done in a very unfriendly and unapologetic manner Took the shine off what had otherwise been a very pleasant trip to this beautiful island

Tel Aviv to Minsk Amazing flight no delays we boarded quickly clean aircraft really comfy seats and the food was great choice between sausages and beef and we got a waffle cherries bread with the the meal Staff was really nice no complaints

My experience was very smooth no flight changes or surprises in the departure flight In the arrival flight there was a security threat in Beirut Airport resulting in flight delays for ALL airlines The way Ajet dealt with the situation was outstanding and professional Given the unintended delays we missed the next flight Without even asking and as soon as we arrived to their desk they fixed the flight for the next day and offered us free transport hotel and meals The air and ground crew is very nice and helpful The only setback is in communicating with the Airport employees in English Until this improves communicate with a smile and nice attitude and youll get what you want eventually

Lufthansa operated by Germanwings from Barcelona to Berlin Tegel and back Both fights on time with very quick boarding and ground service First flight was a year old A plane was very clean and comfortable The return flight on a year old A despite the old age of the aircraft it was very clean comfortable and showed signs of great maintenance service You cold only tell that it was that old becouse it was considerably louder but the journey was very enjoyable The snacks are not very good but I can forgive that on a h min flight Great comfort in the seats with more legroom Great value for money and going to try Eurowings

Mykonos to Thessaloniki A short super enjoyable flight Everything went well on both flights the planes were nice and clean crew presentable professional and helpful and the flights on time short and so enjoyable I kept looking through the windows at the islands we were flying over beautiful Both flights were under minutes long we even got a small bottle of water coffee a cookie and a wet towel I can totally recommend Ellinair

Good shopping for such a small airport Clean and clear Cheap car parking compared with Schiphol When arriving plane parked in front of terminal and was outside the building with my checked bag in minutes

Excellent service Nothing to complain Theyve served an excellent food during the h long flight and was delicious All the flight attendants were polite and worried about the cleanliness and support all the passengers aboard There arent delays and the luggage have arrived perfectly fine A Grade

This was a lovely flight from Hobart to the Gold Coast on Tigerair Boarding was orderly We walked to the plane and boarded through the rear I had row to myself in the second last row I will travel with them again

One of the best African airports that i have ever been to I had worries at first before going through terminal but to my surprise the whole experience was stressfree and enjoyable The airport atmosphere was very pleasant the checkin was quick and courteous the duty free shops had some good and reasonably priced items and there were also some decent looking food outlets the washrooms are well maintained and staff were friendly despite their limited proficiency of English language

I had a problem with the immigration I somehow missed the immigration check after my evening flight from Hanoi to Luang Prabang my responsibility of not having checked if I had a stamp The next day I went back and they charged me on top of what I already paid made me sign a paper written in Laos not a copy or a picture I was able to take after I asked I paid as there were no other option They were not nasty but not kind they kept telling me its my fault for not checking No sharing the responsibility or acknowledged that they might have not done a proper job on their hands So check your stamps before you leave there are different separate lines to do one for the visa the other for the immigration stamp and be aware that they can play the game they want At the end all is good you pay and you have your passport back with a big smile from their side
I am not sure when you went to the airport in maracaibo but things have change a lot Prices are not as bad and there is lots of choices to eat and drink very reasonable

Flew Bangkok to Paro roundtrip both flights via Calcutta Outbound I was in Economy Plus and the legroom was excellent The breakfast was well served hot and tastyfar more substantial that is offered on many other carriers On the return I was upgraded to business and the leather seat was roomy and comfortable The meal lunch was good but the performance of the crew was truly worldclass I have to say that I was very impressed by the professionalism and demeanour they displayed In business one is given access to priority clearance in Bangkok which worked well but still a long wait for baggagethough mine was the first bag out Excellent offering overall

A relatively large regional airport for a small town However Darwin is the state capital of Northern Territory We checked in for the flight went through security and then waited for the flight to depart There were no hassles or problems Everything went smoothly

A satisfactory experience overall the first leg slightly better than the second one Clean modern aircraft leg space ok food better than average and service more than acceptable For the fare I paid I can have no real complaints Would fly with this company again if the opportunity arose

Pretty good airport Nice restaurant shops and post security amenities They recently finished a terminal expansion project which I must say looks very nice Not many cheap airlines though Overall good airport

This airport has a extremely large number of visitors Ground transport and flow to and from are fine Concessions facilities and restaurants are far and few between sit down bar restaurant for many gates waiting lines everywhere all facilities both male and female have long lines Very far behind the times would rather fly to any other airport in they area

Hiroshima Airport is a small domestic airport and international services at this airport have only been commenced recently so I do not have a high expectation upon my visit in midNovember The airport is small and there are only limited facilities and restaurants available and they charge JPY for people who wish to visit the observation decka down side compared to the major airports in Japan where the observation decks are free of charge Access to the airport is not at all convenient as no trains or subway lines can reach the airport The only choices are limousine buses and rental cars from other cities Nevertheless the airport is very clean and the ground staff both immigration and airline staff are efficient It took me shorter than minutes from disembarking the aircraft to leaving the airport The limited number of restaurants can also provide a satisfactory range of food choices for visitors Given that Hiroshima Airport is only a small regional airport the airport has met my expectations and I would not hesitate in using this airport again upon my next travel to Japan

Such a fantastic flight Our flight attendant Jay was incredible His demeanour was cheerful and friendly and I truly wish every attendant was like him From the moment you got on the plane he had a positive energy and was respectful and helpful of all the guests Love United and kudos for such a great team

This airport is head and shoulders above any other airport I have been to and Ive been through a few Every person I interacted with form check in to security to service staff were all over the top friendly with great senses of humor The security line is the fastest I have ever seen I have never waited in a line here even during the holidays maybe minutes max The gates are clean and modern tons of outlets and different seating arrangements lots of space for only having gates Loads of parking for an airport of this size I was able to park my car like meters from departures and left it there for a week I know how infuriating flying can be especially when things go wrong but it goes a long way when people are so friendly This is my favorite airport and I go out of my way to fly out of here please give these people the recognition they deserve

This airport is good but there is no wifi and check in desk is one There air two shops and one cafe The best thing is that there is an outdoor square and a fountain after passport control There are international gates The gates area is modern

Tibet Airlines offered great service and comfortable seating with ample legroom Chengdu to Lijiang is a relatively short flight of hour but crew were very accommodating They had inflight entertainment showing on screens in both English and Chinese Water only served on this flight but would recommend Tibet Airlines

An excellent short flight with great onboard service from a friendly attentive cabin crew Leg room was ok and the seats were comfortable enough for a short flight Overall a good experience and good value

San Francisco to Indianapolis I was on my last leg of journey home from New Zealand I flew out with American an then Fiji Air New Zealand Jetstar in New Zealand and they were all great The staff on Virgin America need to fly with these airlines and learn how to smile be friendly and not look grouchy A smile goes a long way

Small minimal facilities not much to do while you wait Staff are friendly and efficient The day we arrived there was live music playing in the customs area nice touch We walked out of the terminal to be greeted immediately by our tour arranger

The Tehran lounge was really good free highspeed WiFi plenty of comfortable seating and endless snacks and food options which is really impressive considering that Mehrabad is a small yearold airport mainly used for domestic flights despite being international The A aircraft was really old but well maintained seats were very comfortable and featured a whopping m of legroom The interior was definitely upgraded from the original aircraft as things like touchscreens were nonexistent at the time the aircraft was built Bathroom was also clean and spacious A small amenity kit was provided along with some masks and a hand sanitizing gel A non alcoholic predeparture drink was served along with warm nuts The cabin crew were super warm and friendly a warm breakfast was served which was magnificent The service and amenities were unbelievable for such a short flight Though no WiFi was available on board and the IFE needed some serious improvement Also some snacks and refreshments were served before landing but I was too full to eat or drink so I just went for some water We departed on time but arrived minutes early and like all flights with Iranian pilots the landing was butter smooth It costed for a round trip in business class Overall really good flight and I would definitely fly Mahan Air again

Rigolet Labrador to Goose Bay Labrador on October on an Air Labrador twin Otter Aircraft has been well used over the years but provided a comfortable and quick way back to Goose Bay Bush flying copilot loaded and unloaded the bags seating well wherever there is an empty seat No complaints about the service and would not hesitate to fly with them again

Experienced CMN last month arrival from Paris Orly with RAM and continuing to Muscat with Oman Air Had to retreive my luggage pass immigration and recheckin again All was very smooth and from the time the plane landed I was outside less than min later very impressive Agents were all polite and efficient The secret is like everywhere else Be patient respectful and polite and everything will be fine Will not hesitate to use this Airport again

Travelled late July Arriving from Edinburgh late afternoon found the airport quiet Standing at the back of a long line for passport control I thought we could in for a long wait But they virtually waved the entire plane load through in around minutes By which time the luggage had already arrived So we were out of the airport within minutes Ive never known anything like it On the way back there were several flights delayed due to a storm However everything still worked well for our flight and we departed on time Not a big airport but I was happy with my time there

Always great and good value for money No issues with delayed flights and a smooth journey overall Friendly staff and onboard service even on super short flights eg Bangkok to Trat At Trat airport they also have complimentary snacks and drinks

Despite a delay of about minutes overall it was a good flight Check in was easy the flight attendants were friendly and efficient and the plane was clean and comfortable The only free beverage was water which was no issue on such a short flight
Checkin for the flight was on time the reception by the staff was excellent confidential space The control is efficient and fast the boarding lounge comfortable

I will stay away from most recent reviews I have only one severe criticism and that costs them a star checkin luggage per person in business class of only kg between Europe and the new world Caribbean in this case More for a fee depending on how much you want to take Most decent Airlines even EW Discover let alone famous carriers like Air France and many others allow you X kg per person That has to change absolutely All the rest was plainly EXCELLENT Their ranking around stars has become obsolete The fleet has been completely renewed brand new As replacing the old faithful Boeing otherwise an excellent aircraft

CVG is my home airport and I have always had a good experience compared with other large cities However I recently returned from a trip and had parked in Long Term parking Previously I had only to walk out the door and across the pick up lane to the well marked shuttle buses and ride to the long term parking Apparently they have revised the whole set up and there is zero accessible signage to direct you to a brand new pick up spot for the shuttle buses There should be a sign at the old spot telling of the new one signage in the actual terminal near where arriving customers will see it as they enter the luggage retrieval area arrows and signage that distinguishes the east and the west pick up areas are for different things eg the East is for Uber etc and the West is for parking shuttles note there is a sign for the bus shuttles in the west end only after you have walked about of the way there once in the line designated for different shuttles there needs to be signage that distinguishes which shuttle lot bus will be stopping where there are at different shuttles stopping in this lane and the bus itself needs to have signage eg long term parking This is such a huge oversight please correct it so you can maintain your excellent reputation

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

OsloCopenhagen th Aug on a B Oslo Airport is shamelessly very pricey Timely arrived minutes prior to schedule smooth flight Easy superfast checkin in Oslo Granted nice soft roomy seats and a full row of loads of space Flight only half full Catering onboard good though only at hefty costs Ticket inexpensive No IFE WiFi or frills But no complaints the price does not allow for much complaints Boardingdeboarding very quick through jetbridges Aircraft and FAs were somehow aged but all worked effectively

Brilliant both times we flew them Brilliant food crew especially the Thai based very comfortable seats got a decent amount of sleep Kept snacks in the galleys Stocked bathrooms with toothbrushes eye masks etc Good wifi connectivity decent ife Brilliant airline and will definitely fly again

Morning flight on PR from Daraga to Manila I have international connection in a separate booking booking but check in agent made it sure my luggage was checked through to my final destination which was so much appreciated as it saved me time and effort at Manila Airport Flight was smooth and on time Ticket price was reasonable

Beijing Nanyuan to Hohhot China United is the only airline that uses Beijing Nanyuan a former military airport in the South of Beijing The airport is easy to get to and flights in and out of Nanyuan do not seem to be subject to delays as serious as those at Beijing Capital Theres also very little taxiing Checkin was quick easy but the checkin area is noisy and dilapidated Toilets at the airport werent great The flight was on a newish and the plane was clean Service was friendly and the bacon wrap for breakfast was actually very nice Takeoff and arrival were both on schedule Id use China United again just to avoid the delays at Beijing Capital

A very pleasant flight There was an issue with the bag drop but I had some friendly assistance The plane left on time and the flight attendants were helpful and friendly The new plane was clean and comfortable A small snack was served which was fine on such a short flight I also appreciated the free beer

ANCFAIANC Economy Open Seating Check in was difficult The checkin agent did not understand how to read my ticket and almost seemed to blame me for the error Once on board however the flight attendants both on the outbound and return were very nice especially on the return flight a definite sense of humor Era offers low fares between Anchorage and Fairbanks and I will be flying with them again Its also nice not to have to go to security when flying on the smaller planes

Great experience Early check in possible and done quickly staff super friendly Security fast and lets you go faster with a baby Nice tax free zone that you can actually enjoy as the check in and security is done quickly At least two amazing playgrounds for children great cafes everything clean

We have been using this airport several times a year for the last ten years Over the years the facilities have progressed From a field for a car park to a proper hard standing area with security The terminal is up to scratch for a small airport generally very clean with all facilities We particularly like the short walk from the arrivals entrance through security to the gate Announcements are clear and there are plenty of arrivaldeparture screens We dont use cafes or shops in any airport but they look to be appropriate for the size of the airport Car hire and baggage reclaim very easy Plenty of taxis usually outside but can be a queue at peak times This is our favourite airport hate Alicante and Gatwick
Bar and restaurant staff appeared to be totally fed up and disinterested in their job Could do a lot better Rest of the airport was fine and very clean

Passed through Toronto City Centre Airport on a recent trip from Chicago to Quebec It is a small airport so very easy to navigate We were through Canadian immigration very promptly and back through security for our onward flight without fuss The departure lounge was very comfortable with plenty of seats available All the immigration and airport staff that we encountered were friendly and helpful Overall a great introduction to Canada and one of the best airports that I have been too

One of the easiest airports to access both inbound and outbound that we have ever experienced Staff on the information desk in Terminal were extremely pleasant and helpful when we asked for assistance Public areas very clean and well kept Plenty of seating for passengers Great food outlets and some interesting local shops as well A real treat to travel through this southern California airport

Vancouver to Honolulu via Ottawa We had the pleasure of flying Omni after a very long delayed missed connection flight and they went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and comfortable The higher level of service is very evident in the crews demeanor and professionalism Penny and Ilya were particularly helpful and went out of their way to make our flight memorable Thank you to the entire team

Quite a small airport compared to the Dubai or Abu Dhabi International Airports Only half a dozen or airlines serve this airport On arrival myself and wife senior citizens were treated with compassion and helped by the airport customs and immigration staff No difficulties faced by us we found the airport quite peaceful neat and tidy I wish more flights were available to and from this Airport in UAE Travel to city center of Al Ain a charming city in the midst of the Arabian desert was also a pleasant experience with hardly any traffic problems

I flew from Kerry to go to Alicante ALC and back Parking is not far from the terminal When you go in the door the toilets cafe and checkin area are very close Internet was fast and easy to connect to Toilets were clean enough The caf has good food and there are two vending machines before you go into departures It is a short walk to departures and security is not that long There is two boarding gates with a small gift shop Boarding went through very quick and the flight arrived minutes early We arrived back after ten days and we were early again which was great There is only one baggage belt and it can get very crowded Very satisfied with the airport and the experience

Airport is clean has good shops great seating area and has clear signs However the thing that annoyed me the most was the fact that in the entire terminal you could literally i counted just find a total of five power outlets that should really be something to be improved so watch out for that

I love Air North and use them whenever its convenient between Kelowna and Vancouver Very reasonable fares which includes two checked bags and advance seat selection for Always on time friendly staff and I love the vintage s Its like what flying was like decades ago much nicer and more relaxed

Excellent airport Arrived at am on the BA London flight First time visit to India so I stopped off at the biometric finger print machine queued for minutes and completed he task in mins Went to border control There is a separate queue for business class travellers and they checked my boarding pass I could have done the finger prints here The agent wanted to see my eVisa print out Kind of defeats the object of have an eVisa But processed and passport stamped and quickly through By the time I arrived at the baggage claim my luggage had already arrived I then exited to meet my pre booked driver Took about mins from getting off the plane to getting into the car Departure had to get a ticket check before entering the terminal I have checked in online but mobile boarding pass not available Had to show the eTicket on my phone to get into the terminal I also had a print out of the itinerary Check in business class for BA flight to London only agent so about mins spent Dedicated business security lane was reasonably efficient Went to the Encalm business lounge to find a queue but this was the Priority pass queue the agent called business and first class travellers to the front I was then redirected to another lounge Enclam Prive I dont know what the differences are but I needed an airline invite to get in Nice big lounge with a huge choice of food some cooked to order Efficient boarding in groups and policed very well Overall a great airport experience

I just booked through this airport in October on my way to Australia It was such a dream no queues friendly efficient staff Luggage scanned without having to remove Ipad small bottles etc It must be one of the better airports in the EU

We travelled through Monastir Airport and found it to be pretty good for a small airport The queues coming in were fairly smooth and on the way out of the country everything went smoothly as well Facilities are perhaps a little limited but its only a small airport comparatively and at least it was clean

Matecaa to Enrique Olaya Herrera Medellin with Easyfly The flight was a little delayed but not too much They have a nice staff the flight was very quiet and comfortable They bring a little catering but the flight just takes minutes so its a really nice detail the plane was clean the price is very atractive I have the best opinion about this airline

The Airport is actually very nice and there are many comfy sofa beds It has a good amount of shops and places to eat and it has a clean and comfy atmosphere The airline Gulf Air was a nightmare but the airport was very good Recommended to transit through

Very pleasant airline Friendly and helpful crew Reasonable prices for food and drinks on board There was limited choice but that is ok on a hour flight This was the second time I flew with SmartLynx We had a nice flight and I would fly again with this airline

Went to OVD on a day trip from BCN in mid June to visit family in nearby Castrillon I seen the airport evolve for the last thirty years into a very nice compact and efficient operation Everything is laid out in a logical sequence You arrive into a small checkin area as there are still less than a half dozen or so carriers that use it go through a quick and orderly screening area and up to the gates There are various shops to include a regional Asturias gift shop stores transportation outlets and the such Public areas are clean and not crowded by any means There is the typical cafe with lots of room and reasonable pricing We found taxis right outside the terminal along with two bays for ALSA busses running to both Oviedo and Gijon Be advised that the trip to the provincial cities of Oviedo Gijon and Aviles all take about a half hour or so to get to All in all a very nice userfriendly airport

Small simple and clean everything you want in an airport Love coming home to this beautiful airport Pros extremely clean efficient great signage short wait times never any traffic to and from and never any plane traffic Cons no lounges not a lot of shopping very limited food choices things close early a bit far outside city centre parking can be pricey

I was recently on a short hop from Sevastopol to Kiev Airport checkin was fast and polite Plane was pretty old Embraer with tight legroom Catering consisted of tea coffee water all looked and smelled uninspiring The crew was young and nice Ticket price was a good deal Flight was on time Ok for min flight

Excellent flights from Gran Canaria to Tenerife North with this super regional airline Well maintained clean aircraft both ways Short flights of around mins with friendly cabin crew Newspapers brought round before take off During the flight served glass of water with a chocolate biscuit followed by a sweet Just enough time to collect everything in before landing Check in easy with no queing at both LPA and TFN Luggage delivered on belt within mins of entering baggage reclaimat both airports Thank you Binter Canarias for excellent service

Brasilia airport is probably the best Brazilian airport The shoppingeating area is good and with a great variety The information desk is good and people friendly not to mention the architecture that is beautiful The bad things about the airport are Transportation Buses not as frequent as they should be No metro or train Boarding area once you pass Security the airport is too crowded and not having the same amenities as the preboarding area make the journey less comfortable Too small for the traffic it has Drop offPick Up passengers There is a lack of enforcing the laws and people park in the drop off areas making it difficult to approach sometimes

I wanted to fly by Air NZ After finding out the Perth route was now going to be flying with WAMOS Air I researched I nearly canceled with all the negative star reviews Wamos Air is the best airline I have ever flown service was fantastic and the seats comfortable Everyone was given a blanket and pillow the food good for airline food You could get extra drinks and food if wanted and periodically they would come around with water On return to Perth it was the same The plane was not dated The lady next to me on returning was quite ill and the cabin crew couldnt do enough for her They even reseated me so I wouldnt be concerned and they could access that traveller in case of added complications

Loved it Takes no more than minutes from entering to get to the gate When you depart minutes It was like heaven compared to Toronto where there are long lines lots of computers and where it takes so long to get to the gate and where you dread the lineups getting off the plane for the same reason It is convenient it is quick clean and has a Tim Hortons

Fantastic Service Booked from Australia for Joburg to Maun flight Kept great communications for any changes and even transferred me on a SA flight no extra charge for my KasaneJoburg leg when I explained about connection time with my Qantas flight due to schedule changes without having to be asked and emailed me back a new booking Great service nice snack on a short leg clean modern plane on time friendly ground staff I hear things might have been different a few years back but certainly my experience was very good and would fly with them again

On arrival the airport was very clean There was water fountains and music It was very peaceful When we departed checkin was so easy and security was simple There were lots of shops and dutyfree Overall One of the best airports in the world

Great medium sized airport Travel fairly frequent from Hannover mainly from Terminal B to the UK The three terminals are very similar Good city centre connection with SBahn Fast checkin to gate usually same for arrival to out of door

This airport has undergone a transition from ugly duckling to something of a beautiful swan Spacious beautifully furnished comfortable are just some of the words that come to mind There is plenty of signage and even passengers on discount airlines are treated as if they are appreciated Although it doesnt have a butterfly garden I would compare this in ambiance to Singapore Changi on a much smaller scale of course Burmese charm is everywhere The CIP lounges are spacious well stocked well staffed and offer a good selection of local and international snacks I wish every airport in Asia was more like this one

Our flight from Auckland was late leaving due to bad weather We arrived at the REX counter in Melbourne flustered and tired The check in for baggage had just closed but Thomas came to our rescue He checked if our baggage could still be checked in escorted us through security down to the REX gate arriving with minutes to spare before the flight was called With out Thomas we would never have made it he went over and beyond to ensure we were able to make the flight Thomas is a credit to himself and REX The cabin crew had no idea we were weary travellers We were greeted warmly and genuinely thankful to have made the flight for home To the REX staff thank you This is why we always fly REX

This airport is small so whilst access is good facilities are very limited Airside there are only vending machine so if you want anything to eat or drink best use the bar Landside Do not carry tins eg Duck Confit Pate etc that are greater than g in hand luggage they will be confiscated at security

Des Moines KDSM is an all round great airport It is a very easy airport to navigate in and it doesnt take long to get through security at all It always seems to be clean and free wifi is always a plus While there seems to be a lack of shopping and food choices there are a few that all seem to be good places of business Terminal seating is in the process of being expanded as it doesnt hold the demand all of the time Its a great airport to depart and arrive to It isnt very big but will get you where you need to go

We love flying with Yeti airlines Theyre always super fast friendly very professional and even taking our dog with us was no issue at all and very easy Whenever they can they put us on an earlier flight which is very convenient Yeti Airlines is our goto airline a whenever we travel between Pokhara and Kathmandu back and forth

Shanghai to Barcelona via Tehran with Mahan Air business class round trip The ground service is efficient and decent The aircraft was kept in very good condition and the seating is very comfortable Crew members are highly efficient helpful and friendly in all four segments Food and beverage is great with starter three main course choices and desert which is comparable to any international flights Menu is written clearly The airline provide everything they should for a business product even a limousine at PVG from gate to aircraft except entertainment all PTVs are switched off maybe sanctions Mahan Airs lounges in IKA is excellent with nice sofa Wifi connection and food selections Ticket price dollars which is in really great value Will fly them again

Multistop from Munich via Kiev to Istanbul Then back to Munich after some days of holiday in Kiev Perfect flight times all flights landing ahead schedule Great service on the ground and on board Relaxing lounges UIA highly recommended

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

Gatwick to St Petersburg I was slightly apprehensive about travelling with Rossiya Airlines but need not have been This was full flight from Gatwick to St Petersburg on an A The plane had seen better days but was clean When I checked in I asked for an aisle seat and was denied one Boarding was very quick and I soon found myself in a rather uncomfortable seat for the just over min flight The cabin crew were very nice people and efficient The service included a complimentary sandwich and drink which was appreciated I plan to visit Russia again in August and will gladly use this airline The friendly staff won me over Disembarkation was via a bus transfer to the main terminal

I was a little nervous to fly after reading some of these reviews but my ticket was already purchased so I went for it Best flying experience Ive ever experienced Both the Pendleton airport and Portland airport were easy to find and they both werent in the major airports so didnt have to deal with TSA or people Check in was simple and from check in to boarding was quick Take off and landing for both flights were great best Ive experienced and little to no turbulence Im wondering if the negative reviews were for flights taken during the months with crazy weather which would make sense as to why it would be scary so Ill probably stick to boutique air during the months with good weather My flight home got delayed a couple hours but it honestly wasnt a big deal and they called and texted hours prior to inform me Overall best experience and Ill definitely be utilizing boutique air more Definitely recommend

What a wonderful feeling entering the Bermuda airport Friendly thoughtful staff and the wonderful band playing Bermuda is Another World were quite the contrast to American and Canadian airport experiences My wife and I just returned from a wonderful stay in Bermuda if possible tell the band that their beautiful music is still in our heads a week later

I am convinced that anyone that has anything bad to say about Stansted is either paid delusional or a banker that hasnt got anything positive to say about anything Ive travelled to airports so not quite as many as some people but Ive been to enough to say that Stansted is bloody marvelous at what it does Its simple clean efficient has a beautiful single terminal building some of the fastest security queues Ive ever seen no matter how many people its trying to push through Stansted is quite simply operationally one of the best ever and Ive never had to wait more than minutes departing Even arrivals moves ridiculously fast and while sometimes you can wait in a queue that looks lengthy to enter the country it never takes that long The people working at Stansted know how to move Its an absolutely marvelous display and it always astounds me whenever I go Its a well signposted airport very easy to navigate the quiet area is fantastic loads of shops and food options My only MINOR criticism is that it can sometimes be difficult to find a place to sit down upstairs but other than that its absolutely a class airport

Gatwick to Denver I was placed on a Wamos flight by Norwegian and almost cancelled due to all the terrible reviews but I didnt find it that bad at all We brought our own movies to watch and our own food which I normally do on a flight anyway as I like healthy stuff Ive had worse legroom on other flights and the staff were more friendly and helpful than many others Ive known and I fly a lot The plane was pretty old but perfectly functional The staff were so great that I told them Id write a review because I felt that the pasting theyre getting online is unfair and makes us travellers look rather spoilt to be honest
