This was the busiest I had ever seen Sydney Airport but things ran smoothly the staff were very efficient getting everyone through security and was very impressed to how friendly the security staff were that is really appreciated I was also impressed when my flight with Air New Zealand was ready to board they called the Business class passengers first and policed it by checking everyones boarding pass which is good as one pays a lot more money for Business Class so should have the privilege When departing Auckland it wasnt policed hence so many more people were in the line An impressive airport overall
Francistown Johannesburg September Good short flight efficiently run with good crew On time and no problems

Corruption and extortion are alive and well at this airport Both myself and four colleagues in the following days were asked for our passports and then dollars to return them from officials at this airport It has been a while since this last happened to me in any country at any airport but this place stands out Who would want to visit this place for business or vacation Never again

This is a nice and modern airport at the moment they are expanding the airport so there is a lot of building going on but in the departure area you will not notice this very much The Airport has got free Wifi and a small restaurant with shop on the land side Airside you will find a small shop with prepacked sandwiches and hot dogs and other small stuff a small duty free shop is also around but not very cheap There is no Lounge to be found at the moment but after the expansion is completed there will be one available around May Checkin procedures are fast and the waiting area after checkin is fine with a view on the tarmac All in all a nice modern but small airport with expensive restaurants and shop

Munich to Bologna and Pisa to Munich both on an Embraer economy Both flights handled efficiently southbound on time northbound delayed by about mins on departure due to to late arrival of incoming flight there had been thick fog at MUC early that morning which had sent things adrift for much of the morning However support given to those with tight connections Modest inflight service snacks and drinks wine came in proper glasses Air Dolomiti worked okay for us

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

Just wish to say that the check in and wheelchair assistance at Malpensa was really excellent and one of the best that I have experienced as a recent wheelchair traveller Staff were very helpful and efficient The only issue that I would raise is the state of the toilets

Exceptional Service from Ground Crews I recently had an experience that despite starting off on the wrong foot turned into a testament to the incredible dedication of the airlines ground crew Unfortunately we mismanaged our time and ended up missing our flight It was a stressful situation for our family of four and we were worried about what would happen next However the ground crew went above and beyond to assist us They were understanding and reassuring immediately helping us to rebook our tickets What truly impressed us was their effort to ensure that we could sit together on our new flight The staff worked diligently and communicated openly throughout the process making a stressful situation much more manageable Thanks to the remarkable support from the team we were able to travel together without further issues I cant express enough gratitude for their exceptional service It truly made a difference in our travel experience Highly recommend this airline for their commitment to customer care

Went to Dubai for business with my wife and got a flight to Al Maktoum International DWC Brand new airport parts of it still in construction Much easier than DXB to go through has less shops though Not much variety for eating but enough for duty free Airport staff much more attentive that at DXB this to be expected though considering the traffic volume is much less than DXB Only downside is that it is far away from downtown Dubai if got business there I would give a high score as it is a brand new airport and facilities are improving all the time A pleasant experience overall

Flew into Alderney from Southampton A lovely little airport Very relaxed friendly staff and a good shop and cafe very good considering the airport is tiny Taxis waiting right outside the main entrance and it only takes about minutes if that to get from the aircraft to the terminal entrance Very good all round

As living in the north of The Netherlands Bremen airport is a good alternative for Amsterdam Recently flown from the new low cost Ryanair terminal Its basic clean and blue There is a multipurpose shop which sells everything from a to z at somewhat inflated prices and small coffee shop Seating is mostly in plastic chairs which you could find at your local dentist Reasonable but we had an early flight so it was not so crowded Would not like to be there when its get full There are also some paid internet terminals The airport is well situated from the city center and freeway from the parking garage you are within minutes in the main terminal building Bremen is still a great small airport but they need to get some other low cost airlines on board besides Ryanair

Flying Izmir to Ercan The International section is Very clean and modern Quick and efficient passenger service from checkin through passport control and all the way to boarding Its always a pleasure to use Izmir Adnan Menderes airport for arrivals and departures internationally The duty free shops are spacious and have many shopping options The toilets are clean and stocked I have no complaints always hasslefree flying out and through Izmir The WiFi is also a bonus very fast and user friendly to access

Most of the airport was hot Only felt moderately cool at the quiet area which wasnt quiet at all It was right next to noisy escalators and on top of an area where staff I assume they were staff would congregate and loudly converse The rest of the time I thought staff were loudly and the airport was nice enough Lots of restaurants and little shops although most closed at night I arrived and was in transit for hours Outlets everywhere and potable water available
A very nice small airport with all that is needed except a coffee shop if I remember correctly Access is easy and clear the terminal clean and there is free parking

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here

TallinnAmsterdam is a short flight but crew were nice helpful and were able to understand at least languages they helped my Dutch Grandmother who speaks no English Amenities not normally provided but because flight was near empty they gave out snacks plus complementary tea and coffee They also allowed us to sit in vacant seats which was nice In general a nice trip and much more than was expected for basically a regional airline

Airport was new and very nice Immigration friendly and welcoming Nice first impression on Egypt upon arrival Washroom need to be cleaned regularly though Other than that its a very nice airport for travellers to Alexandria

The cabin crew were amazing They really took control of the cabin and looked after all the passengers The thing Ive never seen is how they controlled the disembarking of the plane ensuring specific rows would get up in an orderly fashion Ive flown Kulula for over a decade and theyve really upped their game

GOTAYTGOT We choose this airline because it was a part of a charter trip We went on a seat A its was quite big It was as you expect in a economy class airplane not much legroom quite cramped The seats were quite nice but you will notice that they have been there for a while but it works fine The cabincrew are very friendly and nice The food onboard was okay You cant expect that much from an airline in the food section We thought we were going to get breakfast as we flew at in the morning Instead we got meatballs in a sauce which was really nice

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job

Good transport connection via BAB Moderate parkingrates close to the terminals CheckIn only minutes prior to departure Short distances More than daily flights major Star Alliance hubs MUC and FRA and direct flights to holiday destinations Daily lowcost flights to London STN Vienna Rome FMO is a good choice for travellers in northern NRW western Niedersachsen and eastern Holland who want to start their journeys business travel as welll as holiday travel relaxed and in a friendly atmosphere

I was surprised with the cleanliness and efficiency of the airport in Guayaquil Really modern and easy to navigate I liked the zen garden at the domestic arrivals which really was a nice touch Toilets were clean Passport control very organised and staff are polite also duty free staff were very helpful Nice WiFi and view of the runway watching planes goes by Happy using it

Basically a well designed terminal that requires upgrading Immigration and visa on arrival procedures are quick as foreign passport holders go to separate counters both for arrival and departure Luggage delivery is fast but then you will have to queue for at least minutes as every piece of luggage has to go through the only screening machine in the customs hall No taxi or airport shuttle is available and you will have to rely on touts or on military staff very friendly to help you find a vehicle to take you to town unless you have prearranged transport with your hotel Departure hall is not airconditionned and was infested by mosquitoes out of duty free shops were closed and the single airline lounge has been closed for a long time One positive point all areas including toilets are kept very clean

The toilets are the cleanest I have seen Im years The customs was quick and efficient I travel every year to Curaao and was a pleasure to see that they are much better than Schiphol Las Americas American airports European airports

This ugly block is straight out of Stalins era although a new terminal is going up alongside The old one is tatty Two gates A B A few little shops a bar and no smoking inside VIPs are called earlier than other travellers and in my case to a different gate Keep your eyes peeled I tried my Skyteam Platinum card on the VIP gate and it worked The VIP lounge plumbs new depths Seedy styling and furniture with a peeling linoleum floor and no smoking there either And you have to pay for everything even a coffee but the range of food and drink is quite reasonable Still we did get our own minibus to the aircraft and we got on first To be fair the folks around the place are friendly enough

All flights were on time and comfortable Cabin crew were friendly and welcoming On board snacks to buy were good value Seat pitch good average Last year we few with this company from Madrid to Malta and return Both flights very good

Originally booked through Canaryfly Upon arrival at airport we saw that our flight was cancelled We didnt receive any notice but it turned out very smooth as we were already booked on a Binter flight at the original time To us it seemed as this happens frequently and they have a good system in place The flight was enjoyable and the cabin crew did a very good job

Hong Hong to Budapest via Shanghai Flew on A on HKG to Shanghai while in a newer B on the long haul to Budapest China Eastern marketed flights The long haul leg was flown by their daughter company Shanghai Airlines to Budapest Amazing experience pure adventure Bought this ticket some months earlier for the high season to Europe as a huge bargain for USD including x kg of luggage which is welcomed near Xmas It costed me in addition positioning and depositioning flights to which I volunteered as I needed the extra miles for my elite status However I was notified months before travel by my online travel agent Travelgenio that the return flight from Budapest was preponed by hour Then I was forced to change as I would not be able to arrive in time for the new departure I then decided to change plans completely and celebrate New Year in Budapest instead of Vietnam Thus I postponed my return travel from Budapest by days This was done by emails to the Travel Agent no response and then phone calls to Ch Eastern in Brisbane and Shanghai Eventually it went smoothly and I was changed to my wish without added costs apart from changing onward flights beyond Hong Kong with another airline That even allowed me to do another cheap detour to Hanoi on my way back to Hue The homepages of China Eastern and Shanghai are difficult to penetrate and to book or change bookings from Unless one has a Chinese telephone number However days before departure I could access seating and chose freely my favourite seats even got of legs in exit seat However one cannot access the entire booking unless registered with CEs flyer program in which I am not interested Apart from that it was a good adventure a complicated travel where everything could have gone wrong but all went smooth Arrived in Hongkong early and was able to checkin hours before departure as the airline have many departures daily No queues at the checkin and the ground staff were good and answered questions though fearing speaking English Two BPs issued immediately Flying HKGPVG is considered as international flights though it could be considered as domestic That give the advantage of not leaving transit while leaving HKG and passing PVG First flight was on an aged A Extremely controlled and organised priority boarding at gate where all business and elite flyers were boarding entirely before the remaining passengers Onboard newspapers and channels of music were offered bring own headset Shared monitors showed some educational movies Food was limited to a tidy pack of biscuits Drinks were unlimited water tea coffee beers but only for hour out of the hour long flight during ascend and descend all services were closed down until Minutes after kickoff and again Minutes before landing That leaves passengers with very limited time of service FAs were fine The second flight were by Shanghai Airlines Boeing It was a very positive surprise and was faultless Modern aircraft good food and service hot meals offered at dinner and then again at breakfast Frequent drink rounds Button calls answered quickly and needs were addressed instantly Individual IFE on touchscreen monitors was very easy and quick to operate with a good number of Western and English translated movies Toilets clean Both flights took off earlier than scheduled

Dulles Airport is located in Virginia and bit far from Washington DC Very large and wellmaintained airport very clean Few sitting places Immigration process takes long time Boarding bridge works as bus to the airport terminal Taxi and bus services are there

A small pleasant and friendly airport All the staff are really nice and now even the younger staff at security are very friendly which wasnt typical before the pandemic The procedures are very fast However during peak times there is absolutely not enough space around the caf and dutyfree shops in the Schengen section even after the recent terminal upgrade I really miss the newspaper stand in this area I would especially like to praise the staff at Little Slovenia in the NonSchengen section Its truly a small oasis of kindness and wellbeing

Saint Marie to Antananarivo What an absolute pleasure flying with this new airline Madagasikara Airways Finally competition to Air Madagascar with prices half the price of the national airline reliable ontime departure convenient schedules and complimentary drink and snacks onboard with an extremely friendly cabin attendant who made announcements in languages Planes are serviced in South Africa Sad to see that despite all this the plane was only half full hopefully more will hear of it as it really deserves to succeed

Copenhagen to Sorvagur return Wonderful experience many smiles by service team multiple drink refills decent inflight entertainment via own device and very smooth flight into Faroer An excellent value for money and perhaps one of the last remaining airlines in Europe that treats customers as many did in the past I got the impression that the team liked their job and were happy to welcome everyone on board We preordered delicious snacks and very comfortable seats Flights were on time and a breeze a perfect start into the vacation and back home

Lives up to its name no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins of flight delayed and no aircon but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

I flew China Airlines from Singapore to Vancouver on the st June by Premier Economy The flight was not very full but dep from Singapore again delayed by minutes Due to this the Airline allows another extra minutes in its schedule We landed at Taipei minutes late only after a wait of hrs took off for Vancouver on the second leg of my journey This flight was unfortunately delayed by minutes at Taipei due to baggage loading issues etc We landed at Vancouver minutes late as a result of the late take off The flight however was very smooth comfortable Cabin Crew was very good cleaned the toilets every hrs so they remained spic span were well stocked Entertainment system was very good though on SingaporeTaipei sector my Screen had no sound I had to change my Seat The food I always eat on flights is AVML Indian Veg Meal this varied in quality SingaporeTaipei meal was very good though it lacked Indian Bread bun provided No Plain Yoghurt I would rate it On the Taipei Vancouver Sector the Dinner was below par only the fine quality basmati rice north indian tasting veg fruits was edibleI would rate this only The breakfast second meal was better as they provided Parotta with Indian cauliflower potato curry cabbage curryboth tasty Again fruits were provided Banana should have been given I would rate this meal No Plain Yoghurt an essential part of every Indian Veg meal was provided Fortunately I always carry my own Yoghurt Indian Pickle packets so I could repair the meals enjoy them I hope China Airlines pays attention to my comments modifies their AVML meals to include more Yoghurt Indian breads in future The Seat was very comfortable with seating in Premier Economy Baggage was well handled no damages was quickly discharged at Vancouver Airport Overall view of China Airlines the Flight can be described as relaxed comfortable with good service ambience A last word on the A Aircraft which in my view is excellent for such a long flight smooth stable very spacious I will continue to fly by China Airlines in my future flights to Asia

Mainly domestic airport serving the Brazilian side of Iguassu Falls Busy airport with a air bridges and some remote stands Shopping opportunities as you walk from the gate to Baggage Reclaim Baggage Reclaim is on the ground level and has main baggage carousels Domestic arrival so no Customs or Passport Checks Small and busy Arrivals area with parking directly opposite Small but efficient airport

Cabin was clean Personal screen was big enough and a lot of entertainment programs were available Seat was very comfortable My personal area was spacious Tullys Coffee was offered with tasty chocolate Flight attendants provided quick and responsive service Everything was excellent

Berlin to Moscow You have to pay for anything apart from your personal item That includes your carryon luggage Longest queue at checkin I have seen in years as a result of everybody having to pay for carryon or luggage that was more than kg Aircraft are new and made a good impression Cabin crew young goodlooking and charmingly helpless Seat do not recline

Its always very relaxing to fly from to Nuremberg Its a really small airport but everything works so easy and uncomplicated You can get there easily by train a subway station is directly in front of the entrance or by car you can park just min walk away checkin is very fast and boarding too There is no shopping and not that many food options but when you just want to get relaxed and easy from A to B its perfect And the staff are nice too even the security staff is always goodhumored More airlines should use this airport

A very nice airy terminal that seems modern enough Free WIFI and free parking Everything within walking distance Most people travel domestic to Copenhagen but a rising number of international routes eg AALAMS makes for a lot of possibilities Checkin is very quick and so is Security All in all a nice experience
Hanoi to Hong Kong There are new business class seats on the plane very pleasant and comfortable The food is good the choice is standard Stewardesses good and pleasant service

This airport is well organized and easy to navigate its become one of my favorite airports in the world On this trip JFKSFOTPE I flew into and also left from Terminal One recently renovated attractive and spacious It also contains quite a few spaces for relaxation plus many restaurants and shops On arrival my bag arrived before I did On departure I checked in at the Interational Terminal which is connected to Terminal One Going through security at International was fast and easy The only negative was that several of the restaurants in Terminal One were closed in the evening

The improvements I mentioned in were completed on schedule and have given this airport a new and modern feel Unfortunately the upper level is no longer a viewing deck area However a new restaurant with a view of the airfield was installed on the ground floor Facilities are top class considering the size of the airport A brand new baggage retrieval area was added to the airport The layout of the airport works well Staff are still just as friendly

I fly through San Javier about times a year and generally it works fine My only complaint is the boarding process Because there are no seperate gate lounges people queue in the departure hall All pretty chaotic especially if one has paid for priority boarding as it means fighting through crowds to get to the front and in the process putting up with mindless comments from people who dont seem to understand the concept of priority boarding The ground staff do nothing to help

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen
Despite the poor reviews I kind of had to use Safi on the Dubai to Kabul route I was pleasantly surprised that we got reasonably new As with normal leg room and the planes were dead on time

Vintage airport that has been updated and serves lots of people on domestic flights The energy level is high and the view of the runways and operating area is excellent Fun place to arrive or depart with plenty to see and no end to the peoplewatching opportunities Pretty efficient as well
We took flight from Kathmandu to Delhi The aircraft was Airbus Flight was quite good and on time Food that was given during flight was good and well presented cabin crew was so friendly and humble

Mumbai to Paris Excellent and clean Aircraft A Awesome Cabin service and cabin crew Amazing food and drinks Clean and comfortable business class seats even though they are not lie flat but comfortable sleep at an angle The highlight is excellent on board crew who took care of guests in an excellent manner Excellent AudioVideo system clean and neat restrooms I would like to say the most affordable business class product for a very quality product Would recommend all the way

My wife and I flew from Buenos Aires to Miami this January The airplanes appeared to be old with no entertainment flat panels no earphone outlets and no USB charging outlets The seats were old fashion leather wide and comfortable with spacious leg rooms and reclineable backward to almost degrees all of these made the flights very comfortable Meals served were rather good with frequent service of beverages of limited types free wine was included with meals Our experience was far better than most reviewers whose reviews we read

PBHCCU CCUPBH Y class Check in staff at Paro very helpful friendly smiling Cabin crew similarly accommodating and friendly Clean cabin decent space for Y class Light refreshments and sandwiches veg or nonveg served on this short minute segment Every flight has been spot on time or slightly early Good announcements from cockpit to point out Himalayan peaks when near Paro Competitive prices A good alternative inout of Bhutan from Drukair
It is not big The efficiency of checkin and security checks is high Signposts are clear The WiFi connection is stable The ambience is clean and not crowded

Nice atmosphere friendly staff and excellent hospitality The staff was courteous and welcoming the food was good and hot and there are drinks to choose from The lounges are good the service provided was great and checking in is simple Early landings and timely flights

The gate agents are great but they might have the most inefficient TSA security checkpoint Ive ever witnessed It took them around minutes to scan bags and only one was flagged out of the They seem to be the only airport where the analogic machines have actually made the security checkpoint slower which is wild considering the technology of those things Everywhere else seems to have competent people to run them

This airline is world class and knows how to treat its customers with professionalism and respect Hands down the best airline Ive traveled with and Ive traveled a lot If their standards remain top notch Ill be a customer for life
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

Small Domestic Terminal in Male Fast and efficient no Food or Drink facilities Quick boarding by bus New ATR with comfortable seat pitch Short Minute flight very friendly Maldivian Crew Water Juice and Fruits offered Smooth Landing in Dhaalu Bags delivred in minutes Perfect short and comfortable flight

A very small airport ours was the only plane there when we landed so visa immigration and luggage was quick though I doubt if they could manage with more than one plane at once Departure check in quick and efficient The airport is clean with a number of duty free shops bit tacky

Brussels to Antalya Positively surprised okay we have been on a more recent airplane but it was certainly ok The children were well taken care of and the staff were very friendly Of course there is always one grumpy one which was also the case during our flights Closing off the curtain right in front of you while you want to bring your children to the toilet without any apologies not very polite The words just a second madam would already have been perfect Besides this we had nice flights

Stansted to Ercan via Istanbul I booked my flight then checked reviews most of which hadnt been complimentary My experience of flying with Atlasglobal for the first time was entirely positive Unlike most other budget airlines I had kg baggage allowance and basic food and drinks were served on each leg of my journey at no additional cost One flight attendant in particular deserved a special mention on the Istanbul to Stansted leg of my trip from Ercan on Sunday morning she was genuinely helpful and very friendly She literally greeted everyone getting on and departing the plane with a sincere nice smile

Flew Amsterdam to Belfast International on Easyjet EZY and I found the overall experience to be very good There was a slight delay in take off due to ATC however not a a major issue The onboard cabin crew lead by Clark were excellent and very customer oriented Great flight on Easyjet

Stockholm Bromma to Malm Sturup Very friendly cabin crew and good service This is the only airline in Sweden that serve free meals during domestic flights The plane were clean and the seats were of standard model I will fly with Malm Aviation whenever I go to Stockholm again Best domestic airline so far

The staff are friendly and its clean and offers a good service most of the time I do have two constructive comments however I wish you would put your flights on sale way in advance Eg I want to book for next summer now but have been told to wait until the end of the year This is not good for their own business as most people want to book summer vacations for next year now and if they are not on sale people will go to other countries like the Canary Islands etc and this is a shame I had booked for trip returning to Dublin via LGW on th November and bought flight from Dublin on Ryanair now told change to Heathrow New flight to Dublin from LHR required Additional expense for people using you to route home

TUNTIP Checkin at Tunis was efficient and staff generally friendly Boarding at the gate was chaotic While on the runway the plastic emergency exit covering came off The pilot came and put it back on Plane then proceeded with takeoff The food was standard and staff friendliness on board ok although only with limited English skills Onboard announcements were in Arabic only The interior was worn emergency cards in seat pockets were still from the former owner of the plane a defunct French airline

I traveled into and out of Cardiff Airport in June I found the airport to be quite user friendly and compared to some of the reports Ive read a pleasant surprise A couple of negatives the one pound coins needed for the baggage trolleys seems rather tight and petty Although its close to Cardiff and the M it isnt easy to get to and from unless you have a car Even in a car there seem endless roundabouts and traffic lights to get through Check in was fine I arrived in plenty of time The security on departure seems over zealous compared to say Heathrow and would if the Airport were busier lead to very long queues The shopping was okay toilets were adequate seating in the new departure lounge was fine I didnt try the food outlets or WiFi As I said at the start not an amazing airport but it did the job it is after all a small regional airport

Airport has a weird system for departure You have to go to a security check point outside the airport to be patted down manually by security guards while your vehicle luggage is sniffed by gaurd dogs Then you are dropped off at a terminal for security check again this time through electronic devices where you get a special colored sticker on your luggage Afterwards you proceed to a shuttle bus carry your own luggage that will take you to another terminal about a minute drive where temperatures reach degrees Celsius in the summer At the nd terminal a security check is done to ensure you have been security checked at the previous terminal Now some of this can be avoided if you have a special VIP pass that skips step And a VVIP that skips all steps The check in counters are ok about of them run by Dubais DNata Immigration is slow and queues are long Duty Free is small with tobacco chocolates and alcohol available One coffee shop available behind Duty Free After passing immigration but before your gate you pass through another security check point remove your shoes belts etc Plenty of seating at the gates plus one coffee shop although AC is never working in the summer and no wifi connection through out the airport Staff are all generally friendly

AMSAAL and quite satisfied with this regional airport Only a few flights per day so baggage reclaim understandably very quick Bus line connects with downtown Aalborg every minutes weekdays but only hourly during the weekend travel time is mins and costs DKK Checkin efficient and hasslefree using selfservice kiosks Free Internet computers are available landside a nice touch Security staff very friendly Boarding area is rather cramped with limited seating do not go airside too early

Bangalore to Hyderabad My first time with Air Costa they been operating as a regional airline India for years A great experience the legroom was really good seats comfortable and the aircraft very new Its low cost so besides a glass of water it costs But given the flight time of little over an hour thats no problem The range of food and beverages looked good though The flight was mins late the only downside
Not as big as Airports in Beijing and Shanghai that it is hard to navigate It is very efficiently run and very clean It is the best midsize international airport in China

Ive seen many negative reviews about Sri Lankan airlines However my trip was so good Even though it was a hour flight they provided drinks and a snack which doesnt happen in North America The service was professional too I hope they will grow

Great airport for small aircraft Twin OtterCessna used primarily for safari transfers Courteous and friendly staffsecurity as well as satisfactory washrooms and a nice snack bar Wilson airport is a welcome change from the chaos of Jomo Kenyatta Note due to its small size there is no souvenir or duty free shopping

Yesterday I had a pleasant experience from Horizon two airline employees on the Horizon air turboprop that I flew from Missoula to Seatac I had a very short connection time to board an Alaska air flight to Charleston SC I flew this same itinerary MSO to SeaTac to CHS last year and because of airport construction and a long distance between two terminals I nearly missed my flight With this in mind I told the flight attendant named Kyle that I would need someone to help me get to the right terminal in time to make the flight I was quite anxious about it Kyle told me that the first officer agreed to escort me to the terminal as she had a three hour layover She not only made a smooth and soft landing with the plane but she also walked with me all the way to the plane I was to board Please let first officer Emilee know that she went above and beyond her job description She is a lovely person and goes out of her way to increase her customers comfort level I consider it a blessing to have walked beside first officer Emilee
LuganoAgno is a little airport maybe the smallest in Switzerland but I think its the most efficient Its commercial says Youll be in the air in minutes and its the truth I think its a great airport

Brasilia airport is clean and always improving the facilities The architecture is uptodate The airport is well located and you can reach it by bus but no train or subway It has an good commercial area close to the gates The airport facilities are in good condition and are well maintained
Airport is quite small and toilets are not so clean Not much to do while waiting for your flight but for a short wait the experience is not that bad

Big enough to serve all of your needs yet small enough and easy enough to get in and out of What a contrast when compared to Kansas City and Atlanta where my journey originated They have a childrens play area great local restaurants beers coffee etc It is about the same airfare to fly into Milwaukee often times as it is to fly into Chicago with a lot less hassle

Travelled twice fromto Joburg Very small airport used mainly and maybe only to reach Okawango Delta A couple of flight per day to South Africa and Gaborone twice a week to Namibia However it is usually quite busy because all small airplanes leaves from here to all airstrips in Okawango Security control also for internal flights with these small planes One gate you walk to the airplane There are no facilities inside only one toilet and no food and shops one checkin desk that open hours before flight but the queue is reasonable It is a safe airport quite clean but not the place where youd like to spend more time than necessary Nice shop and honest food just in front of the airport

Flight TF Gothenburg Stockholm Bromma Attentive professional FAs comfortable seats papers for free good in flight magazine on time clean plane smooth boarding and disembarkation clear safety announcements good sound system Best of all a small meal for free with coffeeteasoda and a chocolate candy

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in

Excellent small airport clean spacious good restaurant airline lounges collectively available to a great many airlines Arrival was to jetway Departure was by bus to plane from gate E the gates uses buses to go to aircraft The departure flight needed deicing since the aircraft was not parked at a gate it could be deiced in place before taxiing Frequent reliable bus service tofrom city Security personnel on departure efficient and courteous Time in security line minutes
The airport is very small however the staff provided a very good service We went through the airport very quickly

I took KE from HKG to ICN in July As I have already known that it was a top airline I had high expectations on it The ground service was very good The seat was quite wide and the cabin crew were very polite The food was average but not many movies to watch Although it was delayed for two hours I think the whole experience is worth the price

As with many small airports travelling to and from Altenburg is a pleasure The terminal is about as big as a DriveThrough burger restaurant and there is free parking within m of the building This airport is an excellent option for passengers travelling to or from the southern part of the former East Germany or to the north of Bavaria I live in Bamberg and the drive is much shorter and more pleasant than to the next nearest Ryanair airport at Frankfurt Hahn On the downside if you arrive early the Duty Free shop is very small and the restaurant is basic but the staff are friendly

Second busiest airport in Finland after Helsinki now really quiet thanks to covid Terminal is reasonably big and has jet bridges so you dont need to go outside while boarding unless its a small turboprop like we had which cannot use jet bridges There are couple of shops a bar and a cafe and just like most other airports in Finland there are rocking chairs where to relax and even a piano anyone can play Checkin security and baggage claim went smoothly and fast since there were only a few passengers Airport is well connected to the city by buses and taxi

arrivals and one departure Arrival is one part and departure is the other Super efficient clean and pleasant Taxis out front Departure area maybe could use more seating Interesting there was a ping pong table there and it was quite popular It has a relaxing feel about it Probably one of the nicest airports anywhere Arrival has a store where you can buy a bus card and load it for say or days travel

BRUJNBBRU with a stopover in Tripoli There were some troubles with the inflight entertainment On our way to JNB there were not enough headsets so we couldnt use the inflight entertainment On our way back from JNB to Tripoli the inflight entertainment in our part of the plane didnt work at all The food was okay and the cabin crew friendly Its definitely value for money but there are some things to improve

TIPATH A very comfortable flight on leather seats on new CRJ Breakfast well served with a generous portion Service went smoothly and efficiently crew were English speaking Plane interior clean Flight left on time and seemingly no worries about cent for cent baggage weight checking All in all a very pleasant experience

Malm to Stockholm I rebooked on Malm Aviation due to SAS strike in Sweden What a sharp contrast to SAS Checkin was painless using the selfservice machines Flight was operated by an Avro RJ with comfortable seats and sufficient legroom Cabin crew was efficient and smiling But the nicest touch was the free snack on board tasty roast beef sandwich orange juice coffeetea I was rather impressed by the cabin service on this hourflight The only negative point is the free seating policy as usual it resulted in a freeforall at boarding Malm Aviation is a very nice niche airline and I would strongly recommend it

Still a well organized airport We use the new international section Clean and simple to use Good staff security and customs Just expect that more international flights will be available soon from Qubec

I recently flew with Swiss Air on the Bucharest to Zurich route in an Airbus A Despite the overall comfort of the aircraft and the friendliness of the cabin crew the cabin temperature was much too low and could not be adjusted despite our requests The crew was kind and suggested we wear warmer clothes assuring us that the situation would improve over time Unfortunately the temperature remained consistently low throughout the flight making the journey less comfortable than we would have liked Nevertheless the aircraft was modern and clean and the staff provided prompt and friendly service If it werent for the temperature issue I would have had a very pleasant experience If the temperature cannot be adjusted immediately the company could provide passengers with additional blankets to offer them thermal comfort Overall my flight experience with Swiss Air was good but the temperature issue left a negative impression

Flew them on the Frankfurt Sarajevo trip on board their B I found the airline staff professional and friendly which cant be said about the customs at SJJ airport most of whom looked downright angry and like they hate their job The BH airlines crew were great and boarding was quick and breeze The flight arrived a few minutes early and I found the cabin fairly modern and clean

Manchester Tripoli Late leaving Manchester due out at and eventually left at around pm Smallish plane two seats either side of the aisle but hardly anyone on board so plenty of room Plane was new and the experience was fine cabin crew were helpful and friendly and food was good No video screens or music so take your own or a book Will be using this route again

nd largest airport in Philippines has terminals T is for international flights Checkin Level has main banks of Checkin counters AD at the back is the Departures area firstly Passport Control with manned counters and then Security Scanning both of which were quickly achieved Main Departures has the usual array of shops and duty free shops and cafes Some views of the gates and airfield There is lounge which covers most of the carriers premium customers its tired but has a reasonable selection of food on offer and seats with view of the apron Airport busy but did not feel overcrowded
Excellent flight Water served during the flight Landed ahead of schedule staff was polite and friendly

Recently flew to and from Roissy CDG to Biarritz International in the Basque country in south west France for the first time The airport itself is small but there is a good bus service which will take you into the city centre pretty quickly On arrival on the HRS AF flight from CDG this flight seemed to coincide with a number of other flights from the UK which made the baggage arrivals area chaotic In addition the toilet facilities landside need some upgrading and definitely could do with the cleaners visiting there on a more frequent basis especially midafternoon which seems to be the peak time for the airport The rubbish bin in the gents toilet was overflowing when I was there which left a poor initial impression The airport does have an excellent tourism booth with very helpful staff however In addition from the airport one can get onto the nearby motorway very quickly and the care hire agencies also had very helpful staff at the airport especially Europcar On departing Biarritz back to Paris however I discovered that the departures area has only one very small cafe so passengers may not want to enter this area too quickly as the wait could be long and somewhat boring In summary the airport is convenient but it falls well short of the new fresher and modern design of nearby Pau airport which is excellent
Bar and restaurant staff appeared to be totally fed up and disinterested in their job Could do a lot better Rest of the airport was fine and very clean

A very new airport with few flights Lots of parking and an outdoor cafe Checkin easy because it is not very busy once past security the gate area is small but with plenty of seats Duty free is expensive priced in US costa coffee pizza ice creams and a cafe provide more food than at many airports Toilets are clean Free WIFI is good and fast Buses to the planes no airbridges at all Very good for an Egyptian airport

Flew to FLL days before Christmas The roadway into the airport and the terminal were beautifully decorated for the season For preholiday travel the terminal was busy but not at all crowded There was plenty as seating available as well as plentiful dining options from sit down restaurants to fast food to choose from The terminal is bright and very spacious with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield Even though it was night time one could look out across the well lit airfield and see planes taxing and taking off Going through security was a breeze with TSA Pre clearance

Air New Zealand short haul is brilliant The crew service was brilliant There was also a quiz on the plane for the whole flight Very quick flight time after the plane was late coming in from the previous destination Brilliant quick flight

The ground staff in Puerto Princesa Airport and air crew of flight Z were so kind and understanding I have traveled via AirAsia Philippines times and I havent encountered any problems with them I always find their crew friendly The online booking is easier to navigate and payment process is smooth compared to the trouble I experienced with the other local airline

We travelled to Dubrovnik out of season so unsure what it would be like during the summer season when it is significantly busier What we did experience was a very clean modern stateoftheart airport that has been built and designed to an excellent standard It feels premium and polished not something I expected if I am honest before setting of on our holiday Arrival was very simple walked off plane on to a beautiful bright glass airbridge and into modern terminal structure made of glass and metal Immigration was quick and efficient not overly friendly but not antagonistic either We were airside probably within minutes from leaving the plane There is only one shuttle that goes to the city and it meets each flight leaving half an hour after each flights arrival and the cost was reasonable On Departure the checkin hall is bright and airy and the checkin staff for BA were friendly and helpful Security was a breeze and staff seemed generally fine we were the only flight taking off that evening though so it was very quiet The departure area was clean and well organised there isnt a lot of shopping opportunities or much to do but it is a small airport so that wasnt expected Do be aware of the extortionate prices charged by cafs for water you can buy it cheaper in some of the dutyfree shops at more reasonable cost Also only minutes of free wifi stingy and charging for more in this day and age is deeply odd These niggles aside however overall quite impressed
The set of counters of Cathay Dragon was a bit out of order since every counter was excessively full due to the great number of passengers Business Class and Marco Polo Club and Oneworld Members

We flew Qantas on a flight operated by Finnair on their behalf from Sydney to Bangkok It was a great experience from start to finish staff smiley and helpful Finnair my special GF food great good entertainment offer and we left on time from Sydney and touched down a few minutes early in Bangkok It was the distinct mixture of experiences on this flight which have made me post A collaboration of Scandinavian Australasian and Asian continents More like this please Just great My husband would have liked just a bit more legroom in economy for a long flight

I recently took two flights both of which provided a great experience First flight No CX from Chengdu to Hong Kong on an A Economy Class It was a very comfortable flight the cabin crew was outstanding and the food was good Second Flight NoCX from Dubai to Hong Kong on a Boeing BER Premium economy class This flight exceeded all expectations It was incredibly comfortable and the cabin crew was exceptional friendly helpful and truly dedicated The service on the ground and onboard was fantastic making the trip smooth The ample legroom allowed me to stretch out and relax while the wider seats extra recline and adjustable headrests provided the perfect setting for a good nights sleep The food was delicious offering a variety and flavour that made the experience wonderful I would like to thank Mr Philip from the Philippines whose outstanding service left a lasting impression This was a wonderful trip that I will never forget

Excellent small airport clean spacious good restaurant airline lounges collectively available to a great many airlines Arrival was to jetway Departure was by bus to plane from gate E the gates uses buses to go to aircraft The departure flight needed deicing since the aircraft was not parked at a gate it could be deiced in place before taxiing Frequent reliable bus service tofrom city Security personnel on departure efficient and courteous Time in security line minutes

Small and old airport One small ugly terminal with long queues Once past check in counter and paid php airport fee you are in a waiting area Waiting area is on two floors with several stalls selling food and drink but nothing spectacular One small duty free store as this place is an international airport but anybody can buy in this store Lavatorys even if not easy to be found are just ok Gives you the feeling you have been parachuted back to the this airport but all ended well

Check in at Port Vila was somewhat chaotic in the Domestic Terminal however certain check in desks for certain flights ensured you checked in for your flight ontime Very strict closing times for check in be warned to check in on time Boarding announcements were not very clear and any announcements were very hard to hear due to echo in the terminal Boarding was efficient greeted by the Smiling crew and that was it really Pre takeoff checks and we didnt see the crew again until the prelanding checks were done There is NO refreshments offered so take your own We did on this flight and so glad that we did Beautiful views to be had heading north to Santo however things turned to custard on coming into Santo It was midafternoon when the thunderstorms tend to pop up and we could not land at Santo due to the weather We then endured another minutes back to Port Vila where more chaos ensued I must say it was the Australians and Americans who were demanding on arrival wanting compensation and accommodation their pleas went unanswered as weather issues are not the responsibility of the airline folks Found our own hotel for the night turned up back at the Airport the next afternoon for our replacement flight and off we flew back to Santo and landed on a beautiful afternoon Cabin crew again were full of smiles on boarding and deplaning but really they did nothing else Aircraft was clean toilet was clean and announcements on the aircraft were much clearer than on some airlines we have travelled In fairness to Air Vanuatu they got us there and back and then there again safely they accommodated us onto an extra special flight due to the disruption you could not ask for anything else

The airport of Medan has been moved from Polonia to Kuala Namu International Airport KNIA KNIA is now the most advanced and the second largest airport in Indonesia It is also the first integrated airport rail link in Indonesia The whole area is free from smoke means that they provide and manage the smoking area well The baggage claim area is welldesigned Restrooms are always clean and have no pungent smell

Departure is very tedious Our flight got delayed not due to the airports fault but it took hours for them to get our luggage back Most of the luggage returned were wet and damaged Arrival however is very quick and easy

An excellent Domestic terminal very large and clean The security screening upon entering the airport for a am departure was fast and thorough Plenty of check in counters and efficient agents manning them The food is very expensive but I dont buy at the airport so no problem A very nice airport all in all

Ive flown in and out of BJX a half dozen times and have no problems Take along a book or knitting as there are only a couple of souvenir shops but they are colorful and reasonable My destination has been San Miguel de Allende the art colony thats popular with US citizens

A huge airport with multiple terminals and layers thereby distances are big Large lifts and automated people movers do help a lot Border control was fast and efficient they hand out a sim card for free on arrival Security was efficiently organized too Staff is mostly friendly and helpful Transport to town can be by metro busses or taxi It easily takes hour or more

The airport is very small so there is a lot of queuing Check in was fairly smooth once it opened and the check in lady was helpful and efficient Oversized baggage also taken at the desk which is good when youve got ski equipment There was then a long wait until we were announced to go through security Waiting area was limited and the food sat in a semi outside area where smoking was allowed There was a very long windy queue through security Limited facilities before and after security There is no lounges available

This airport is great Always clean lovely staff few delays and good food The information desk woman was very welcoming and we had a lovely chat Wifi access was good As small airports go Bluegrass is pretty much the model of what a small airport should be Shopping options are limited but you have a nice bookshop and a good bar after security the car park is a minutes walk from the terminal and the surroundings are well kept In years of traveling through Lexington I can think of nothing negative to say about this airport and its staff Even the TSA security check has always been pleasant
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

Beijing to Pyongyang The aircraft was clean cabin crew friendly and the flight on time You get the Pyongyang Times to read aboard I flew for the first time this type of a Tupolev and found not much difference to some other aircraft The food was acceptable The selections of beverages could be better

I had a wonderful experience flying with Vistara Airlines recently and I cant praise their staff enough especially Ankush and Manisha From the moment I arrived at the airport they made the entire checkin process incredibly smooth and stressfree Ankush was welcoming and guided me through each step with such professionalism making sure I had all the information I needed His calm and friendly demeanor made a normally hectic process feel easy and seamless Manisha was equally attentive helping me with my questions and ensuring I felt comfortable with every detail of my journey Their teamwork and dedication truly reflect Vistaras commitment to exceptional service Not only did they make the checkin experience smooth but they also set a positive tone for the rest of my trip The flight was equally enjoyable with clean cabins comfortable seating and excellent inflight service Thank you Vistara and a special shoutout to Ankush and Manisha for going above and beyond to make my journey a pleasant one I highly recommend Vistara Airlines for their superb staff and topnotch service

I flew one way from Melbourne to Canberra I paid extra for more leg room and extra for priority boarding It came to The flight left on time and arrived on time The seat was comfortable The staff were courteous Based on my experience I wouldnt hesitate to fly with this airline again

This company is horrific We had a cancelation of our flight back home and this airline refused to refund our money Fly Maya Island Air They are exceptional less expensive and very flexible The planes are also shady You will not regret flying Maya Island Air Have a wonderful and safe flight

After reading several negative reviews on this page regarding LPA Gran Canaria airport I wish to make a defence I find the airport similar to many of the Spanish airports operated by Aena in that it handles the volume of passengers proportionately and professionally Bear in mind the vast majority of passengers passing through the airport are there for leisure purposes this has always been a difficult balancing act to please the foot traffic Knowledge and preplanning are the key to success Informative information can be found online about the airport for example httpsgrancanariaairportcom is just one example Especially in this day and age with covid and the uncertainly about travel with changing restrictions it is paramount that planning ahead to provide a heads up of potential problems and issues is a must

We were initially a bit disappointed when Etihad did not use its own aircraft on the route between Abu Dhabi and Jakarta but used wetleased Wamos equipment However the entire experience was good Clean and spacious plane with pleasant configuration so ideal if you are traveling with people The staff was professional and friendly They carried out very thorough safety checks before departure and landing The only real downside was the entertainment Little choice and that should really be different no flash path information Furthermore only praise for Wamos A Basic experience on time and comfortable

Small international airport International flights limited to a few charters from China Arrival hall domestic has only one conveyor belt which did not work on the day I arrived so luggage were brought in very swiftly by handcart Taxi and shuttle bus available to city center km away Domestic departure hall is adequate and departure gates have sufficient seating a coffee shop and wifi

Small airport in the West of Ireland People and staff very friendly New bathrooms in lounge Food expensive Duty free was very big but there are no bargains for people travelling to US as items like perfumes are actually more expensive than sites in US We used to get bargains in duty free but not any more

Excellent service I flew on a hr m flight and the crew were excellent from boarding to disembarking The crew offered a complimentary snack onboard the seats are comfortable and the flight was smooth There were no delays or inconveniences during the flight The seats recline and although they are a bit old they are still leather and big so its very comfortable The crew helped me find my seat and they had a great attitude when I ordered a glass of water twice I will fly with them again recommended

Friendly little country airport in Australia Quiet clean terminal building with enough space for passengers using the frequent Regional Express Airlines Saab services This airport is well positioned between the towns of Narrandera and Leeton and has easy access to the main road to these centres It also has rental car services Best of all it was quiet and peaceful so one could do some work while waiting for flights no blaring television in the corner as is often the case these days Pleasant airport checkin staff at Regional Express as well
The check in was smooth Signs in English are sufficient to direct the passengers The ambiance is great and its facilities are enough to give comfort to its passengers

Windhoek to Frankfurt After having read reviews I was prepared for bad service and problems during the flight but luckily everything was fine and I am quite happy with the overall experience The aircraft is spacious and clean seats are comfortable and have a pillow and a blanket for each passenger The crew was very friendly and not so good cop bad cop The food was quite good however it might have been better maybe a dessert could be added Big selection of drinks but only one type of juice orange On the long overnight flight dinner and breakfast have been offered During the flight the crew also offered water The entertainment system is still not working it seems to be a persistent problem that the airline is not willing to solve

Auckland to Chengdu Their cabin was fresh and clean and being a newer aircraft was kept very well The service is warm and professional The seats fold flat and my kids slept for most of the hour flight We arrived relaxed and stress free considering that we had young kids to look after and worry about Night flights with kids are the way to go The food was very tasty The flight attendants were very polite and accommodating They never made you feel you were a burden to them I will happily fly Sichuan in the future

Im autistic and was nonverbal unable to speak when I went through security but the staff were incredibly kind and helpful It was very much appreciated as its obviously very difficult to navigate the world when one cannot speak and the staff were completely understanding Be proud

I arrived at Cape Town International Airport and had to wait for my baggage almost minutes This was a local flight from JNB to CPT This is not my first bad experience of the same nature in recent weeks

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of Air KBZ flying from Yangon to Mandalay I bought the ticket just two days before the flight and the fare was very reasonable Checkin was fast and efficient and a Air KBZ employee approached me in the line and escorted me to the checkin desk and helped me checkin The domestic terminal is small and a bit chaotic but this is not Air KBZs fault and should be remedied when the new domestic terminal is finished There are no screens announcing that boarding has commenced so you have to pay attention to the airline employees who walk up and down the waiting area with handheld signs with your airline and flight number on it Boarding was via a bus to the aircraft The plane was clean in good condition and the seats were comfortable The flight crew was helpful and friendly We were served a light breakfast on this minute flight The flight took off and landed on time I would certainly fly Air KBZ again

Bangkok to Taipei Having now taken four flights on V Air my comments remain virtually the same as my earlier review I arrived at the newly opened international terminal at Bangkoks Don Mueang airport about minutes prior to the scheduled departure Checkin took less than minutes even though the plane was around full The aircraft pushed back minutes late but arrived precisely on time The seat is comfortable with more leg space than is usual on budget carriers my preordered meal of chicken teriyaki was excellent and the FAs are efficient and cheerful One even came to my seat to welcome me back having seen me on my last flight almost months earlier I wish all budget carriers were of a similar standard

Had a missing baggage when landing at Victoria Falls Airlinks staff was very helpful in tracing and rerouting this baggage to Nairobi where I was when they traced the baggage Awesome customer experience

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available

Liked the airport of Edmonton Very efficient security and no big walking distances A nice bright design that make you feel comfortable Besides there are a lot of shopping and dining options here This Airport can be a role model how regional midsize airports should be

Flight slightly delayed but arrived slightly ahead of time by minutes Crew well presented and very professional Meal type and beverage selection an overkill for such a short flight Will fly Eswatini Air again

Bradley is my home airport I fly from and to here multiple times a year to visit friends and family While it isnt as big as the New York airports or Boston fares are usually among the cheapest in southern New England and southeastern New York and BDL provides service to all major eastern hubs such as Atlanta Detroit Cincinnati Charlotte Minneapolis ChicagoORD Washington Philly and Baltimore as well as numerous Florida destinations Las Vegas Denver Toronto Montreal Cleveland Raleigh San Juan Cancun and starting later this year LA and Dublin Ireland Concessions are ample and security is usually manageable in under thirty except some mornings I nearly always fly Delta and their service out of BDL has been fantastic Flights to Salt Lake City Seattle San Francisco and Nashville would be ideal additions

We took Flight from Kathmandu to Bangkok by Nepal airlines for our Holiday trip Flight was on time meal provided during flight is delicious and have veg and non veg options Staff of airline were well behaved and professional I will use service of Nepal in future as well Highly recommended
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious

Yangon to Nyaung My wife and me flew three routes with Air KBZ over our holiday in Myanmar and we got outstanding service every time The cabin crew all have excellent presentation and are very courteous and attentive We had a cold snack tea and coffee all of which were very tasty on all flights Its unusual to be given cream cakes at am but they were very nice All aircraft used were very clean and in good condition and all flights departed and arrived exactly on time Air KBZ is way better than we expected
Quite amazing that Bangkok Airways manages to serve a warm meal with drinks and coffee on a minutes full flight free of charge Even though the food wasnt very special but still edible it impressed me

Modern and clean airport The transit is really strange like you have to get into China and leave China again Came from Beijing to Singapore via Shenzhen Convenient airport lot of shops reasonable price airports many eateries Western Chinese Easy to find your way to the gate Ground staff do not smile

Traveling through Murtala International airport in Lagos Nigeria is an experience Staff are generally friendly and smiled a lot My documents were repeatedly checked I counted ten checkpoints altogether At five of them I was asked if I would hand over some money They weirdest situation was that the customs officer asked how much money I carry and then after hearing the honest as he was a customs officer answer asked me if I would give him some of it The airport is quite run down and processes are not streamlined Boarding was rather chaotic with passengers placed on different coloured seats after the boarding passes were scanned

Old airport looks like a s relic which it is Only used for transfer which was so simple just a short walk In that sense convenient but not much to do air side and unable to comment on passport or check in services Staff pleasant and very helpful So my one hour in the Seychelles was smooth and pleasant Departure area airconditioned which was handy in c humid outside temps

Keflavk to Copenhagen This flight was operated on anew Aneo showcasing Icelandairs Saga Class the airlines Business Class product Although the flight was delayed by three hours an uncommon occurrence given Icelandairs excellent ontime performance access to the Saga Lounge at Keflavk ensured the wait was a comfortable one The flight itself was smooth and pleasant While the Saga Class seats are not lieflat they are wellcushioned and provide ample comfort for the short journey The onboard service was warm and efficient Overall no complaints Icelandairs Saga Class delivers the most comfortable option for travel between Iceland and Europe or the Nordics

A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa for which I paid a high fare Got a cup of water and a chocolate gr Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate because I nicely asked In their Tourist Class not that their intraEuropean Business Class is anything great much better Lufthansa Co are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent you get what you pay for and there are no surprises Not with Lufthansa pay higher fares add luggage seats etc and get the full noservice experience
Short but pleasant flight on time Friendly crew cheap tickets clean plane and for a such a short flight a good snack was offered Boarding and deboarding fast

I recently flew from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airways and had a fantastic experience The flight crew was attentive and professional ensuring everything ran smoothly from boarding to landing The aircraft was clean and comfortable and the service was prompt despite the short flight duration The pilot provided clear updates and the entire trip was seamless A great example of efficient and excellent regional service

The best airport in the Middle East and Europe Staff service is very good Checkin procedure was fast and efficient The airport amentities are quite good good cafes to eat something Segafredo for coffee Duty Free is really very big and the selection is quite large

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

If you dont need to go to Denver I recommend COS as the best option for going to Colorado Small but not too small clean efficient quick and centrally located to most points in Colorado Good quick car rentals I use it routinely to go to Pueblo and Denver Yes Denver as it can be more convenient and faster to get to a lot of places especially in south Denver Remember Denver airport is miles east and an expensive toll road from many points in Denver Also traffic is very congested in Denver but only moderately so in Colorado Springs Only problem I have is that most often but not always the cheaper fares are into and out of Denver

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

It was an easy online check in Due to other company flight delays I was short on time to drop my bag in When I arrived it was too late for me to print my bag tag Ricky at LAX directed me to an operator who printed my tag and checked my bag in Flight was also great Service when needed but nice and quiet during the night to sleep I recommend Delta Air Lines

Naha airport has undergone some renovation and expansion it keeps improving each time I go there Being a small airport arrival is easy and luggage waiting time is not too long customs are also friendly and easy to pass through There is a major improvement in checkin areas for international flights and some domestic Used to be in a cramped little area now its a lot more spacious There is also a big improvement in food offering before immigration Once passed international immigration you will be left with very little choice I believe they are still undergoing some major facelifts for the departure gate areas maybe more stores will be added soon Overall this is a charming little regional airport which is easy to move around

Sal is a great small airport which is easy to use lots of signs and decent food options Good taxi services and shuttle buses to hotels Clean and airy and bright Would recommend Aeroplanes park very close and many airlines fly to Sal which is useful Friendly staff

Checkin security check an immigration at Xiamen Airport swift although not very friendly Contract lounge large with decent FB choices Boarding for both flights well organized Both flights with good FB offerings and service and on time IFE very good The big letdown was again the lack of frequent flyer points for members of other One lWorld airlines besides Asia Miles There was not even a fare bookable in economy which attracts frequent flyer points I fly frequently within the OneWord alliance and no other carrier has this practice I will therefore stick to the other members of Oneworld in the future

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane

Qazaq Air from Almaty to Shymkent returning a few days later Very good value considering tickets were booked less than hours before departure Nice new aircraft and smartly attired crew who were all trilingual Baggage is included in the ticket price and hand luggage was not strictly monitored but since both flights were not full there was plenty of space in the overhead lockers Check in at both ends was perfunctory and more or less wordless but the flights were punctual the return flight leaving minutes before the scheduled time of which was greatly appreciated by all on board There was even a snack service with a good choice of drinks all included in the ticket price Another retro touch was the basket of sweets offered round before take off I would definitely fly this airline again and hope they expand their destinations The only thing I would say against them is that at present their small fleet seems to mean that certain routes are served with en route stops that added to the slower speed of the Q aircraft could make some trips around Kazakhstan quite arduous Overall though excellent and amazing value

The schedules are well respected and the staff is excellent Boarding and disembarkation are quick The plane is clean and the information is clear Les horaires sont bien respects et le personnel est parfait Lembarquement se fait rapidement ainsi que le dbarquement Lavion est propre et les informations sont claires

Very clean and modern airport New terminal added in New access highway to Shenyang Limited air traffic with few delays Baggage area is poorly lit Not sure why As the Chinese economy grows who knows what will come of this airport Right now its a clean well run airport albeit with little air traffic Interesting for an American to see Air Koryo planes and personnel at the airport

I flew from and to Varna Airport in April The airport is good but the lounges were closed early in the morning There is only duty free shop and the prices there are good One bad thing is that boarding the plane is always by bus otherwise it is a good experience

Worst service I have ever seen in my entire life Had to wait for hrs at the carousel for my baggage to arrive Im told workers were slacking off and didnt see my bags until a senior officer had come to get the baggage moving Unfriendly staff who dont even wish to communicate with passengers unless you incorrectly use an aircrew term where they are most happy to correct you and then snigger about it and then once again act like youre nonexistent Well at least that informed me that they are not deaf but clearly ignoring me Porters in uniform are helpful and kindly directed me too Beware of Taxi drivers and ununiformed porters my baggage was forcibly snatched by one these to help me to the domestic flight departures

I had a pleasant experience on my Teheran Mehrabad to Shiraz flight It was a little bumpy due to weather but a delicious packed snack and drink were served for the short flight All the crew were very friendly and are a credit to their airline The A EPIEG was clean with a decent seat pitch for my foot frame and I was given a row of seats to myself All in all a very nice company who charged a very reasonable for my one way ticket I wish Iran Air the very best with each new addition to their expanding fleet and this wont be the last time I fly Iran Air

Was looking forward to flying with Solomon Airlines who were operating this flight on behalf of Air Vanuatu Check in was quick efficient and polite Boarding passes issued and invitation to the Air New Zealand Lounge where we sipped champagne and ate nibbles while we waited for our flight Boarding was quick and we sat in our allocated seats A C in Business Class Immediately offered champagneJuice or water before takeoff Naturally we had Champagne on this midday flight Cabin was clean airy and bright and the cabin crew were an absolute delight Friendly smiles everywhere and typical south pacific hospitality Lunch served was fresh very inviting and very tasty naturally followed by more champagne Flight time hours went by very quickly Even though the aircraft did not have WiFi no IFE and no charging ports that really didnt bother us as we were forewarned by researching in advance and we came prepared Its when youre not prepared travelling with kids and their electronic bits and pieces that they are forever glued to is where this could be an issue Be prepared Highly recommend Solomon Airlines and would be very happy to fly with them again

After a long transatlantic flight the last leg of my flight was with TAM from Sao Paulo to Porto Alegre When I landed in Sao Paulo I still had a couple of hours before my next flight I went to TAM desk for the checkin and the person there offered me to take an earlier flight which was in half an hour I was extremely happy about this Its the first time that I was so satisfied with the airline staff The flight was ok and with some snacks and a drink nothing too special but as youd expect in a one something hour flight
