Ground staff at JFK could have been better I had a great deal of luggage and needed a special staff member to handle tagging It was hard to find him and found out he hadnt been informed for several minutes Seats comfortable to Casablanca good flight crew good catering Casablanca to Lagos had an excellent crew and the best airline catering Ive had in decades of traveling Id definitely fly them again

This was my first flight with Starlux and was most impressed Checkin was quick and easy The plane is new quiet spacious and spotlessly clean featuring a large screen with many entertainment choices The flight left a few minutes late from Terminal One which was recently renovated and quite comfortable The onboard service was caring and professional My two oriental veg meals were somewhat bland but were generous and wellprepared

I had an excellent experience at Taoyuan Airport Very impressed with the smooth and efficient baggage handling process The staff were incredibly helpful offering assistance with moving my luggage at the baggage carousel It made the entire process much easier and stressfree Really appreciated the level of customer care and attention to detail in ensuring that everything went smoothly Im highly satisfied with the service and would definitely recommend it

London Gatwick to Podgorica The Fokker seats were comfortable in formation but they were small and legroom was limited Crew members were helpful and attentive We were served a couple of drinks and a fairly basic sandwich but it was fine It was cheaper for me to book a ticket to Belgrade via Podgorica than it was just to Podgorica I told the checkin staff I wanted to get off at Podgorica and that was fine

The rum and pretty well everything in the duty free stores costs double what it costs in a grocery store in Managua Rum is about US in a grocery and in the duty free in the airport A pound of Case de Cafe coffee is about vs about in the grocery store However the duty free shops are the only place to buy legitimate Nicaraguan cigars as total production in the country is for export They are very good and very high quality but to be honest at times in the USA they cost less Random luggage searches on departure are almost always for locals rarely tourists The airport is really quite advanced for Central America currently departures are a bit of a hassle with the construction of that area arrivals are a breeze and rarely does it take more than minutes with immigration and customs both especially for tourists vs visitingreturning Nicaraguans Taxis to the city are clean and controlled if a bit slow vs a regular taxista and cost US with the drivers in the red shirts However if you walk to the street about feet the fare is around If you can negotiate in Spanish that is

Saint Petersburg to Samara The airline is very good The cabin is clean and comfortable and with this always promised food and friendly staff As for the baggage allowance things are even better the baggage allowance is kilograms

An uneventful flight to Amsterdam Catering was not the best this time bland food and sides We were served twice it filled our stomach but that was it Service provided by the staff was friendly and speedy despite a full plane Seats were comfortable We landed min earlier in Amsterdam

Travellers arriving into SSA on international flights beware most of the cash machines in the airport for some unfathomable reason cease service at Particularly inconvenient since TAP and Air Europa flights from Lisbon and Madrid arrive shortly before midnight leaving international travellers with no Brazilian money This happened to me for the second time now which suggests it is a continuous issue There are three cash machines in the revamped Banco do Brasil right next to international arrivals which accept foreign maestro cirrus cards but they only issue a maximum of R per card which is just about enough for a taxi ride to the city centre and a beer Apart from this major issue which is strictly speaking not Infraeros fault but the banks SSA still remains an efficient and pleasant airport

The service was simply outstanding on this my first flight with Hainan Airlines Very comfortable business class seat on B provided with plush Sofitel duvet and bedding beyond anything I have received on other airlines Food was excellent many courses and beautifully served Cabin staff service was exceptional friendly and very attentive more than Singapore Airlines and seemed very genuine Onboard entertainment was okay but lacking compared to many airlines Look forward to further flights with this airline

I was down with flu and surprised when I checked in and cleared passport that the airport did not have any pharmacies or clinics inside the airport This is the first time in a long history of travel that an airport doesnt have these facilities Very disappointed

This is a very nice airport Very clean and modern Airport staff are courteous and helpful It is definitely the best airport I have been to in the Caribbean and definitely better than some airports in the US especially Miami where you are not even offered free WiFi Nassau airport has complimentary WiFi everywhere Selection of popular restaurants inside the US departure lounge There are some shops but mostly expensive souvenirs A great experience hats off to everyone at NAS

Stewart Airport in Newburgh NY is simply good I love to use this airport and often choose international carriers based on their landing at Stewart My experiences with Play Airlines have also been great Lorraine in checkin is a gem and keeps things running smoothly It is wonderful that the airport keeps adding domestic flight carriers as well Now travel is possible from Stewart International to Charleston SC No other airport is as easy to navigate as Stewart International The atmosphere is pleasant the staffing is topnotch and the TSA agents are respectful and helpful The entire process from checkin to boarding is smooth and efficient International arrivals are quick and Ive never had an issue with my luggage I highly recommend Stewart Airport to anyone who wants a simple hasslefree international travel experience

I was pleasantly surprised by Biarritz a small airport where everything seemed to work fine I was particularly impressed by the fact that the immigration officers on arrival and departure were smiling and courteous I wasnt expecting to see the negative reviews below but they are not too recent so maybe things have improved

The crew were extremely nice the flight was about hours and hours for the flight back to Hong Kong The flight was really smooth Props to the pilots The food was light and average The drinks were cool the in flight entertainment was out of service but pretty sure the airline is on a budget Warning that the ticket only includes kg of luggage to take on the plane and have to pay individually for luggage in cargo hold kg round trip more than HKD Seat was alright had decent recline trying to avoid flying with Hong Kong Airlines until maybe a few years later when they earn some money back Overall above average flight
Lisbon to Salvador Bahia Flight plastic free The first one I have travelled with And they had Ipads to comfortable watch what we preferred The distance between the chairs was large

A postmodern airport with many good restaurants and very spacious and comfortable environment Inside the departure area you have an amazing view of the aircrafts The seats are very ergonomic and delightful All the airports areas are very clean and hygienic On the other hand there are not many signals explaining the directions for each of the airports areas and facilities
You are all so sweet and smiling I travel frequently and for the first time in my life I saw so many smiles and excellent service Well done Keep it up

Initially booked in Economy Class but when I was about to board agent took my boarding pass and voila got upgraded to Business One thing that stands out with Philippine Airlines is the hospitality and warmth of their crew both on ground and on board Food may not be at par with other big Asian carriers but for what they lack makes it up with their service One thing to consider as well is the ticket price being the most affordable Ill keep using PR as it is the most convenient affordable and with genuine service PRs exclusive Mabuhay Lounge at MNL T is one the best thing that happened with PR so far Keep it up

This is a very pleasant airport especially compared to Schiphol Its efficient staff are friendly and the decor resembles a hotel lounge rather than the average airport look At peak times when a lot of leisure flights depart it can however get quite crowded As this airport is labelled as RotterdamThe Hague Airport there has to be a public transport link to The Hague This is inadequate consisting of a small shuttle bus connecting the terminal with the nearby metro station where you need to change Its all a bit of a hassle as the minibus is often too small for the number of passengers and baggage and runs infrequently outside rush hours The schedule should rather be adjusted to the arrival and departure times of flights Better still would be a direct public transport link to The Hague
A decidedly mediocre airport Winnipeg and Quebec City are similar in size but are far advanced in terms of services on offer design and overall experience What happened in Halifax Depressing and sad

It is a mediumsize International airport located in the city easy to arrive Served with all the big airlines companies in Brazil and also Surinam Airways TAP Portugal and flights to Miami and Fort Lauderdale by LATAM and AZUL The terminal is clean and offers lots of options for shopping and food The departure lounge could be bigger Sometimes it is filled of people and the seats are not enough The staff are good and prepared

Flew NIKI from Valencia to Vienna Quick boarding and ontime departure Cabin was clean and the flight was smooth and relaxed Cabin crew provided drinks and a very good cheese sandwich Later they provided us another round of water and coffee Seats a little bit narrower than other airlines Paid for a return ticket for flying with a very good airline

It looks like a white elephant but what an elegant one Corpus Christi appears to handle only connecting flights to Dallas and Houston thats the international bit with just three airlines operating there It is light bright airy and wonderfully free of the normal hustle and bustle of a modern airport Checking in took three minutes passport control and security about the same they have new full body scanner Each airline has its own gate complete with airbridge to connect even to small planes

Colombo International airport is a joke Never had such a horrific experience as a tourist on an international flight This airport is notorious for ripping you off and charging unconventional baggage fees for carrying a personal item such as a purse or even food They weighed our food and charged me over for my purse and food They even wanted to wear my jacket that I was wearing I do not recommend this airport and they are notorious for treating tourist like this as I was advised when I landed in the Maldives Sri Lanka in general is a phenomenal country with amazing people

This is a pretty nice small airport where you can find anything you would expect from it There are flaws like anywhere else They definitely need more staff which is obvious The offering of time killers are updated with new shopping places but still have to work on it My main issue was the parking which was pretty expensive so I had to search around for other solutions since the parking at the airport ended up more expensive than my Wizz Air ticket I use Google and found a private parking spaces but you can also look for others I suggest this one definitely Overall it is a decent airport that keeps on upgrading every year I visit it

Hiroshimas airport is somewhat small but is intelligently laid out and easy to navigate Perhaps because of its relative newness it appears to be quite pristine inside with a good range of services for travellers The biggest drawback is the distance from Hiroshima city well over a half hour outside of the city As another reviewer noted the IBEX flight requires walking out onto the tarmac which could be a hassle in inclement weather
One of the best choices in Brazil The airport is very modern pretty and clean it can be considered an architecture beauty Way better than So Paulo and Rio

We had a great flight with French Bee from Paris back to NYC We booked late for our first ever Europe trip so we didnt want to buy expensive tickets We took a risk going with French Bee since its cheap about one way We were nervous seeing all the bad reviews especially with cancellations Turned out to be an awesome experience on time good foods no turbulence
The service is good as a budget airline Cabin crew is helpful I did not encounter any bad issue along my flight I will recomment this airline if oyur having a tight budget The fares are reasonable
We flew from Toronto to Paris Flight attendants were very helpful and welcoming We especially appreciated Emersons help He was great Ground crew were great too

This is the major airport for southwest China Flew into Chengdu from Shenzhen where it was quite a lengthy walk from the Terminal gate to baggage claim This was topped off with a further lengthy walk to the opposite end of the terminal for the taxi rank Flying out a week later I had time to look at the airport more closely Terminal is old and definitely looking its age Terminal was shiny and modern with three fingers that extend out Plenty of interesting shops to keep myself amused inside the terminal and the lounges were adequately comfortable The feeling was light and airy inside with a good view to the outside despite the extra glass screen separating arriving passengers from departing ones

Check in and immigration fine Nice breakfast in London Cafe Smooth boarding for Windhoek from A Return Cape Town to Addis Arrival At Bole smooth and quick no que at visa on arrival Luggage fine Out quickly

Smooth arrival domestic in the new airport It is the only airport that I have arrived at that there is actually free onwards buses to most of the tourist resorts north of the airport about every five minutes I did not know about this free service but if passengers have lots of luggage they need to be mindful that it could be a long haul from the bus stop in their resort to their actual hotel I took a taxi from one of the three or four tax agencies outside arrivals they were actually half the price of taxihailing apps There were some nice airy restaurants in the arrival area and presumably these are available to departing passengers Five stars from me

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

On our departure from Simferopol to Moscow we were very pleased with friendly and efficient service at the checkin and the information desks But upstairs in the waiting area we were struck by absolutely different attitude The attempt to have some drinks before boarding finished with success only at the third cafe Its name somehow Happy potatoes Sorry not very sure But I am absolutely sure about the names of the cafes where we were met with rudeness and unhelpful attitude The names of those cafes are Skybar and We were flying on the st of July Such a shame to be let down by such a beautiful airport

The new Terminal at Birsa Munda Airport Ranchi is a welcome surprise for many Its a small but modern terminal with a few amenities that are actually not needed as the wait times are low due to low traffic You will find seats on both floors and few coffee shops to make your wait easier The airside is separated by tall glass panels and one can be entertained by watching the arriving departing planes Disembarkment and Boarding is done via the modern aerobridges that are truly of international standards Since it is a small airport the security checks and checkin process is very informal and the staff are courteous and helpful I always have pleasant experience in this small modern airport I wish there were more flights

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Kuala Lumpur to Kuching return on Feb Overall vey satisfied with the experience An exceptional service by the friendly cabin crew The airline offers an exceptional value for money The economy class cabin very clean and features new seats and wifi entertainment using own device The food is good for a domestic flight In both sectors boarding by groups and strictly follow The ground staff is good but can be better For one and half hour flight am not complaining

I recently traveled through Johannesburg International Airport and was thoroughly impressed by the exceptional service and overall experience The airport staff were incredibly helpful and friendly making the whole journey smooth and stressfree The facilities were clean wellmaintained and easy to navigate enhancing the overall travel experience From efficient checkin processes to a wide range of dining and shopping options Johannesburg International Airport truly excels in providing a topnotch travel experience I highly recommend this airport for its great service and overall pleasant atmosphere

PER to MRU Efficient check in at Perth Airport Air Mauritius provides access to the Aspire Lounge at Perth which is actually a very good albeit open access lounge Aircraft was delayed due to delayed connecting passengers Boarding was around minutes late Aircraft quite modern clean and well presented Good amenity kits Welcome drinks served Business class seat is a standard lie flat but works well On the shorter routes like this they dont provide a mattress topper Lunch and drinks served after take off Food was good smoked salmon starter and lamb main Reasonably selection of IFE Staff responded quickly to any calls I managed a few hours sleep Afternoon tea served prior to arrival For an hours and minute flight the offering was a little limited and not presented with much flair Arrival was delayed and though off aircraft quickly immigration was slow Luggage waiting for us when we had cleared immigration My feeling is this represents a solid mid range business product

Living and working in South Africa I fly home to Zimbabwe fairly often and try to be patriotic and use the national airline I have only been delayed once in the past year Food is good and service also of acceptable standards Ggetting through to the Joburg offices is another story altogether overall I think Air ZIm are doing the best they can with the resources at their disposal

Flew with AIRDO a low cost airlines owned by ANA from Tokyo Haneda to Hakodate Flight was on time and full of passengers who were en route to observe the cherry blossoms in Hakodate Cabin crew was really professional friendly and attentive Legroom was good seat was comfy cabin was clean Soft drinks water apple juice tea orange juice coffee was served to all passengers even it was a low cost airlines Both of take off and landing were smooth

Nice clean and efficient regional airport which I have used regularly over the years Never had queues at checkin Living in the Eastern part of Holland FMO the official abbreviation of MnsterOsnabrck is a good alternative for me to Amsterdam Provided that is you have a car public transport connections to the airport are not simple and not fast and you find a good and not too expensive flightespecially flights with connections in major hubs Frankfurt or Munich can be rather expensive

Like Bermuda itself this airport is a thoroughly civilized experience not very busy so not crowded with a rather predictable traffic pattern of arrivals and departures Facilities are very adequate and the dutyfree shop has a reasonable variety albeit a bit expensive On entry customs officials are polite and welcoming When checking in for our departing flight the official who had to pat me down for a followup security check the machine beeped when I went through apologized for having to do so and thanked me for accommodating the security process All in all a refreshingly unique experience one that is alas vanishing amid the alltoocommon post overzealous and ironically ineffective security measures elsewhere Bravo to Bermuda and its airport
Sorong to Jayapura Flight left almost on time Aircraft clean and comfortable with friendly crew and many empty seats at the back Inflight meal only a cup of water and a little breadroll

The airport has a nice design but it is not well maintained and you always feel its aging fast The waiting time to reach immigration might take more than an hour in summer while bags might take on average minutes in nonpeak times Duty free is good and the RJ lounge is very good with plenty of options Toilet and hygiene facilities dont have consistent standard

The airport is really modern and beautiful Its very tidy and clean and has a lot of signs and announcements and a lot of staff that help out with your luggage the staff are really kind and the airport is really clean

Piedmont Triad is just a jewel of an airport Friendly staff polite and helpful TSA Officers who seem genuinely pleased to have the opportunity to chat to travellers Add to this outstanding wifi connection which comes free of charge with no time limit and comfortable clean and stress free surroundings We fly here frequently from Glasgow with a connection to NC at Newark Not as many shops or food concessions as larger airports but at least the staff are friendly The difference between Newark and Greensboro is really quite startling My wife and I love this airport

Entebbe airport sets good standards for an airport in Africa Though I do not recommend staying in it for hours it is still a clean safe place Coming from Sydney it is ok Its clean and the lounge is amazing Though having kids with me did make a hassle Otherwise its a nice quiet airport to go to Especially when the border security allowed me to go from the back to the front of the line I like it

The arrivals hall at the international terminal is clean and tidy but does not cope well with any more than large aircraft arriving at the same time It can take over an hour to clear customs and there is only one baggage conveyor The only ATM is after passport control and you will need PGK if you wish to purchase a visa so it pays to have your currency ready before you depart for POM The departure lounge is also very clean and tidy and customs and immigration are efficient However if you wish to do shopping there is only one very small duty free shop and an even smaller cafe after customs and security

I have been in this airport many times over the last three years and it is by far the best airport I have experienced in Latin America It is clean and new and easy to get through with no long queues only a little when waiting in immigration after transatlantic flights Everything is very open and there is many different things to buy in taxfree

Panama City to Caracas a journey of hrs There was very little legroom but we were served quite a decent meal and considering it was a short flight I was impressed We departed on time but arrived min late

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

Small and always a risk for bad weather but they do an amazing job clearing the snow closed less than hrs per year despite getting more snow on average than any comparable city Rarely any delays at counters or security Free WiFi Not much in the way of food or shopping No public transportation into Syracuse taxi only

I am sat in a light and airy air conditioned building drinking Cappicino Freddo The queue for checking in was small but very organised and the whole building is welcoming Arrival was just as good although a slight wait for baggage due to three aircraft coming in close together This airport has come on a lot since last year and I recommend it The indicator boards all seem to be working ok and the WiFi is good What more can you want Dont blame the airport for things they dont control

Omsk to Krasnoyarsk I was a little unsure as to what to expect from a second tier Russian company However the check in process was quick and efficient although it was done only in Russian and I had to move a little weight from my checked in luggage to my hand luggage The flight departed and arrived on time The plane was quite small but legroom was still adequate It was subject to turbulence as we were approaching the landing The cabin crew appeared not to speak English as announcements were only in Russian A good snack was served on the almost two hour long flight My luggage came off the flight fairly quickly All in all a satisfactory experience

Sydney Santiago via Auckland on Above average flight with an average meal very good crew and reasonable IFE selection However the abreast in economy is too tight The seats are too narrow and the aisles are tiny The meal trolley only just fits through The tray table is also very small On the return leg a passenger fell ill immediately after takeoff The crew managed this very well About hours into the flight it was determined that wed have to return to SCL The airline put us into hotels As a transit passenger through SCL the airline arranged to pay our reciprocity fee US to enter into Chile This was a long process over hour but at least they paid for it The airline wasnt able to arrange a single large bus to take us to the hotel at the last minute and so there was another long process about hours of getting all of us into separate mini buses The hotel was excellent and included free food Back to the airport this time in a big coach and a very long checkin process Our bags were checked through to SYD and we were advised wed been put onto a Qantas flight from AKL to SYD The flight was again reasonable good crew OK food definitely not up to Emirates standards and bathrooms kept clean Due to our delayed arrival into AKL we had to overnight there and again LAN had arranged a hotel meal and bus transfer for us Overall LAN managed this stressful situation which was out of their control quite well ensuring we had a place to rest and food to eat and made sure we all got to our final destinations My lower marks are for the standard and quantity of the food and the cramped seating that almost all operators of the have adopted

I took the am flight from Basra to Erbil an Iraqi domestic flight I bought the ticket the day before at the Iraqi Airways ticket office in Basra They were friendly spoke English and only take Iraqi dinars no credit cards I paid roughly the equivalent of The flight left on time and was fine The equipment was a B On the short flight they served a breakfast tray with a lot of very sweet things chocolate milk an Iraqi Twinkietype cake a soft roll with jam and a banana It wasnt really to my liking but it was nevertheless an energypacked breakfast which is more than one gets on European carriers these days The flight attendants were friendly and we landed in Erbil on time I was satisfied with my flight and wish other people would also leave reviews for this airline

Very nice airport closely situated to New York City and very convenient for all travelling tofrom Long Island Decent selection of shops easy to navigate and not crowded at all when I flew threw both times Local hub for Southwest airlines

I have gone to this airport several times the past two years Beside my bad experience with sixt car rental I can not find any reason to complain Friendly and helpful staff check in and security done in minutes Small duty free and nice coffee shop Well functioning small airport

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze

I thought this airport was lovely Outside are the cobbled roads and tram link into center In the main airport terminal the facilities are excellent They have a truly amazing viewing deck with information about the space programme and aircraft using the airport Security was quick efficient and friendly and boarding immediate to the aircraft I feel Bremen airport gives passengers the proper respect they deserve even when travelling a budget airline

First time in Jordan we had to change the airplane at Amman airport The experience at the security check was not a good one The staff was rude to the customers and not very professional although we were friendly and everything was ok with our hand luggage We spent a few hours in the BusinessLounge and enjoyed the food and the comfortable atmosphere

Omsk to Krasnoyarsk I was a little unsure as to what to expect from a second tier Russian company However the check in process was quick and efficient although it was done only in Russian and I had to move a little weight from my checked in luggage to my hand luggage The flight departed and arrived on time The plane was quite small but legroom was still adequate It was subject to turbulence as we were approaching the landing The cabin crew appeared not to speak English as announcements were only in Russian A good snack was served on the almost two hour long flight My luggage came off the flight fairly quickly All in all a satisfactory experience

An enjoyable flight It left on time and check in was easy The seat was quite comfortable for a short flight The staff were very friendly and efficient The food was surprisingly good as well The flight offered refreshments twice In fact more food then my flight on QANTAS from Sydney to Cairns

Multistop from Munich via Kiev to Istanbul Then back to Munich after some days of holiday in Kiev Perfect flight times all flights landing ahead schedule Great service on the ground and on board Relaxing lounges UIA highly recommended
Clean airplane departed on time Crew were professional and friendly Good announcement from the pilot Offered a cookie and a bottle of water No in flight magazine

Quebec City airport is very clean and comfy Free and fast wifi with no submission or forms to fill or emails to wait for to validate the access The whole terminal is bright and welcoming The seats inside the departure terminal are new and very comfortable The checkin area is very well organised and neat The toilets are very clean On my arrival everything was easy and in the end the only little improvement this airport could make is for the luggage delivery time Apart from this very small detail this airport is just perfect

I booked this flight solely because it was by far the cheapest option for me to get to my destination on new years eve I hadnt known much about Garuda Indonesia before except for the fact that its a star airline I must say I was pleasantly surprised Everything from checkin transfers food and service was excellent I was travelling with my elderly relative for whom wed requested a wheelchair for who was escorted by hand to her seat upon boarding something which Ive ever seen on another airline We had a very tight connection in Jakarta minutes which was managed very well by ground staff at all airports The ground staff at Melbourne Airport assured me that our luggage would be loaded onto the connecting flight I was panicking when our flight from Melbourne departed slightly late due to our already tight connection but the ground staff at Jakarta Airport were preprepared and were ready waiting for us to escort us quickly to our connecting flight and we thankfully made the connection Overall a great experience

Athens to Nuremburg First time I had used or heard of this airline and as it was a very late booking I had little choice The experience was very pleasant The plane was modern clean good legroom comfortable seats The cabin staff were young polite and well dressed Plane was delayed after boarding for minutes due to air traffic control and we were informed by pilot who did his best to make up the time They are pretty strict on hand baggage I have sat on many planes that have been delayed due to excess hand luggage which had to be transferred into the hold This plane loaded very quickly due to one person one bag policy If I have one criticism it would be that there is no online check in system I rarely travel with hold luggage so to have to line up with fellow passengers who had cases was a bit of a pain If however like the majority of passengers you are checking in hold luggage then it is probably not such an issue

After reading lots of reviews I was really sceptical about flying with WOW air I still went ahead and booked my ticket to detroit as it was the cheapest option for a one way and I had to book last minute which is always more expensive I decided to pay for selected seats up the front with extra leg room on both flights and got really lucky with having no one in my row for the first flight The second flight I chose a seat with no middle seat and was really happy with this decision As its a cheap airline a lot of people do not pay for the seat upgrade its really not expensive to purchase the extra leg room and well worth it for the comfort Plus you will likely not have many people around The food and drink on board is very expensive but as I knew this beforehand I purchased food and water at the airport to take on the flight with me I think I was lucky with the reliability of both my flights taking off on time as this was the one thing I was worried about The seats are very dirty front seat pocket but all airlines are usually quite unhygienic so this was to be expected The service on board I thought was great very friendly staff and attentive Overall I would say you get what you pay for and you are taking a risk booking with WOW air but lucky for me I had a good experience with them and would book again

I had just gotten to Khartoum from Dubai and I really had to use the washroom I went to the mens washroom and man oh man It smelled like people went there and forgot to flush I didnt use the washroom I ran back to my father because there was faeces on the floor of the toilet as well Outside I saw a janitor sitting in his chair comfortably and as I do not know how to speak Arabic I just decided to hold it instead of telling someone to clean up Other than this the airport was alright but not even close to ideal A month later my mother came via the same flight and airport and she had to wait hours at the luggage belt for her luggage to arrive

KigaliJoburg June in an old narrowbody B I was upgraded from an inexpensive economy ticket to business class by using miles in their Dream Miles Frequent Flyer Program Checkin and lounge access in Kigali smooth as usual Luggage was kindly checked in to final destination legs ahead on different tickets and airlines Thats a courtesy winner which hardly any European airlines can cope with Checkin issued my onward Boarding Passes on the spot which made my life easy by staying in transits throughout the journey enjoying entitlements and lounges instead of struggling with immigration and landside eg in South Africa Lounge in Kigali is good though still with room for minor improvements Boarding easy by walking m on tarmac directly to the aircraft The business seats were in rows in x configuration I had D to avoid direct exposure to the rising morning sun In economy seats are narrower and in x configuration Morning flight departed on time and arrived slightly early Onboard seating perfect special meal accommodated other hot meals offered were also good No drinks and no food menu provided Unclear what they actually had onboard for catering Drinks and wine selection sparse and modest However we were offered predeparture champagne Piper Heidshick FAs were generous pampering us well and of world class in kindness and attentiveness They might benefit from further airline exposures IFE is useless no headsets given Given FFP miles instantly according to my original booking Luggage well handled Cannot demand much more for regional flights in business class

First time flying with Jet they didnt disappoint We flew on a new A neo aircraft Crew were friendly efficient We got drinks services going but only coming home We paid for inflight meals both ways tea coffee or hot chocolate were included The food was very good hot Drinks were good value

Very pleasant experience The airport was very clean and up to a great standard It looked like a new development The airport staff are very polite Passport control a breeze especially for families with small children The baggage arrived in good time I could not find an ATM or a currency exchange counter though Had to go downtown to get local currency

Flew on four separate legs within Myanmar and found them to be surprisingly good You dont normally expect catering on flights of under an hour but there was something on all segments Arrived in good time at Heho Airport for a flight to Yangon and they automatically put me on to an earlier departure There is a certain amount of third world amateurism about the boarding process but it all seemed to work

Staff are very rude They checked me thoroughly and ask to open my bag and not to touch anything i was just standing there and they are also checking the other passengers coming after mins i ask the security if i can go and get my bag she said oh yes you can i forgot She made me wait for nothing They have an overpriced for their food inside the airport I will share this experience to my colleagues and other friends

Guangzhou Baiyun Airport is the most impressive airport for me The ground staff of China Southern Airlines are very warm and have a good attitude This aspect is much better than many domestic airports Since I booked the hotel next to the boarding gate I needed to get the ticket to pass the security check and customs one day in advance The staff of China Southern Airlines helped me to coordinate with the customs and security check departments and finally I checked into the airport transfer hotel successfully

Faleolo airport in Apia Samoa is a small airport We found immigration customs etc very quick and efficient as well as baggage handling At the moment the airport is not really pretty to look at but a new terminal is being built which should be spectacular when completed Its really refreshing to be able to walk through the airport on arrival departure and not be forced to navigate through a giant shopping mall like at Sydney The airport has done duty free shops which you are free to go into or not go into rather than having to go through them to get in out of passport control a few small food shops reasonably priced and a bar Parking is Samoan Tala Staff at the airport are friendly welcoming and helpful The only negative side is that there is no air conditioning outside the security areas and check in is a bit uncomfortable when its humid

Hong Kong to Okinawa Naha Overall A very pleasant flight The only two gripes I have was that they changed the plane to a narrowbody A when the flight was supposed to be operated on an A and the other being that the legroom on the A was not as generous as their widebody aircraft but then again every A is going to offer lesser legroom With that out of the way everything else was done right Boarding was seamless cabin crew were very professional and courteous and uptodate IFE was offered even on the narrowbody A Meals were provided too Not much time was wasted on the ground and we were airborne before scheduled time All in all a very pleasant flight

Beautiful terminal and concourses in the new terminal Light and airy honestly the airport I would most enjoy waiting around in for a flight delay Also good food and shops and a general uplifting feeling Also the bus transit link back to Hong Kong was fast and efficient Going through security screening was a bit of a line but the check procedure was quick enough
Arrived on full QF from Sydney on April Fantastic new airport that does credit to New Caledonia Clean modern and very quick from a full plane to bus transfer to Noumea

It is a second tier nonhub airport so traffic is lower As others have noted it is surrounded by a botanical garden so the setting is beautiful Recently all of the food options were significantly upgraded Security moves quickly and efficiently The arrivals area is large and conveniently located next to the parking garage for a quick departure Rental car counters are right in the arrivals area Which brings me to the only negative waits for checked baggage are noticeably longer than almost any other airport Figure on a minimum minute wait Would recommend getting your rental car while you wait on your bags

BUR is a no frills no wow no stress airport and those are the best things about it Easy to park with valet getting through security is usually a breeze and there is little fog to cause delays Theres a Peets coffee and the cafe is overpriced but decent Do you really expect fine dining on what is primarily a short haul airport basically an SWA airport Other than the charming s air about the place you get on and off the planes old school style with stairs and with SWA can enter through the front of back of the plane the latter to avoid the slow pokes SWA boarding lines are well organized If I were to complain the rest rooms are smallish and Terminal B for United is too small Seating can be somewhat tight close to boarding time Baggage claim is usually reasonably fast but there are only two carousels so dont dawdle If you are going to the westside or even downtown youre in for a long cab ride but most travelers live in one of the nearby valleys and if youre a tourist its close to Universal Studios Theres a train within walking distance that will take you downtown or to Ventura County during limited times Overall a very good travel experience because it is easy and stress free
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice
Very nice airport Small short ways with quick checkin short TSA waits short Gate walks and free wifi for minutes

From Jeju Korea to Taipei and back I was hesitant to fly with an unknown local Taiwanese company but I have to say that I was nicely surprised the service is good and plane clean The hostess are courteous and the planes looks internally and externally wellkept The flight was pleasant and trouble free even with a baby Far much better from the china eastern flight I took from Shanghai to Jeju which was baby unfriendly I would compare Far Eastern Air transport as Dragonair a bit more clean

Just flew on a oneway flight from Zurich to Sarajevo and was extremely pleased The flight was carried out by their ATR aircraft which looked pretty new and was clean too We both departed and arrived early which I found great however What Id noticed is that the only type of entertainment they offered on board were the magazines in the seat pockets which were rather boring but this was after all a small aircraft so I wouldnt have expected anything else The plane was surprisingly full there were only about three unoccupied seats on board The inflight meal consisted of a very tasty sandwich and a wide selection of drinks Very kind cabin crew and they spoke really good English which was great I definitely recommend flying BH Airlines

Small quiet regional airport with small turboprop aircraft from a single airline There is no separate security screening staff have always been exceptionally helpfull Late arrivals for departures are handled efficiently The cafe is an offshoot of a nice respected cafe in the city serving exceptional coffee There is little point trying to fly from the bigger airports of Ballina or the Gold Coast The planes might be bigger there but flight times to Sydney are the virtually the same you are less comfortable waiting in those bigger airports Mother nature is the only downside with early morning fog causing some concerns but has never really affected me when I have wanted to travel

Singapore airport is magnificent and extremely wellmaintained with its facilities gardens waterfalls etc but arriving in the country has been made very difficult for Nordics There is no one at the immigration department upon arrival you first have to fill out a variety of information in English on a small computer which can take up to an hour If the machine accepts everything be happy There was no one to assist you in the queue of dozens of people at the machines And if you are accepted you go to another automatic machine where you present your passport and other necessary documents Your bag has been spinning for a long time waiting for you to pick it up from the belt When leaving the country everything seemed to be OK but then the departure security check began which was anything but friendly The border control officers who were clearly enjoying it gave orders and ripped off the jackets of older people who did not obey at the same second A militarystyle manly arrogant woman took my passport and boarding pass away because they noticed my diabetes pills everything was drugs to them Then I was ordered aside and subjected to various tactile tests with a digital device They couldnt didnt care to read prescriptions Overall it had the feel of being in the military chain of command
The conveyer belt was not working ground staff are limited and quite unsupportive no canteen to eat food But the airport is very clean Newspaper stand and water filter is well in sight

Lovely airport amazing views of the Alps Checkin was ok Wizz airline desks were poorly managed with long ques but the rest of the airlines seemed fine and so was security Shops were a bit lacking but overall a good airport

I always have great experience flying with GOL It is efficient and provides great value for money The crews are friendly and the plane looks well maintained They provide snacksmeals during their flights depending on flight duration and Decent entertainment system together with a free wifi for messaging

Beijing to Pyongyang Comparing an intraEuropean flight of hours and this flight practically no differences clean aircraft nice stewardesses punctual simple food good and attentive service a normal standard

Ankara airport is lovely clean and a pleasure to be in It feels very new and modern and has a lot of glass to let natural light in Security is very fast and efficient and connecting to and from the city is fairly easy with a shuttle bus that costs TL Unfortunately like all Turkish airports to get free wifi you need a code sent to your mobile so if youre traveling and dont have a sim card that works then youre out of luck Otherwise its not a problem

Adelaide to Melbourne Staff were lazy and unhelpful They appeared more interested in selling extras and assessing baggage weight than providing service While nobody expects luxury from a budget airline courtesy shouldnt be dependent on ticket price

Air Cambodia formerlyCambodia Angkor Air I felt quite sad for this airline because although the cabin crew were amazingly calm relaxed and friendly it seems that despite using smaller aircraft ATR s I understand they are really giving it their all to provide a decent level of service for such a short flight even though a cup of water was all that was provided I very much doubt if Ill ever fly with them again but I wish them all the very best

If youre coming from a western country be aware that this airport functions a bit differently than what were used to First you and all your bags have to pass through security bags in the scanner you in a light body search and then you enter the hall where the airlines check in counters are You do not need to present a boarding pass to enter this first hall meaning you can come in with a friend or family member who isnt flying This hall has some chairs toilets and or shops After you check in and drop your bags with your airline you proceed to immigration At this point you can only get through if you have a valid boarding pass You get to a second hall with the duty free and a couple more shops and restaurants Last you move to the area where your gate is Theres different areas with different gates each with their own security line if you go to the wrong gate area like I did you need to ask airport staff to escort you out so you can go to the correct area This security check is the same as the first one bags on the scanners and you get a light body search Then you proceed to your gates waiting area where you have toilets and shops No one ever checks for liquids or electronic equipments and I even had my own bottle of water in my bag when I went through both security checks Men and women have different security lines so that man are searched by a male officer and women searched by a female one As for facilities there were enough chairs for everyone but chairs were not the most comfortable If you like shopping in airport this is also not the best place not enough offer of shops and even the duty free doesnt have much to offer The airport is generally clean and there are western toilets plus free water On arrivals immigration lines are often under staffed so prepare for waiting mins If youre looking to exchange money at the airport you need go back the stairs after you collect your luggage because the money exchange counter is on the departures floor

Very efficient and pleasant airport Check in was quick and used the executive lounge I have used many but this was excellent One of the very best Food and drinks of good choice and a high standard Served to you rather than self service Comfortable and lovely friendly staff who couldnt do enough for you

Mainly domestic airport serving the Brazilian side of Iguassu Falls Busy airport with a air bridges and some remote stands Shopping opportunities as you walk from the gate to Baggage Reclaim Baggage Reclaim is on the ground level and has main baggage carousels Domestic arrival so no Customs or Passport Checks Small and busy Arrivals area with parking directly opposite Small but efficient airport

MEX consists of two terminals with Aeromexico Delta Copa and LATAM taking up the newer Terminal and everyone else essentially taking up Terminal Terminal is definitely more userfriendly with Terminal being well over capacity This honestly I dont think will change given that its proximity to the center of Mexico City makes it quite convenient in spite of its shortcomings

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in
Nice small friendly airport Good transport links to the city by bus which meets flights and plenty of taxis A few shops and cafes and very clean facilities

I had a fantastic experience at Ben Gurion airport From the moment I arrived everything was smooth and efficient The checkin process was quick security lines were wellorganized and the staff was friendly and professional The terminal was clean spacious and wellmaintained with plenty of seating areas to relax before my flight I was especially impressed with the variety of shops and dining optionsthere was something for everyone Free WiFi was fast and reliable making it easy to get work done while waiting Boarding was handled efficiently and overall the experience was stressfree and friendly I highly recommend this airport for its excellent service and organization Looking forward to flying through here again

This is a large airport that is undergoing runway expansion which is very visible on takeoff and landing For a midmorning flight the C concourse was very but not very crowded Seating at the gates can be a premium however we had no difficulty finding seating The connecting hall has all kinds of restaurants both fast food and sit down Airport WiFi is easy to connect and fast The bathrooms are impeccable There is an attendant on duty who is constantly cleaning the bathrooms after every use The attendant greets passengers saying welcome to the cleanest bathrooms in CLT Kudos to Airport management

Me and my wife flew up from Copenhagen to Kangerlussuaq and back again The food was perfect The seats where okay but you couldnt lower it to a bed There was no AVOD system but the pre selected movies were great directly from the cinema
Nordavia has been renamed as Smartavia and reviews can be found on this new linkSmartavia Reviews

Very friendly clean and organized Still in need of more modern technology but above all for being in a poor country it delivers a good service nice food court and souvenir shops although the latter are pricey It has something for everyone

What great TSA staff have at St PeteClearwater Airport The lines moved smoothly and additional lines were opened when it became crowded The food court consists of one small shop where the food is OK Looking forward to going through this airport again on Sunday

In August Johannesburg to Maun and Kisane to Johannesburg Both flights were spot on time Service on board was fine with drinks and light snacks served for the roughly hour flight in each direction Aircrafts were in good shape and the seats comfortable for this type of trip Checkin in Joburg was easy and very quick Check in in Kisane was a breeze as the airport is tiny All in a good experience and a great way to enhance your Botswana experience

Ljubljana to Munich The homebase airport of Adria Airways is Ljubljana and it very small relaxing and convenient It is surrounded by the Alps and the departure was fantastic The airplane was modern and the crew was nice Ontime departure Drinks without alcohol were free and I paid for my white wine Considering that I had a cheap ticket I cannot complain Upgrades would have been available for which includes the lounge

We have used this airport in the past there is noticeable improvement in the facilities and services The check in are is spacious with adequate seating and few shops The check in process was smooth and the security swift and friendly After security there is a large waiting area with free newspapers and view of the apron the separture lounge is upstairs and they have aerobridges A good regional airport if you want to go to see the Big Cat Tigers

Note that the airport departure tax is SP for over s All taxis from airport are run by private company and are fixed rate The cost is around All previous comments re chaos at departure excessive zeal by document checking officials overcrowding etc are still as relevant as ever A thoroughly depressing experience in what is a friendly generous and wonderful country

On our flight with LAN we had to change flights in Sao Paulo to TAM Airlines retrieve our luggage and check it in again as we were flying a domestic flight to Rio and then to Santiago There wasnt much time between the connections in Sao Paulo and going through immigration and changing terminals made it almost impossible With minutes before departure we didnt have our luggages checked in and there was a big line at the counter The staff on ground made a great job in checking our baggage and then taking us to the plane in a minibus as we were the last ones to board The luggage arrived safe in Santiago and both flights were on time On the way to Rio there was a new A with lots of leg room and for Santiago an old A which gave us a lotof trouble with many turbulences The food served on TAM wasnt different from the one of LAN but the staff were extremely friendly Still the experience in Sao Paulo looked very chaotic to us and we would prefer LAN for further flights

The flight was a bit late departing from Gaya but I wondered if we would even fly given the dense fog The flight was beautiful scenic in a half empty cabin with cleanest and beautiful interior The crew distributed snacks and drinks quickly and we could enjoy our view Everything was really nice and their flight magazine is informative of the country and sites A really beautiful experience

Another pretty solid trip with Jet A full package holiday was booked through them and they did not disappoint The flight times were good as they offered a decent early flight to get there and a leisurely enough time to return Checkinbag drop at Belfast was quick and easy with friendly staff and the boarding process was fast and well managed leaving the experience hassle free Onboard the plane was clear well kept and pleasant decent leg room for taller passengers as well The inflight shopping options seemed OK although this wasnt something that I would usually avail of however food and drink options were good enough Not bad in terms of range and price to match granted more than you would want to pay on the High Street but OK for a flight The staff really made the experience good with the crew friendly and very efficient getting food and drinks out quickly and picking up the rubbish after in good time Jet has been like this the last few times weve travelled with them so hoping this keeps up

Hollywood Burbank Airport is a perfectly splendid airport and a notsoperfectlyspendid airport simultaneously What do I mean Well first Long Beach is my favorite airport in the Los Angeles area with Burbank a respectable second I find them to be more pleasant than especially LAX and even Orange County The feeling of flying into and out of Burbank is one of aviation yesteryear of sorts think sort of like the show Wings Driving onto the airport and following the signage to the terminal and car rental return is simple and straightforward Dropoff and pickup areas in the front of the terminal are simply and clearly delineated though sometimes difficult to access given the constant flow of traffic in that area which is still nowhere remotely as bad as LAX but remember Burbanks terminal is old Walking into the airport you clearly have a feeling of sera Art Deco architecture something really Americana and unique even as American airports go Checkin for either American or Southwest is a breeze no sarcasm no lip service all business but still pleasant Seating and flooring pre and postsecurity is a little aged and worn in some areas and could really stand to be improved but theyre also no worse than much of LAX Shopping and dining options are very limited even by small airport standards surprising considering that we are still in the greater Los Angeles area after all The staff at the car rental facilities are generally helpful and professional though actually friendliness is hitandmiss Ive never met anybody rude there though TSA personnel seem to be the most truly hitandmiss either sugarcoatedly friendly and jovial or aloof and grumpy almost to the point of being rude To TSAs credit here though they are amazingly efficient even by small airport standards whether you have TSA PreCheck or not There has been a proposal by the airport authority to effectively construct a new terminal in the place of the existing terminal which would be a shame to have materialize with the charming existing terminal could just be renovated and modernized while keeping its rich history in tact In all Burbank is a good airport with some notable warts but positive experiences to be had hard to rave about but still easy to like

I arrived on a national flight from Guadalajara The gates of the Tijuana Airport are quite modern with jetways at each gate There are restaurants and shops along the concourse It was necessary to have my passport checked by an immigration officer who saw it was a US passport and waved me through without looking at it The customs inspection was minimal The baggage claim area is OK When I checked in for my departing flight I found passengers were required to go through screening and customs inspection to enter the checkin area It is possible to exit and go outside while awaiting boarding time after you check in The street entrance to the airport is under construction and it is necessary to walk past the boardedoff areas to enter the terminal There is a bus station at the airport right by the terminal for shuttle buses to CA Overall this airport is not bad and will be very good once construction is completed

Stockholm Vsters is a tiny airport located around minutes drive west of Stockholm The name is therefore misleading as Vsters is a proper mediumsized town in its own right The place has a very friendly easygoing feel to it There is very little to do save buy a cup of coffee or something stronger if thats to your taste but then I have never had course to spend more than minutes at the airport There are special very efficient buses to Stockholm and elsewhere which connect with incoming and outgoing Ryanair flights It is also possible to take a regular bus into Vsters A totally hasslefree calm place to begin or end a journey
Out on QF on Premium Economy back on QF Business Class Premium economy very good and business class great Cabin crew really good and service superb

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

A small domestic airport in Taiwan Fast and friendly staff Surprisingly many shops Looked very clean Because this is a military airport too you can spot military aircraft taking off and land taking photos is forbidden though On time nonchaotic boarding and the plane took off in schedule Recommend

In May the new international airport terminal was opened in Fez It is an enormous improvement and upgrade on the previous terminal with a much more spacious and aesthetically pleasing environment In departures security can sometimes be a little slow but there is a clear and effective process which is greatly improved as compared to the old terminal Border checks on both arrivals and departures are much more efficient and swift There is a lounge available as well as pleasant shops and cafes in both arrivals hall and departures An entirely upgraded and pleasant experience travelling tofrom Fez

A small domestic airport on Hamilton Island Queensland Australia very small but tidy and efficient Check in was a breeze and through security very quickly Lots of seating and only a couple of gates as planes restricted to daytime flights only Basic refreshments available and toilets although small were nice and clean You had a nice view of planes landing and parking close to the terminal and could see bags being loaded unloaded and the plane being refueled Very small but pleasant airport to wait for your flight

We were running late due to high traffic in Ayodhya owing to Kumbh Mela Akasa helped us by providing buffer minutes at boarding This helped us in arriving to the flight in time They have ensured that our boarding is faster so that overall flight time wont get delayed As soon as we are seated flight took off within mins This did not result in any delay

Excellent airport with ample space and good architecture Checkin very efficient Immigration officers very friendly because now there is a small machine on the left side with which you can evaluate the service of service of the officer from poor to excellent in grades It is true that it doubles as a military airport but you could have a rare sight of military jets standing nearby

Having read earlier reviews of Xiamen Airport I wasnt looking forward to going there and changing from international to domestic First whatever the airline tells you at your point of departure you will have to recheck your bags on to domestic flights and vice versa from domestic to international From international to domestic the signage isnt helpful After collecting your bags go upstairs to the domestic check in area and recheck your bag at the transfer desk of your airline Transferring from domestic to international if the international check in section isnt open you just have to hang around until they open the doors There are plenty of cafes and noodle bars Once through the security screening go to the check in desk for your airline and recheck your bag in In fact at my point of departure Changsha they managed to check my bags through to Amsterdam but when I went to the check in desk to pick up my boarding pass for the next leg there was my bag waiting for me to check it in Apart from all that the airport is spacious and pleasant Lots of shops and cafes All the people I approached for assistance spoke good English

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

Arriving here is a potential nightmare especially at the weekends They are just not geared up to handle more than one jet the size of at a time Queues at passport control can stretch almost out to the tarmac and although very friendly and courteous they are so slow Baggage reclaim takes forever and it is just a scrum to try and get through customs On the last trip we were in a queue for customs clearance and the officer in charge of our line just disappeared We had to start all over again

Small airport only serves a couple of airlines Landing process was pretty fast seem the airport does not have air bridges Bags delivered pretty fast Check in at airport was fine many dining options Security check was fast Not sure about transportation options because we were picked up and dropped off by our hotel It is a very sufficient regional airport

We were very pleasantly surprised with our experience in Premium We normally fly Premium Economy on British Airways and this was a far better experience the plane was lovely and new and the crew were much friendlier The premium experience on board is good nice to have additional space and a private section of the cabin and the crew were generous with drinks The food was fine and we were pleased to be served two hot meals on the way out Our checked bags came off very promptly at both ends the Premium labels did seem to make a difference The only slight negative was that our flight left Gatwick late afternoon and the Premium check in line took longer than the normal one as they seemed to give priority to those checking in for next mornings flights Strange but didnt spoil the overall experience

Very clean and well taken care of This airport is served by so many great airlines with diverse destinations I do think that GRR needs more international routes At GRR the airport is not too big so it makes efficient travel Also they have a good selection of shops and stores The airport facility looks really modern and cool for being over years old The only cons is that sometimes it can get a bit crowded and the staff doesnt manage high groups of passengers well Would give an if I could

Needs a proper restaurant Toilets are not up to the hygiene standard and are very congested I am muslim and offer regular prayers but call is very loud need to maintain at comfortable listening Needs further variety of fast food international chains to have a quick meal

Flying from AEP to IGU in Prem Economy I was nervous about what to expect on Aerolineas I have to say that I was really pleasantly surprised once we got on the plane Check in at Business was a breeze Security and Boarding was polite chaos They had two flights going to two locations boarding at the same gate at the same time However the premium economy was great simple but worth the extra The seats were comfortable and clean think that armchair type of seats you use to get in business class Service on this flight was friendly on others it was nonexistant They provided a sandwich and soft drinks The best thing though is on every Aerolineas flight my bags were on the carousel as I arrived there They have some amazing expedited system to get premium bags off which is great

I recently had the opportunity to experience the new terminal at Kempegowda International Airport in Bangalore and I must say it is a remarkable addition to the citys infrastructure Design and Ambiance The terminal boasts a stunning architectural design that blends modern aesthetics with traditional Indian elements The spacious layout is filled with natural light thanks to large glass facades The use of local materials in the design adds a unique touch making the environment both inviting and reflective of Karnatakas heritage Facilities One of the standout features of the new terminal is its stateoftheart facilities From efficient checkin counters to wellorganized security checks the entire process felt streamlined and userfriendly The wide range of shopping and dining options is impressive offering everything from local delicacies to international brands I particularly enjoyed the curated selection of souvenirs that showcase local artisans Technology The incorporation of technology is commendable Free WiFi charging stations and selfcheckin kiosks make the travel experience more convenient The digital displays for flight information are clear and easy to navigate which is essential in such a busy hub Sustainability What truly sets this airport apart is its commitment to sustainability The use of rainwater harvesting systems and solar energy reflects a forwardthinking approach to airport management which is vital in todays context of climate change Accessibility The airport is wellconnected with ample transportation options including taxis buses and ridesharing services The ease of access from the city makes it a practical choice for travelers Overall Impression In summary the new terminal at Kempegowda International Airport is a remarkable blend of modernity functionality and cultural resonance It elevates the travel experience and sets a high standard for airports in India Whether youre a frequent flyer or just passing through this airport is a pleasant surprise that showcases the best of Bangalore

I left on early BA flight and was very impressed with the helpful staff in the airport check in hours ahead fast empty security and border control Nice airy feel and clean although some cafe prices shocking cost me more than Scandinavian airports euro for potato chips Generally modern and relaxed despite a number of early morning flights and there was a machine where robot gives you jelly beans I like distractions in airports takes your mind off stress BA gate staff helpful and whole experience was stress free compared to disgraceful regional airports in UK

My recent minute flight from DCA to PHL operated by PSA Airlines for American Eagle was a pleasant experience Despite a minor delay while waiting for the crew to arrive from another flight the service was good We were offered a predeparture beverage and even received beverage service during the short flight a nice touch for such a brief journey The CRJ proved to be more comfortable than the CRJ making the quick trip enjoyable For such a short flight theres truly nothing to complain about

The Airport was quiet and everything went really smooth The staff were professional and did not give me a hard time while checking in and during customsimmigration Toilets and lounge were clean and comfortable to use The wifi was also very reliable

Seats in economy cabin very comfortable compared to a lot of airlines The hot meal was of good quality however on a hour flight it was the only hot meal and a small roll before landing You need hot meals on such a long flight we were so hungry when we got off the aircraft Half of the crew were tui Scandinavia crew they were lovely very glam and hard working the uk based crew could learn a lot from these guys The uk based crew on my flight out looked a mess and done the bare minimum and werent very pleasant Drinks were plentiful also which they only served at specific times throughout the flight as I heard them say no to a few people when they asked outside of the service I think this is great stops people getting drunk and annoying on a long flight which makes it more pleasant for everyone The hours went quickly and Id fly with TUI again
Nepal Airlines is a cheap option for direct flights from Nepal with good service Nepal Airlines improved its service over time The cabin crew were professional and meal served was good

Travelled in and out of this Burmese provincial airport early last year arriving from Mandalay and leaving to Rangoon Pretty basic but it was OK and really belonged to another age of flying This because you could wander out onto the runway between planes arriving there werent many and if you wished you could go to your hold luggage which was stacked on a trolley awaiting the planes arrival and put things in or take things out of it Many of the Burmese passengers availed themselves of this facility as our plane was an hour late arriving When its light appeared in the sky on its approach an airport official suggested we all go back into the terminal so we did An airport still in an age of innocence with no apparent need for security of any kind

Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended

The great thing about this airport is its size It is small And that means a short walk from the aircraft through the building and out Baggage reclaim is basic you take it from the baggage truck outside but that is efficient and quick The arrivals area appears unfinished Check in and departure are also quick and easy If you want a drink in a nice bar use the place before the immigration After that there is only a small bar The duty free shop is cheap and quite well stocked There is wireless Internet at the airport but it does not work

Domestic flight AccraTamale hr flight One time in both directions Water juice and snack fish or meat pie savoury biscuits provided on this short flight more than you get on BA domesticEuropean flights three days Friendly and very polite cabin crew Marvellous captain who gave great information about the flight Joint venture between Hainan Airlines China Hahn Airways and Ghanian investors An excellent service which makes domestic travel much easier in Ghana

I had read the worst reviews about NDjili International Airport and did not exactly look forward to the experience of arriving and departing there But my hopes were set on some other articles I had found about a new international terminal that opened end of built by Chinese contractors I must say the new terminal the staff working there and the guarded parking and dropoff areas in front of it are exceptionally good It is a small but very bright and clean building Customs officers are professional and nice to the passengers same applies to security staff at Xray machines and where one must pay for an exit visa when leaving DRCongo Airconditionong works well and there is a nice business class lounge Do not expect any shopping outlets there is only one bar but the latter can easily compare to those in the better European airports Thumbs up for the new terminal hope it stays like it is today The road from the airport to downtown Kinshasa was also completely refurbishes good pavement lighting at night Travel times tofrom the airport to the embassies area of the capital are now only h to be compared to h a few years ago I was said

This airport is vastly improved since the previous comment Ideally situated for the catchment area south of the Humber After nightmare journeys just getting to Manchester Aiport my visits to NZ are now via Humberside and Amsterdam Minimum fuss no crowding a relaxed start to a lengthy trip Additional package flights are now offered and the Amsterdam hub is a definite plus There used to be a direct link to LHR with Air UK but this was discontinued before the demise of the airline and never revived Although not essential could be useful on occasion Landing costs I believe

Arriving and departing from this regional airport is far less stressful than dealing with the airports in Cancun or Mexico City There are fewer passengers of course plus the airport is well organized and clean Checkin was fast and easy and security was well organized courteous and fast There are several places to enjoy a snack or meal before takeoff The waiting area is spacious and uncrowded and offers great views of planes landing and taking off Wifi was free and worked well

FDHTHF Friendly staff clean aircraft with comfortable leather seats Orders for drinks and snacks taken and served individualy Prices on their inflight menu are OK Landing in Berlins Tempelhof airport is a fantastic experience Too bad the airport is due to be closed soon Even with bags to claim aircraft to subway station took less than Minutes Beat that

In the UK it is pretty difficult to get a fullservice airline offering direct flights to anywhere except Heathrow or Gatwick The socalled lowcost carriers dominate Having flown the competition we reluctantly tried Jet for our flights to and from Madeira In many ways Jet proved to be a long rung above the competition kg of checked luggage and kg of hand luggage plus a handbag or laptop bag are included as standard The seats are as you would expect on this type of airline minimalist The cabin crew were friendly and the drinks and food onboard appeared to be reasonably priced I cannot vouch for the quality of the hot or cold food as we did not try it Flights out and back were on time and boarding was smooth and efficient

Just wanted to shout out the excellent customer service and help I received recently at Denpasar Bali airport I stupidly left two bags on the carousal when I went through customs Airport security were very friendly as the guided me through a secure area to go back behind the luggage area to retrieve the bags and customs did not hassle me for going through twice Cant imagine doing this so easily in a North American airport Bali people are great
