As AC has given up this route we again flew with this Lufthansa subsidiary from YYC to FRA and on to Venice Boarding went smoothly as AC staff now handle this aspect for Eurowings which they didnt do last year The plane left and arrived on time which allowed us to make our connection with Lufthansa Cabin crew were very helpful and fluent in both English and German The seating in business class in and the seats were very comfortable As we chose the evening flight we were able to sleep for a number of hours The seats recline into a fully flat position Comfortable blankets and pillows were provided The food was excellent with a choice of three entrees A fairly good selection of movies was available All in all a much better experience than the one we had last year Lufthansa must be having success with this route as there are now two flights daily from YYC to FRA I find it curious that AC gave up this route

Rimini Airport is highly recommended as a way to access the Adriatic Riviera This smaller than average airport is located on the edge of Rimini MiraMare and is well connected to Rimini and the train stations by coach and a local tram service is not far away either The negative aspect is that the lack of clear signs inside the airport for ground transport could be very misleading for newly arrived passengers and lead the newly arrived into the hands of very expensive taxi drivers Rimini Airport has some nice shops and is well set out I highly recommend this airport
Fantastic Ample and clean restrooms Great restaurants Napping rooms available to rent Everyone was kind and assisted as needed They asked me if I needed help Super customer friendly service

On the th of October i arrived at the airport with a Uber rider Shortly after i left i noticed i left my phone in the uber who has driven off My flight was hour and minutes away from departure I tried asking for multiple people within the airport for help if they had the uber app to help me contact the driver as i would not be able to check in to the flight without my phone The kind police security gentleman by the name of Chris kindly helped me contact uber let me use his phone to call the uber driver and with only minutes left for depart kindly helped me through the security queue Honestly a life saver and I couldnt be more grateful for finding this man this day and i would like to once again thank you if you ever read this review

Nice lay out I got to the airport in the morning I just had a bit of some confusion as it was my first flight The automated ticket booths were convenient and quick Security was a breeze No queue the security personnel were nice and polite I didnt feel intimidated The gates are lined up along the back of the building nicely The Tim Hortons was next to my gate Washrooms are clean They even provide you with sanitizing wipes and cleaner to wipe the seat The stalls are private with no big gaps in the stalls Theres tables with outlets to charge your phone Coming back it was alright The luggage carousels are at the main floor where the front doors are

Louisville is actually one of the nicest airports in the United States poundforpound In fact Louisville on steroids gives you an idea of what more of our true international gateways should look like but dont I mean Detroit and Minneapolis are good but LAX and JFK Ill start with the good about Louisville Parking is easy and reasonably priced So easy in fact that its literally at the back door of the terminal and nicely covered for all those inclement weather situations The airport is super clean The personnel are aboveaverage in friendliness some of the security and restaurant staff could learn to smile but its hard for me to recount any particularly rude experiences with personnel The terminal is very Louisville and Kentuckythemed making the airport an unmistakable part of the state of Kentuckys cultural identity Security is usually a breeze even if you dont have TSA PreCheck which I have Its almost immediately next door to the state fairgrounds minutes from downtown and minutes from serene natural areas like Jefferson Memorial Forest The terminals are straightforward and wellsigned The public art is very localspecific and themed and attractively positioned As a bonus the airport is UPS primary North American hub so its neat to see the massive cargo planes regularly flying in and out of there The real drawbacks of flying into and out of Louisville are that baggage claim takes a little longer than it should for a relatively small airport and you have to pay close attention to signage right as youre driving off the property to access the freeways and fairgrounds In summary Its hard to go wrong with flying in and out of Louisville Ive been doing it for years and it just feels almost like putting on a comfortable pair of shoes

Really nice clean small airport in terms of actual experience On arrival my Aer Lingus flight landed slightly ahead of schedule and I was airside within minutes from leaving aircraft door Immigration was a breeze and quick and the person checking passportsIDs was friendly and welcoming On departure security was fast and efficient and staff were relaxed and friendly The departure area is small but has couple of food options given the size and there was decent dutyfree area although I think greater part of this could be allocated to local products especially food given some of the really great quality stuff I had during my stay in Cork Toilets very clean and maintained and gate areas had plenty of seating The thing I loved though is they sell bottles of water for which you can just quickly tap and take from a stand no pricegouging and they have a refill station centrally located if you need refill it before you take off or if you brought your own bottle much better than Heathrow T when I left The only thing that lets this airport down and why I have marked it down is poor information on its website before travelling doesnt look like its been updated since covid and poor transfers from the airport to the city on arrival Taxis are expensive to the city at given the distance Bus to the city is regular service bus not a dedicated airport shuttle is only every half an hour in either direction and you need Leap card or euros no cards accepted This is inconvenient as international visitors wont necessarily immediately have the either of the former to hand I was lucky that a kind stranger on the bus paid for me using their own Leap card as the bus was waiting when I arrived if I had to go to get cash I would have missed it and had to wait half an hour for the next one Once on the bus it isnt clear when you arrive in the city as it is neither announced nor displayed on the electronic board just random street names and the bus runs with the lights off inside so you travel in the dark and it is all rather disorientating The stop in the city is also a random bus stop not the bus station which also makes it unclear where to get it from when you need to return to the airport from the city Im really perplexed why a city that has a lot of tourism has made it so difficultinconvenient for visitors in this respect and its a shame as the experience at the airport itself was excellent
Not as big as Airports in Beijing and Shanghai that it is hard to navigate It is very efficiently run and very clean It is the best midsize international airport in China

Super tiny Airport like a bus terminal in my town but it was a quite clean and cozy place Location is nice not far from city and you can get there from city center by local bus for about euro There were nice sofas inside and the toilet was neat and clean

Gatwick to Larnaca Once you get on the plane all is well The customer service team on the ground not so great They claim they have no managers so the customer service advisors are their own managers Secondly to change your ticket they will only do this by arranging a call back and no other way If you ring to change your ticket they wont put you through to the team that deals with this but instead you need to wait for them to ring you back Very rigid and pretty appalling procedure if you ask me Customer service needs improving Lastly food on the plane could be better Compared to Aegean and British airways Cobalt business class food is economy plus

Gothenburg to Cambridge with SunAir a franchise partner of British Airways Aircraft are painted in British Airways livery and operate under BA flight numbers The flight was only half full making the seat Dornier more like a private jet than a small airliner Full meal and bar service on this hour flight Crew very good

Atyrau to Uralsk I had a few meetings to attend in Uralsk and Aksai and was not looking forward to the hour or more arduous taxi journey from Atyrau to Uralsk in C heat I was recommend to use Qazaq Air as they now have a direct flight from Atyrau to Uralsk I booked a return flight online selected a seat paid via card and my eticket was immediately emailed On arrival to the airport checkin is simple and efficient The flight was serviced by a Bombardier Dash Next Gen aircraft which was very clean and the aircrew well dressed and welcoming The flight h m was very good with a surprisingly powerful takeoff and flight landing mins earlier than scheduled I certainly was impressed with the overall service and the value for money I will be using Qazaq air again for direct flights around west Kazakhstan

Very quiet and peaceful airport well equipped with benches places to sit and even lie down It is not a large airport so the catering facilities with shops are small but sufficient Very nicely designed areas where you can sit and experience Finnish nature For the first time I see an airport where you can relax physically and mentally It is also a bit cold it perfectly reflects the climate of Finland It does not heat up excessively and there is a delicate chorus which can be annoying at first but after some time you get used to it

Air Belgium for Srilankan Airlines Uncomfortable business class seat looks well used only good thing was the massage function Mix of crew from Air Belgium and Srilankan mostly friendly Food was tasty and filling a good variety to chooses from Toilet wasnt overly clean

Nice and efficient airport Security and passport controls are quick and smooth and makes the airport easy to travel to and from Good connections for transfers to other airport in Norway or Europe Easy access to Trondheim with airport train buses or taxi Brand new Radisson SAS hotel adjacent to terminal A

Flew from Prague to Rome Ciampino return with both flights spot on time noting that both legs were fully booked without any empty seats onboard No checked in baggage so headed straight to the gate The Ryanair mobile App is helpful apart from the nagging up selling but its understandable Its great boarding passes can be saved viewed in Google Wallet Boarding was managed well in PRG and CIA even with the full of passengers with Prague being strict on carry on luggage sizes as some fellow travellers were being a bit cheeky The cabin crew on my return flight were especially superb and professional with a smile Both legs were on a Boeing s I suspect there are no Max stationed in Prague One had an updated interior with slim seats and notably much more comfortable esp Legroom than the other although both were in top condition including cleanliness This product is ideal hassle free for quick flights around Europe

We arrived on Monarch which was a great flight from London Gatwick on arrival to Mahon we swiftly disembarked into a very cool air conditioned Arrivals lounge where bags took no more than minutes to reach the conveyors Everything else went smoothly and we proceeded to car rental so all in all I estimate we were on are way to Villa less than an hour of arriving On the return had no problems at check in had a polite and friendly check in lady Aircraft was on time All in all a very good experience of Mahon airport from start to finish

CAA replacement for Thomas Cook flight repatriation back to the UK after firms collapse Staff were excellent plane a little dated but clean and spacious also under subscribed Comfortable great service thank you all

Flew Solomon Airlines from Brisbane to Honiara We boarded to be greeted by smiling attendants The flight was not too full so we had seats to ourselves Leg room was quite good IFE was just a screen panel lowered from the ceiling watched a movie The meal was lunch we had the beef and it was delicious Staff came around to check if we needed any more drinks throughout the flight

Stockholm Bromma to Malm Sturup Very friendly cabin crew and good service This is the only airline in Sweden that serve free meals during domestic flights The plane were clean and the seats were of standard model I will fly with Malm Aviation whenever I go to Stockholm again Best domestic airline so far
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

I have flown Porter on other occasions and have many good experiences I was supposed to travel with them in April but due to an accident I would not be able to with upcoming doctor and Physio appointments The customer service representative Erin was phenomenal She listened and asked questions as to address my issue with regards to my upcoming flight I am now able to have time to heal myself and take my flight at a later date Thank you Erin and Porter

We use the BA lounges here to avoid the horrendous crowds everywhere in the terminals This airport needs at least two more terminals to offer the space and experience many of its rivals offer When we landed at Terminal we had another interminable wait for our luggage Not a great experience again Id recommend it only because it is better than the other London airports

This is an efficient and wellequipped airport For travellers on AA beware that ground staff and security dont seem to communicate The security channel for US departures remained closed until beyond the scheduled time of departure with no explanation given The departure boards didnt show that there was a minute delay and instead left all boarding passengers to wait outside the secure area This seems to be a specific AA problem

On arrival the airport was very clean There was water fountains and music It was very peaceful When we departed checkin was so easy and security was simple There were lots of shops and dutyfree Overall One of the best airports in the world

A small airport right in the east of the city center with a convenient metro connection readily available The terminal itself is small but well organized and has enough small shops for food and beverages Security queuing times late in the evening were nonexistent border control only inbound was equally fast Best airport if youve to be in London itself

Flew Flybe on the Belfast to Amsterdam route and was pleasantly surprised on the CheckIn Boarding and inflight service The inflight service is just Tea Coffee Juice and some biscuits however the overall service was very good For such a small aircraft there were cabin crew onboard The overall ambience of the aircraft was very good and clean The cabin crew kept cleaning toilet after anyone had used it I was very happy with the flight and service

Burbank provides a convenient and easy alternative to LAX although the departure hall in Terminal B is too small to accommodate more than flights at a time There were flights an MD a and CRJ regional jets boarding simultaneously and the small space and cramped conditions caused confusion and delayed boarding for everyone

Hargeisa to Djibouti Air Djibouti operates one single Boeing leased with crew from a company in Tajikistan as well as reportedly a few smaller aircraft We flew from Hargeisa to Djibouti in November The plane had arrived from Mogadishu with a delay but landed in JIB almost on time It was definitely at least years old but appeared to be in a very good state of repair Seats were tight but comfortable Catering consisted of a single bottle of water which was ok on this min hop Okay was also our general impression

Fortaleza Praia February The flight was operated in a reasonable B by no means new but not as rickety as I had been led to believe The seating was alleconomy and the leather seats fine but slippery Seat pitch was OK and I am a tall chap certainly an inch or more greater than its competitors The flight departed minutes late at and due to the hour I declined the meal offered which looked bland but edible We arrived in Praia on schedule and my bags did the same connecting to Sal and Mindelo without delay All in all a reasonable experience

Dusseldorf to Berlin Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings EW Flight had a slight delay of minutes Flight was smooth and good Seat was fine with enough legroom Food and drinks for puchase crew was just average

The service was good everything that I ordered came in a minute or less and all my needs were attended to Free snacks of hot fudge and tea Fast and there were no delays not late for take off or landing Really recommend thanks for a great flight I am really happy

This review covers only interisland travel On the whole it works pretty well The carousel checkin is OK I recommend printing your boarding pass in advance so its easier to access your reservation number First Class is a breeze Customer service if you need to make a change is very helpful although sometimes overwhelmed for the number of customers and the logistics could be improved TSA has always been swift especially if you have PreCheck and Ive found the agents to be friendly Departure gates could use more seating but boarding has always been prompt and efficient for my flights Arrivals are a breeze although sometimes it takes a bit longer for luggage to arrive The lounge is nothing special but clean and nice to use if you have access I usually only take a carryon and on the whole things work well

This is an excellent new airline everything was perfect from the checkin to boarding onboard experience meals video entertainment the flight and baggage retrieval All the staff were friendly and very helpful Will definitely choose this airline again At Chiang Mai the airline uses the Thai Airways lounge

Albury is a pleasant airport The staff are kind and knowledgeable There are gates departure and arrival The lines are short but it is still good to get in early The seats in the boarding lounges are somewhat comfortable When it comes to security its okay The airlines that you need to go through security for are Qantas and Virgin Australia but not Regional Express The terminal is clean especially the toilets The caf is overpriced but the food is ok The only shopping in the terminal is the caf Unlike most airports it is almost impossible to get lost in ABX The only drawback is that to get to and from the terminal to or from the plane you have to walk across the tarmac Out of all the airports I have been to ABX has been the best

I have to say I was quite impressed with this place The two terminals are easy to navigate and there is plenty of space Plenty of retail if such is your thing an I enjoyed my Stella as I waited for my next leg One thing I really liked is the ability to get WhatsApp updates for your flight schedule checkin gate departure gate etc I hadnt seen this before Surprised that all the announcements are in English

Flew Amsterdam Schiphol to Marseille via Strasbourg Hop has good service and comfort levels for a regional airliner Their inflight announcements in English need some work though On my flights I was on an Embrear which has an odd seating arrangement of The seats were comfortable and not cramped The flights were staffed by a single cabin manager but they handled the job of getting everyone onboard and serving a complementary drink with a snack on each leg well Their inflight announcements in English were completely incomprehensible however as were the recorded announcements in English as well Since I dont speak French I just hope they werent telling me anything important On one leg of my flight there was a brief delay but this was communicated in a timely manner

I arrived at the airport from London Heathrow and travelled via Beijing On arrival at Terminal it was nearing pm and I had been travelling for over hours I wanted to get a taxi to the hotel and go to bed However none of the ATMs in the terminal accepted any of my debit cards I have had trouble in the past in rural areas but never at an international airport I was told to go to terminal one which had international arrivals and try there Fortunately the shuttle bus was free and I go to terminal Only one of the ATMs there which also happened to be the last one I tried accepted my card with one other machine down At other Chinese airports Beijing and XiAn Xingang they have always had ATMs from the big four banks Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Bank of China China Construction Bank Agricultural Bank of China I have never had a problem getting cash from these banks I would also note that the underground station just outside terminal one has multiple big four ATMs and is an excellent way to travel into the city I finally got to my hotel at midnight I wrote to the Airport while in China but never received a response

I wasnt very impressed by the staff The two woman on duty did not appear to be helping visitors much Several of us didnt know which queue to join to go through passport control When I finally got there it was like questions They made me feel like a criminal Is this your first time in Cyprus Do you have house here Where were you in As if anyone can remember that I assured them it was my first visit to the island After some discussion between two if them they eventually stamped my passport and one of them slammed it down onto the counter I know they have to do their job but it wasnt very welcoming and they didnt have to be so rude

Decent sized airport with friendly staff Arrivals area was pretty small but the airport itself was well connected to the city with the bus service running just a few steps outside the arrivals I travelled during the peak holiday season so was dreading departure from Glasgow but I was pleasantly surprised as the security was well managed and we went through smoothly The restaurants were bearing the brunt of the holiday season with not enough seating but it was still nice nonetheless

As the previous reviewer noted Eilat airport terminal is in the centre of the city and surrounded by hotels I didnt believe the taxi driver for a few seconds when he dropped us there Once inside we got a thorough grilling by security and our bags swabbed throughout for explosives I think we got extra attention as foreigners but the female security official was very friendly and jovial much nicer that the humourless officials who you normally meet Checkin and hand baggage checks were quick and easy as the only flight was our seater Arkia departure There is a shopcafe on both landside and airside parts but we didnt get a chance to try either Overall it does the job well just be prepared for the security

Checkin at Gatwick Airport was smooth and efficient The airline uses the No Lounge which is nothing special but with comfortable seating and is WiFi more than adequate Boarding was done quickly and the cabin crew was super diligent in helping each of the passengers find their seat and stow their baggage Although the business seats on this were not new they had ample storage space the flat bed was comfortable and everything worked The food was well presented but tasted a little bland and the cabin crew were extremely quick in removing trays when passengers had finished The WiFi on the aircraft was patchy at best and being Chinese quite a few sites seem to be blocked Running a VPN actually made it quicker with no blocked sites There were a few Western movies but the choice was limited Loos were spotless Overall I have no complaints and would happily fly with the airline again

Odessa to Kiev return Plane a rather old Boeing but for such short trips under hour is not a problem I was surprised to see that they offered sandwiches on both flights together with tea coffee and juices

Hong Kong to Hanoi Regional flight Hong Kong toHanoi January on an A aircraft Ticket included free services and luggage Hot meal given was OK Flight full on time Nice clean aircraft Seats were good but space to front seat was horrible and extremely tiny small de facto painful to knees CheckIn in Hong Kong was quick and easy though my handluggage was double the limit Checked in luggage arrived smoothly checked by customs in Hong Kong who had left a note inside the bag Airbridge provided at both ends

I had a great experience flying with Cyprus Airways The flight was smooth and comfortable making the journey enjoyable I was impressed with the ground checkin team who were kind and supportive Thank you for the excellent service

Fantastic service from bag drop to landing and getting my baggage on the other end All staff played their role in providing the excellent customer service It was an early morning flight and it was really nice to start the day on the right track

Security was super helpful As we were passing through security someone stole my wifes Apple Watch from the box after we went through the Xray We immediately notice it was missing and reported it Security checked the cameras and found the thief Using the image from the cameras they tracked down the passenger and recuperated our watch All this within minutes Amazing

Seoul Incheon to Tokyo Narita with Easter Jet This was a low cost airline but everything was fine Check in took five minutes I paid extra for a bulkhead seat and it was worth it The seats were quite narrow but bearable for a two hour flight There was just a small drinks run and no food available but as it was only a two hour flight it was acceptable

Victoria Falls boasts a nice new terminal building that is uncluttered and pleasant I arrived for a flight to Addis Ababa and was immediately impressed with the pleasant surroundings of the terminal and its air conditioned comfort Check in procedures were swiftly handled and passengers then move on to clear security and immigration which are straight forward save for the fact that one has to deal with the nuisance of removing his shoes at security Following security one takes an elevator up to the departure level where there a number of shops very expensive shops and food outlets All of these were clean and presentable Restroom facilities were wellmaintained and clean Boarding was accomplished via an air bridge directly into the plane Surprisingly Victoria Falls International Airport is very straight forward and easy to negotiate Staff are friendly and helpful I feel that anyone traveling through Victoria Falls airport will have no difficulties or issues

Arrival was easy and bags arrived quickly waived through health control and landside within minutes departing again no issues although the airport was busy with the evening departures there was plenty of security checkpoints open and plenty of staff each employee at the airport I encountered was helpful and friendly once through security there is a excellent Duty Free and several restaurantsbars along with a small selection of shops

Me and a few friends flew to the Dominican Republic in August and the experience upon arrival was outstanding The immigration service was fast and most shops where open The staff help us with our bags and had us out in no time On our way back it was the same very friendly staff no delays food was great on the terminal shops

It was my first time at this small and beautiful airport Very wellmaintained and nicely decorated airport The downtown and hotel areas are not too far Staffs were friendly Outside of the airport is also environment friendly and green

Pros The flight attendants were kind and helped us with the wifi for minutes Very helpful mindful and demure The food was great I was not expecting that Legroom was wonderful Me being m there was easily lots of legroom Theseat was hard IFE sucked and dirty floors

Two years on from my last report and improvements continue to happen The check in area has been updated making for a comfortable experience and the new TSA security area is large and works efficiently A new hotel is now connected directly to the terminal Staff as usual friendly and helpful Forced to deduct one point for the lack of baggage carts If they are there they are well hidden

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

Bangkok to Yangon retjurn in midMay This is my first experience with this airline and it did not disappoint The checkin at the airport for both flights were uneventful efficiently handled and most notably having little or no queues which is always a welcomed sight when there are snaking queues at neighbouring counters for other airlines The boarding for the outgoing flight started a little after the scheduled time The planes do not have any seatback entertainment units but for the outgoing flight there was onboard wifi which allow you free access to a selection of movies and TV shows on the MAI app which can be preloaded onto phones Ipads etc The selection was limited For a min flight it is impressive that the cabin crew is able to come round with wet tissues followed by a meal and drinks service The cabin crew were polite and cheerful The captain made announcements regularly which were spoken in clear English

I arrived from Phnom Penh and then departed to Bangkok On arrival at the domestic airport there was no air bridge and it was a very short walk to the main building It took a while for the luggage to come out but luckily the arrival area was not crowded Departed from the international terminal to Bangkok The terminal was new and clean and check in staff very friendly and helpful There was only one security line open but the queue wasnt too long After security there were few shops and a great Plaza Premium Lounge if you fly Bangkok Airways they also offer their own lounge The Plaza Premium lounge was quiet well design and spacious Overall a great and smooth departure experience

YYZAMSYYZ Legroom was okay got the exit row on the way back Food decent for a charter Seat width normal unlike Air Transat they dont squeeze an extra row of seats in I didnt feel the need to upgrade to Economy plus The personal entertainment device portable hard drive with monitor was great Worth the euro on the day flight back
An old Fokker departure and arrival on time very smooth landing proficient bilingual staff and excellent food omelette with herbs coleslaw and chicken

Arrived into Grand Cayman from Miami on Saturday night Immigration took minutes and bags were already off the belt when we came into baggage hall Only recommendation is a larger canopy by car pick up point as needed during heavy downpour we got very wet On departure took minutes from arrival to check in and clear customs check Limited seats at gates but more seats to right hand side as you enter departure lounge A bit warm but not too bad More space needed by desks at each gate as gets crowded Food and shopping limited but sufficient Few restaurants and duty free but food items very expensive Boarding is via walk to plane which is great if weather is good Passengers were crowding the gate before Boarding Zones were called All in all a good airport experience at a small airport
Flew on th April on day visit to Amsterdam on business Lovely small airport staff friendly good bacon rolls in the cafe A very pleasant relaxing experience

Boarding an A was a unique experience and you will enjoy a pleasant flight thanks to the spaciousness and comfort The cabin crew were admirable and friendly the food was good and delicious Highly recommended

Flew flybe BE Belfast to Amsterdam on October th Checkin opened hours prior to departure and the check in process was very efficient Boarding was called minutes prior to departure and the boarding process was also fast and efficient The onboard cabin crew were outstanding and very helpful throughout the flight and we landed minutes ahead of the scheduled time There is not a full catering service onboard however teacoffee and snacks are provided free of charge Overall I was very happy with flybe service on this Belfast to Amsterdam fight

Recently returned from a return trip to Florida with Thomson and as per usual they were fantastic Aircraft was a month old DreamLiner and its such a brilliant plane Im ft and the legroom was perfect with plenty of space unlike years ago when my knees were jammed into the seat infront Decent choice of movies and a few games to play which kept us occupied as our tablets had to be in hold luggage do to the US Ban The crew both ways were friendly and attentive the free drinks were plentiful and it was never an issue getting more if required The food both ways was fine and wiped the floor with what Ive had on our Flag Carrier during the past year The return flight was the same aircraft as the outbound leg and we landed into Gatwick hour early after a smooth overnight flight I really cant fault Thomson in anyway I fly long haul a lot and the larger airlines dont even come close We are already booked on them again to Barbados in February

Took a short flight from Paris to Vienna and the flight was delayed due to unknown reasons The aircraft was clean crew members were welcoming I didnt expect free meals from low cost airline but was served sandwich and drinks I hesitated while booking a flight with Niki but it was a nice short journey apart from little delay will consider in future

Thoroughly workmanlike return flights Johannesburg to Cape Town Cabin crew were efficient and personable Seats AC had adequate leg room Food was adequate and it was helpful to see the three main courses before choosing one Both flights arrived ahead of schedule

Boarded by bus on an distant location AN on a very good condition crew was young people friendly and eager to help passengers to place carryons to the bins Legroom was tight I was lucky my next seat was left empty and the flight was barer able We departed on time min after departure they served coffee no free and hours within the flight they served lunch from Buy on board Menu Flight was full and almost all passengers transferring to North American destinations

Great experience using Norwich airport Efficient and cheerful checkin personnel Compact WH Smith outlets land and airside Fast friendly and helpful security people Sweet little duty free Great hotcold snacksdrinks areas Lots of seating with airfield and runway view Downside was no development fee spent on arrivals Walk from aircraft hoping its not raining then queuing under draughty plasticcovered outside waiting area before clearing customs Not good TIP On arrival phone whoever is picking you up to let them know youve arrived its best if they wait for you away from the airport Most planes arrive late so the minute parking fee becomes

We had a really good experience at Luton Started well with the official meet greet parking in Car Park this is clearly signposted and we were met by a very pleasant and helpful gent quite a contrast with our rather dismal Heathrow experience in May It was a short walk to bag drop in the terminal which was also done quickly and on to security This was a real standout with short queues and friendly staff No need to remove liquids computers and so on and they do a fullbody scan for everyone that saves the palaver of being beeped by a standard gate and going for the full scan My bag was selected for extra checking that was swift and polite It took about minutes from car park to airside where we found plenty of decent options for breakfast All in all a very positive start to our holiday

Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen to Cairo and back A comfortable and cost effective alternative airline to use between Istanbul and Cairo Its quite an acceptable airline especially considering the price is about half of its main competitors prices The check in process seemed a bit slow at SAW the flight was a bit late to depart but arrived on time into Cairo Terminal On both flights the crew were friendly and helpful and the cabin interior of the former Air Arabia A was clean and tidy The meals served were nice with a selection of non alcoholic drinks available This airline arrives into and departs from Cairo Terminal which is an older smaller terminal that seems to have mainly flights to and from the Middle East During busy periods it was very crowded in the small terminal On the return flight the check in was again slow at Cairo Terminal Passport Control confusing make sure you check which queue to join as the Turkey flights have separate counters for passportimmigration Overall a good experience when taking into account the cost saving Down side is perhaps a bit more time spent waiting in the Cairo Terminal and flying into and out of the less popular airport in Istanbul

Sarajevo Airport is very small and very manageable After you enter the main building there are check ins Afterwards you have to go to the first floor where is one departure hall with or departure gates There is plenty of seating they also have big beanbags for seating which can be quite fun and relaxing There is only one bar with snacks and one shop If you are travelling with children the signs for baby changing room is misleading after you follow the signs there is no baby room You have to follow the signs for the bathroom for disabled If you wait for a long time you might get very bored

Palonegro to Cucuta with Easyfly Was put on this flight after Satena cancelled one of the legs I was hesitant since I had to make it to CUC that day The JS are quite small yet efficient planes Easyfly ground staff at Palonegro was quite helpful and professional Flight was smooth and punctual No complaints at all Despite the short duration of the flight minutes refreshments were offered Would consider it if needed

First time to travel with airBaltic I flew AMSRIX then RIXVNO and finally TLLAMS as part of my Baltic trip I was impressed with the aircrafts and their cleanliness of interior All flights left on time and there was smooth boarding Seats are comfortable and I loved the fact they still have the inflight magazine No inflight individual entertainment screens Food was for purchase which was on for those short flights The only negative thing was on the TLLAMS sector bathrooms were not clean Its not the airline fault but they should have checked it And when we arrived in AMS disembarkation took forever as we were waiting for the buses thats the airport staff fault But overall was a lovely experience

This is a small yet spacious airport with two terminal piers jutting out in a Y shape There were ample seating space plug points to charge your phones and also an enclosed section with desks and chairs to do any work on your computer Large glass windows afforded views of the runways and let sunlight stream in Bathrooms clean TSA security was thorough Check in counters are opened a couple of hours before a flight and I found the staff friendly Car rental booths are in the baggage conveyor belt section and long term parking is just outside the terminal as are the parking lots for rental cars minimal walking required Very easy and fast entry and exit intoout of terminal Driving directions to airport were clearly marked Only a couple of shopsstores for food and drinks A selection of Wisconsin beer was available in the restaurant but not my favorite Leinenkugel Overall a very pleasant airport

Used Hamilton Airport as an alternative airport to Toronto A much smaller airport than Pearson a good thing resulting in much less walking and waiting and much easier to get in and out of A great option if youre visiting Southern Ontario or Niagara Falls if you want to avoid the Toronto traffic and is km from downtown Toronto Not the greatest airport for public transit links to Hamilton and Toronto and beyond likely due to the airports small size Airport was slightly built on the cheap has exterior siding and drop celling interiors reminding me of a bus terminal and has very limited foodshopping options Despite these minor complaints overall a good alternative to Pearson for direct flights and would use it again

Ground staff friendly and professional Limited facilities at Albrook Airport but functional Couldnt do online check in but was smooth at the airport Older plane but was on time and smooth flight No real on board service so take your own snack or drink after airport security Flight was only mins so not a problem Plane does have a toilet Its not like flying a major international airline but its a short flight and was a good experience They even gave us umbrellas to walk to the plane as it had started to rain which was a nice touch Id seen other negative reviews so was pleasantly surprised how professional and polite their staff were Id use them again Its difficult to rate the actual on board service because there really isnt any no entertainment or food drinks but its such a short flight its not that relevant So I base my score on the overall experience Good service and on time flights with friendly staff but in flight service not really offered

LAN is a true premium airline Flew in their Premium Business from MilanMalpensa to So Paulo Guarulhos late night and the service was fantastic Had only hand luggage because it was a short trip As soon as I got onboard I was welcomed and escorted to my seat by the purser Immediately I was offered a glass of champagne Other offers were Pisco Sour and water Dinner orders were taken quickly and served promptly after the take off Their business class cabin has the configurartion of which is good if you have company If not you might find yourself sitting to a stranger for hours I had this several times and the comfort was still good My breakfast order was taken seriously I got everything I wanted I need to emphasize this because there are other premium airlines who fail to arrange the breakfast according to customers wishes The crew just seem to enjoy their jobs and you can see that the service is personal you get addressed by your name and you pay business class but you get almost first class treatment LAN is always a great choice and will always stick to them

Small airport with basic but sufficient facilities Upon arrival airport staff welcomed passengers and provided a small bag of local snacks which was a nice touch Outbound processing was fine with courteous and friendly staff in security Checkin queue took a bit longer than normal for a regional ATR flight Room for improvement on this but ground staff very friendly and helpful

Leon Bajio to Puerto Vallarta Punctual airline Small plane but confortable for a minute flight and very clean Excellent service and good attitude of ground staff and flight attendants They offer you a small snack on board free of cost The check in process at the airport was quick because the airplane has a passenger capacity

I dont know what they call it an International Airport because it doesnt look like one Its a small airport and the only positive thing that I can say is that it was clean the rest is all negative People doesnt speak English The customer service is really bad they werent friendly at all the people were mean and rude Theres no restaurants just two coffee shop and one kiosk and two ATMs According to New York Times Panama is one of the best destinations for tourism and I agree that it is a beautiful country However they need to work on the facilities customer service and improve their languages skills because they could loose tourists and clients just for these points that I mentioned before

We flew Jeju Air which is Korean Low cost airline for the first time The first flight was from Bangkok to Seoul and the second flight was from Busan to Bangkok The checkin at Bangkok is quite good and smooth but checkin at Busan is not smooth as the ground staff was not friendly and seemed to be inconsiderate Both flight was ok and the seat was not bad for low cost airline not so cramped and leg room is good though we flew over hours Cabin crew were friendly eventhough they served us only a cup of water which is understandable Both flight was not delay and the flight from Busan arrived ahead of schedule Overall it was a good flight both way

Yangon Terminal is very nice It is not too large immigration may be slow but they are friendly Atmosphere is modern clean and nice including good restroom Check in counter are totally empty at the time of my departure Once can spend minutes for check in process and wait at a few nice cafe they have noted that you cant find anything to eat after passing immigration

Bydgoszcz airport is very small but there are many people traveling through it daily There are no shops only one cafe and newsagents both in the duty free area Security checks are usually fast and check ins go smoothly This city would benefit from a much bigger airport and hopefully it will soon have one

With flights starting at around USD between Seoul and Yantai Shandong Airlines proved to be the cheapest option beating Asiana China Eastern and Korean Air Given the price I was a little hesitant to believe the service to be of a high level however I was pleasantly surprised I was given a friendly greeting in English on boarding crew holding a basket of sweets for passengers to take as they headed to their seat For the rest of the flight the crew seemed to conduct their service pleasantly with a smile On the outbound flight to China apple chips and bottles of water were offered however on the return leg a delicious hot meal was offered consisting of a sweet and sour type meat dish with rice Highly surprising considering the flight time was less than an hour Interestingly on both flights the captain performed a detailed speech in Chinese and English Despite the fact that the Boeing was several years old it was fitted with Boeings Sky interior and its interior seemed to lack any signs of wear and tear The interior including the toilets appeared to have been cleaned well The seats were comfortable and had ample legroom for the short flight The IFE onboard consisted of overhead screens these played the moving map on the outbound flight at Mr Bean on the return journey Overall a good journey

Berlin to Paris Flight on time clean and modern plane It was impossible to buy any drinks due to an issue with their visa machine The crew was ok but they could smile a bit more At Orly airport we had to disembark by bus which took minutes to finally be at the south terminal

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station

Nice and small airport at El Alto La Paz The process to get my bags was average in time and customs was friendly and polite There are a few cafes and a couple of restaurants I could see Ground transpiration is readily available by taxi or minibus The airport is not a big building but it has wifi it is clean and has many standard services

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again

Norman Manley KIN is an airport of two halves Arrivals is a bit shambolic We arrived on a and people had to be ferried in a variety of minibuses and coaches to the arrivals hall Following that queuing for immigration took over an hour even with most of the desks open The arrivals area is shabby but will be updated shortly The baggage collection is also a novelty with cases pilled up and scattered across the arrivals hall near customs Departures is totally different A modern light and attractive area with well marked check in desks and orderly waiting Beyond the fairly efficient security checks is a relaxing lounge with many retail outlets of both Jamaican and international food and goods

Efficient and helpful service from reservations to ground staff and cabin crew You feel like you matter as a customer and are very accommodating with any changes Food and Beverage selection on domestic route is fantastic nice to have that surprise option Would I fly again of course yes Well done Thai smile airways staff and crew

Always great and good value for money No issues with delayed flights and a smooth journey overall Friendly staff and onboard service even on super short flights eg Bangkok to Trat At Trat airport they also have complimentary snacks and drinks

From the first step of the airplane at Koh Samui Airport I felt that I was in a tropical paradise It was not a standard airport bus but a train of small wagons painted in bright colours Airport is a complex of many small buildings in Thai style connected by open galleries A lot of open space just covered with roof from rain Many trees and flowers Even an aquarium in WC There are minibuses for transfer to Samui hotels and of course you can take an individual taxi with fixed price

We took a TAME flight to Baltra Galpagos Checkin was very easy with very short queues and very clear instructions given how to get to your gate For the Galpagos Islands you are required to go through a host of quarantine checks and you are required to pay US per person to receive a certificate Without such a certicate you will be unable to board nor will you be allowed past the passport control at Baltra The airport terminal is very organised and gates are well spaced Great airport Also when arriving in Baltra you are required to pay an additional entry fee of US
Wonderful crew on this very short flight The aircraft comfort better than the ATR which is the main BW commuter No service on this minute hop but all in all great value and on time

CPTGBE GBEJNB First flight a clean Bae in very good condition half empty with loads of leg room Food excellent for an airline and service find Second flight on an equally clean ATR with equally good snacks All flights on time Much prefer them to SAX or Airlink

We had quite a lot of time to kill in this airport and it didnt disappoint There was a restaurant right in the middle of the terminal that was delicious and decently priced Unfortunately the wifi was not working no matter how many times we tried but they had this nice area called the library we sat in that was pleasant and helped the time pass

I traveled with people from NYC We entered the airport and had no problems coming in Pretty fast service with immigration and getting our bags Outside was rather chaotic Too many men standing around to carry bags They should control them better maybe like cabs take turns as requested On the way out we found the airport entrance very clear Our bus pulled up and emptied better than it could in JFK It was comforting to see the UN security team right outside The building was well air conditioned which was great The ticketing area was easily accessible We found that there was a ton of security checks not sure why as it seemed to be for baggage mostly We had our IDs checked times and our bags screened twice We were told at the ticket area that once inside there were no rest rooms That was not completely true There is a rest room area inside TSA but before the final jetBlue secure gate area baggage screening Also the signs for the duty free shop inside could have been betterhigher to see Overall it was not horrible but just a little cramped in feeling and the double check of the bags while offering a feeling of security sent red flags up as to why they were doing that It seemed like a jetBlue thing as Spirit did not do that Also the place was clean

Very small airport with very limited facilities I am amazed that this is an international airport If you are stuck in this airport for a few hours there is nothing to do However check in and security a breeze and seems very organised

I would like to express my sincere gratitude and appreciation Excellent service made me spend a pleasant and unforgettable time during my air journey First of all I would like to thank you for the safe and comfortable travel environment you provided me Throughout the flight the crew members maintained a high level of vigilance and professionalism Their smiles warm greetings and meticulous care made me feel the warmth of home

We flew to Cairo from our Sharm elSheikh resort as many others did in order to tour the capital city of Egypt The aircraft was very comfortable and seemed quite new They offer great catering for the one hour flight Couldnt fault it

I was very impressed with the experience at Riga Airport So fast through security and no problems with my Japanese hair sticks which look like weapons on xrays Pleasant staff too which makes a real change Wish I could say the same for UK airports Good range of shops and helpful staff but some of the cafes are very expensive just for coffee and cake Slightly let down by toilets and desolate area C after passport control but generally very impressed compared to some nightmare experiences in the UK
Excellent also it is not as large as other mainly international airports it is the largest airport in Shandong province There are many attractive airlines and aircrafts in this airport

I have never experienced such patience ever since I started travelling I became late because as we got to the airport my year old son fell and injured himself and had to take care of him The two ladies working at the boarding gate that afternoon called me twice to check up and make sure we got onto that flight and waited until the last minute before they closed check in I was in awe of their patience and care for me as a passenger this has never happened to me before especially to go to the extent of calling me Genuinely grateful and can never thank them enough We need more of this kind of understanding with airlines Best flying experience ever

WestJet from Calgary to London Heathrow was excellent The flight attendant introduced herself by name and provided a warm welcome Remembered customers names as well A very decent sparkling wine and hot towels were served before take off Menu choices were good and dinner was quite tasty Breakfast options were far better than on other carriers There was a good choice of wines poured generously IFE system was pretty standard Seats comfortable Overall the quality of the premium economy product on WestJet is far superior to Air Canadas and better than British Airways

Just wanted to shout out the excellent customer service and help I received recently at Denpasar Bali airport I stupidly left two bags on the carousal when I went through customs Airport security were very friendly as the guided me through a secure area to go back behind the luggage area to retrieve the bags and customs did not hassle me for going through twice Cant imagine doing this so easily in a North American airport Bali people are great

AmsterdamCancun bought Comfort Class seats The cabin attendants were friendly food served was a little less good it wasnt bad just average The legroom in Comfort Class was good and other benefits are the complimentary alcoholic beverages and personal media player that you get So overall a satisfying flight

Whilst small and basic its the perfect option for a frequent traveller No queues at check in or security Friendly staff even the security guys are nice No long walks to find your gate Arrive mins before departure travel stress free without the crowds and connect to the world via Schiphol Baggage claim takes minutes Would recommend this airport over flying via Manchester any day unless you enjoy arriving hrs early and shopping

While it is beyond the reach of New York City taxis ISP is five minutes away from Ronkonkoma railroad station in turn a hm train ride to Penn Station This may seem very inconvenient for Newyorkers used to La Guardia airoport but it isnt so bad if compared with JFK The airport is small and efficient There are little or no delays on the ground This field is used primarily by Southwest as its gateway to New York Southwest partner ATA is another visitor while some legacy carriers only offer regional service to their respective hubs or focus cities For those passengers who dont like turboprops be advised that Piedmont Airlines operates from this field with DHCs for Us Airways express while Colgate uses tiny Beechcrafts on flights for Usair express and Continental I find those tiny planes charming but many passengers complain Overall a very pleasant passenger oriented airport

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

We have flown twice into Bermuda and each time were inout in under minutes For an island of just residents I am mightily impressed We really appreciated the smiling and welcoming airport staff along with the friendly curbside taxi operators The new terminal is quite impressive and the signage reflects what is commonly used in other international airports The duty free shops sadly offer no bargain prices In fact alcohol products are cheaper in Hamilton Yes the food offerings in the terminal are quite limited but they do attempt to reflect local culinary tastes While local favorites are mostly featured the prices are high but generally commensurate with elsewhere on the island In fact prices are definitely comparable to any of the NY area airports FACT CHECK Bermuda is an island that largely relies on marine shipments of imported food and supplies including oil and gas Closing Thought I have circled the globe and on reflection choose L F Wade airport as my preferred southern transit stop
Small airport which makes everything easier But going through security was a hassle with lines nothing compared to Beijing though Dont expect much of it given the size Very clean

Bradley is my home airport I fly from and to here multiple times a year to visit friends and family While it isnt as big as the New York airports or Boston fares are usually among the cheapest in southern New England and southeastern New York and BDL provides service to all major eastern hubs such as Atlanta Detroit Cincinnati Charlotte Minneapolis ChicagoORD Washington Philly and Baltimore as well as numerous Florida destinations Las Vegas Denver Toronto Montreal Cleveland Raleigh San Juan Cancun and starting later this year LA and Dublin Ireland Concessions are ample and security is usually manageable in under thirty except some mornings I nearly always fly Delta and their service out of BDL has been fantastic Flights to Salt Lake City Seattle San Francisco and Nashville would be ideal additions

City of Derry is a small regional airport however check in was very straight forward the Logan Air staff were very friendly The security process was a little over the top however it was fast There is a small cafe within the terminal and its servers drinks and snacks which was more than sufficient for the short wait prior to boarding the aircraft Boarding the flight was by seat number however this was orderly and efficient The flight from City of Derry to London takes just over hour The cabin crew are extremely friendly and provided some teacoffee and biscuits After landing the plane was parked in a remote apron however there was a bus to take us to the terminal upon arrival My luggage was also coming out of the carousal by the time we got to the terminal which meant I was on my way to next destination very quickly Overall this is a great service by Loganair from a regional airport

Yangon to Thandwe and pleasantly surprised by Air KBZ Snacks served onboard seats generally comfortable Organisational issues with boarding and a slight delay in departure from Yangon Check in at RGN was not very organised however once inside the departure terminal ground staff were more helpful They give you a coloured sticker to put on your shirt to ensure you get on the correct flight Would use again

Nouakchott to Dakar The new Nouakchott airport is about min from the city and opened only years ago Pretty efficient airport not crowded and only gates The lounge was surprisingly good English spoken fast WiFi and a decent selection of food and beverages Mauritania is a dry country The plane was less then a year old but very poor maintained The whole seating arrangement was mixed up Seat itself was old and relatively clean No welcome drink amenities or InFlight magazine Hot meal was served on a min flight Only coffee was served no other options The toilet had no soap nor towels Many passengers eat their meal with bare hands Crew was friendly but didnt speak English Not flag carrier worthy airline but for African standards pretty cheap and the hard product is pretty new Service in business class to Easyjet economy

Bangkok to Osaka Smooth check in and efficient seat allocation They didnt check cabin baggage weight nor size Had to buy food and drinks as refused internet preorder because we used a travel agent Seats ok but a night flight which was very uncomfortable Saw in the inflight magazine we could upgrade enroute to premium economy a good idea For B a good flight

The airport of Medan has been moved from Polonia to Kuala Namu International Airport KNIA KNIA is now the most advanced and the second largest airport in Indonesia It is also the first integrated airport rail link in Indonesia The whole area is free from smoke means that they provide and manage the smoking area well The baggage claim area is welldesigned Restrooms are always clean and have no pungent smell

We flew from Dubrovnik to Athens and then Athens to Zagreb on Croatia Airlines They were on time within minutes for both flights You drop your bag on the tarmac and they load it into the belly of the plane And then you pick it up directly from the tarmac after the flight so there is very little chance for lost luggage which I like They allow a smaller carryone bag as well They did not weigh our bag or try to charge us for anything extra We were allowed to pick our seats for no charge The seats are standard and comparable to Southwest airlines for leg room and space We were served water and drinks on both flights For the price we paid it was a great deal Some people might be nervous about flying a propeller plane but it was a very smooth flight in both directions with almost zero turbulence and a very smooth landing If you had to fault them for one thing it would be nice to have some in flight entertainment Other than that it was a perfect flight Definitely recommend

Upon arrival at MRV discovered a new arrivals hall since my last visit in October last year Baggage very quick into hall Outside a pleasant array of kiosks should you need anything food wise Departures hall is spotless and some nice Caucasian shops to spend your Rubles in Security quick and easy and departure lounge has a nice cafe and a few more shops A pleasant experience before the hassle of Domodedevo

Toronto City Center while dwarfed in size by nearby Toronto Pearson Airport provides an exceptional experience for travelers Most notable is the terminal cafeteria stocked with free coffee soft drinks and light snacks In an era where nothing seems to be given out for free in air travel it is refreshing to see this at City Center The terminal is designed differently than those at most other airports As opposed to separate waiting areas for each gate there is one central waiting area which serves every gate the airport has gates At first glance the sight is a bit jarring but travelers will feel at ease as they settle in to the comfortable seats with their free snacks City Center is also recommended because of its location Views from within the airport and during approaches are beautiful as the airport is situated over water Lake Ontario Meanwhile the airport is very close to downtown Toronto making transport to and from the airport quick and cheap

I fly into Rimini Airport at least times a year to visit family It is a small airport and the restaurant and shops are expensive I love this airport You cant get lost and the best bit is you can go outside on a very large balcony and watch the planes land take off etc Also great if you smoke You are allowed to smoke only outside I would recommend this airport it is still small and friendly

Santiago de Chile to Isla de Pascua Had the opportunity to fly with LAN from Santiago de Chile to Easter Islands a trip I had been expecting tor a long time Although the LAN web site indicated that you should report to checkin a whole hours before scheduled departure time I decided to play it cool and only arrive at the Santiago airport at for a am flight just to see that checkin was still well in progress without any rush Upon boarding the Boeing I just loved the cabin interior very light and roomy with nice LED lights around When finding my seat I soon realised however how small it was Im sure is the narrowest airplane seat Ive ever seen and the legroom was very short for someone of cm I was happy that I was only going to spend hours and not on this plane However I soon found the IFE which offered a great selection of top recent films certainly far too many for this six hours flight As I hadnt downloaded the LAN application on my tablet beforehand there would have been even a greater choice of entertainment available for this flight Soon after takeoff an excellent breakfast with fresh fruit and an omelette was served During the rest of the flight drinks and coffee were served several times The best part of this flight was however the Chilean LAN cabin crew The steward serving my section was chatting around making jokes and asking several times if I needed something more This is the kind of service I would have expected in First Class but here I was enjoying it in Economy Well done LAN

Toykos nd airport smaller and closer to the city Arrival process OK but suffered from being rather manual with queues for immigration and then passport control despite offering online advanced registration Baggage reclaim quite quick Excellent transport links by bus train or taxi clear signs in Japanese and English Ticket Machines for trains ONLY take cash but do give change and are fantastic value for money Leaving Japan the process is very speedy with Bag Drop etc and then Security and automated passport gates There is a cafe on the Arrivals Level if you arrive too early to checkin or are waiting to be picked up on arrival Within the terminal is the usual array of shops and eating places focused more on the regionallocal travellers rather than the full Duty Free range of goods you might find elsewhere in the region Reasonable seating near the departure gates and overall quite quick turnround of planes

Was on flight with Vietnam Airlines from Hanoi to OsakaKansai on its business class Nothing to complain as ground staff cabin crew were professional and offered the best that they could Seat was comfortable I chose the Japanese breakfast and found that it was somehow delicious Inflight entertainment surprisingly was excellent with new movies and music album No WiFI onboard even in business class which may be something the airline should consider to improve

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

My husband and I traveled to Yellowknife for a day The main reason was that we wanted to visit Buffalo Airways Canadian North were fantastic Both services on time and on the way back to Edmonton we were lucky enough to travel on a Combi which was fantastic The crew on the way home made us feel so welcome They were efficient and very pleasant Great breakfast on the way up and a good dinner on the way back If only they were a bit closer to our home in Australia We would be more than happy to travel with Canadian North any time A great experience

Functioning but nonair conditioned air bridge to terminal Terminal building is easy to navigate and path clearly leads after heading down escalator to baggage pickup Baggage arrives after minimal waiting time of minutes Many people in terminal besides passengers and employees Mainly porters Everyone appears to know everyone else so I guess that security is not an issue Inside and outside terminal many drivers call out offering lifts in carsvans heading to Gorontalo city as airport is to hour from regional capital Fares are negotiable but is the norm Bules may pay more Toilets ATMs and lower end eating facilities as well as souvenir stalls are easily accessible Forget having a drink

Tontouta is a fairly basic international airport There are no skybridges so on arrival you descend the stairs and cross the tarmac to the single terminal and vice versa on departure Customs and immigration are fairly straightforward although a little bit of French will help The airport is a long way from Noumea so it is best to arrange a transfer with your hotel pre booking before you leave is the best Arc en ciel was the best company we thought Heading back out is always a nightmare at Tontouta there is no order for anything Customs is always straightforward when departing Only a small duty free on the other side and only cafe not much to do There are no tv screens or monitors for the flights You just have to rely on the French announcements and a piece of paper at the gate Overall was a good experience and a very good airport for a small tropical island
Iloilo Airport is one of the best and nicest airports that Ive seen Shopping store and a number of restaurants and coffee shops are also available Really amazing

BOSMKE I have flown to and from Mitchell countless times I grew up in Milwaukee and moved back here in June I agree with other reviewers that it is a clean friendly wellrun airport What stuck in my mind was how swiftly and well the baggage is handled I flew Southwest and sat fairly far forward in the cabin walked directly to the baggage claim area and by the time I arrived my baggage was already on the carousel This is something of a record in all of the flights I have experienced over the past few years at the other end is Copenhagen Kastrup in July where I waited close to minutes for the baggage to arrive with my own valise arriving some minutes later There is also a rapid bus to downtown with the stop now just outside the baggage claim area now that renovations of that area are completed There are also a couple of good Bartolotta restaurants on the concourses Piccolo Pizzeria and Nonna Bartolottas which I have enjoyed on previous departures All in all Mitchell is an excellent airport Now all they need is more nonstop flights

Not a bad airport Flew out of Terminal A with American Airlines I thought Terminal B was nicer than Terminal A Plenty of places to eat and view the runway My only complaint was the longish wait at security Other than that San Jose is a very functional airport

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient

I was browsing airfares for a late November trip and I stumbled across a business class fare on JAL for much less than it usually sells for Approx USD for TorontoChicagoTokyoBangkok return YYZ ORD was on AA Considering I usually pay about for economy with my extra golf bag this seemed like a no brainer and I pulled the trigger on that fare the very next day That decision was the correct one Ive just returned from the trip which is an annual one and Ive never crossed half the globe and had it feel so easy A fully lie flat bed all the way except TorontoChicago and a completely private one at that The food was great the service was great the lounges were great check in priority and fast track immigration in TokyoBangkok It was as easy as travel can be Ive flown JAL in economy before and even then I thought it was a superior experience than our local option Air Canada which continues to disappoint every time I recall even in economy the seats were wider fewer total seats across instead of and the meals were better Well business exceeded expectations even after YouTube reviews had set them sky high I have no reservations about wholeheartedly recommending them If I were to nitpick and I was fully expecting it as everyone seems to mention it is that the cabin is kept too warm So I packed shorted and a tshirt for sleeping in It was manageable

We travelled to Dubrovnik out of season so unsure what it would be like during the summer season when it is significantly busier What we did experience was a very clean modern stateoftheart airport that has been built and designed to an excellent standard It feels premium and polished not something I expected if I am honest before setting of on our holiday Arrival was very simple walked off plane on to a beautiful bright glass airbridge and into modern terminal structure made of glass and metal Immigration was quick and efficient not overly friendly but not antagonistic either We were airside probably within minutes from leaving the plane There is only one shuttle that goes to the city and it meets each flight leaving half an hour after each flights arrival and the cost was reasonable On Departure the checkin hall is bright and airy and the checkin staff for BA were friendly and helpful Security was a breeze and staff seemed generally fine we were the only flight taking off that evening though so it was very quiet The departure area was clean and well organised there isnt a lot of shopping opportunities or much to do but it is a small airport so that wasnt expected Do be aware of the extortionate prices charged by cafs for water you can buy it cheaper in some of the dutyfree shops at more reasonable cost Also only minutes of free wifi stingy and charging for more in this day and age is deeply odd These niggles aside however overall quite impressed

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates

My wife was carrying few items which were not allowed due to their oversize more than ml The officer obviously had to throw them away before she goes through the security I was very upset to know as these items were medicated and not readily available I called the airport to enquire about the items and was to know that the items were disposed off in the trash I again called today and able to talk to the relevant person He was very helpful and took the pains and advised the supervisor Within half an hour I was called by the Sergeant who break the news that they found both the items Obviously I was overjoyed and so grateful to the efforts made by the energetic and helpful staff at the Cork airport

We recently flew business class New Delhi to Paro and Paro to Bangkok with Druk Air They are a fantastic little airline being only one of two airlines serving Bhutan We were on a trip via Delhi to Paro for nights and then onto Bangkok Both flights on time lounges were shared and and of a good standard Both flights considering Paro being one of the worlds most difficult airports to land in were flawless by the flight deck some amazing views en route and pointed out by the crew Food and beverage were of a high standard and plentiful for hour flights combined with excellent service from very professional and and delightful Bhutanese crew Would certainly use again Only point out being there is no Entertainment or wifi but the views en route you dont need it

This airport is good but there is no wifi and check in desk is one There air two shops and one cafe The best thing is that there is an outdoor square and a fountain after passport control There are international gates The gates area is modern

The checkin staff was very helpful and I had a smooth checkin process I received an aisle seat in the exit row with loads of legroom However that is where the good part ends the aircraft was not very clean and the inflight service consists of a juice nuts and the thinnest bar of Cadbury Diary Milk chocolate you will ever see They did not seem to have any menu for purchase as well After spending hours in the Domestic Terminal at Male where nothing is available to purchase and then going through a hour flight with nothing to eat is not the best experience There is a single attendant on the flight who passes by once to hand out the food and once to take the trash The experience is certainly not comparable to domestic flights in Asia and a tad disappointing especially given the premium prices in Maldives The good thing is that the flight was absolutely on time

Friendly flight attendant who take care of the passengers efficiently Excellent flight but the cabin of the Dash needs a very serious refresh and more confortable seats The flight time was respected On the gate the employees of Air Canada Jazz offer a good service
