Gatwick is above all an experience An experience for the eyes nostrils and hygiene that might not exactly be considered favorable Bear in mind I come from the US We have some excellent major airports but also some rubbish ones Gatwick would easily be considered to be among the worst of what Im used to in the US and its the worst major airport Ive seen yet in Europe other than possibly Otopeni in Bucharest The only nice part of Gatwick I saw was the train station upon exiting the national rail Otherwise the checkin areas are depressing and run down like a throwback to whenever Thatcher was prime minister yet without any good cleaning since that time The checkin as well as gate personnel with Norse Atlantic Airlines were honestly surly professional but surly The security process is a hot mess and lines are incredibly long at least I had paid the pounds or so for expedited security While I made it through security quickly I still had to swiftly pay attention to what was going on Walking through the south terminal there were very few places to sit and eat At least the employees at the Pret were nice The floors were dirty and sticky The toilets and accompanying sinks looked like they were also from the Thatcher era The terminal had a pervasive damp dank flatulentlike odor to it not sulfur but still odd and gross Final point I usually like British people for their politeness but Gatwick is a place to see some of the worst in British people In closing if you have to come to London fly to Heathrow as at least some parts of it feel like a proper airport or to London City which is very small and easy Very clearly the privatization of many British airports has not served the British traveler well at all

I had a return flight booked with WestJet from Lethbridge Alberta to Victoria BC back in late August There was a connecting flight through Calgary Alberta I was scheduled to leave Lethbridge at am August but received a message from WestJet at pm the day before that my flight from Lethbridge had been cancelled I spent about hours before finally contacting an agent who rescheduled my am connecting flight from Calgary the next morning to a later flight as I was not able to rearrange my schedule including alternate packing and a hour drive to Calgary the next morning I then had to park my car at ParkGo for the entire week I was to be gone and pay them I lodged a complaint to WestJet upon returning and finally received a reply after four and a half months of waiting My request for reimbursement was denied due to unplanned aircraft maintenance which they do not compensate you for I did receive compensation for my cancelled flight from Lethbridge to Calgary but not the cancelled return flight Some consolation On top of that I have found that the WestJet staff are not nearly as friendly or accomodating as they used to be In the future I will make every effort to fly with another airline as i feel WestJet even though I am a Rewards member does not offer reliable service nor accommodation for their lessthanacceptable behaviour

This is an interesting airport for Domestic flights throughout Brazil Check in area is full of lines for all different airlines and like old style the airline offices are opposite to check in Many people buy tickets same day at the airport Not many people speak English but if you ask someone if they do they will try or get someone who does if they do not I checked in for my flight on GOL and had hours They would have put me on the earlier flight if there was seats available even with the departure leaving in minutes Prior to security the main building has a round waiting area with shops food areas and so forth If you go to the second floor you will find an Internet cafe barber pharmacy police etc Go to the third floor for a wonderful outdoor bar and a full service restaurant full of TVs and a wonderful buffet You can stay as long as you like and be away from the throngs of folks travelling especially on weekends Past security is the new terminal that is huge and if your gate is at the end it will literally take you between to mins to get there No moving walkways There are snack bars and little shops along with plenty of seating NOW You need to understand that there are several gate changes and the ONLY main screen is after security So be sure of your gate if you can Anouncements were made in Portuguese and then English every time People will help you if you dont speak Portuguese just ask Signage is also in English but if you are going out to get a taxi or bus you must take the elevator if you want to keep using your free trolley Taxi line can be long and if you are going outside the city to say the International airport they will charge you additional to the fare Thats the law Take one of the buses if you can to transfer to Guarulhos

Arrival was super speedy world class speed by the immigration guy Airport facilities money changer is up until the time we arrive in there early pm ish local time Kudos to the landside staff However departure is a different story travelers are mire with last minute opening of AAX counters where usually it opens three hours ahead of time however at IKA it opens hours before departure time For non Iranians immigration queue is super long with one female officer working only we had to queue for more than minutes just to clear our passport Before immigration the seats are not enough to contains all the travellers and after the immigration there isnt any trolleys to move the luggage of us Good part about IKA you will feel safe in the airport with thorough checks and the presence of officers in military fatigue the security here is top notch After immigration there are sleeping benches at the most behind of gates Improvements to be done add more chairs before the immigration speed up the passport clearance and introduce trolleys after immigration

Sat th Dec we sat in departure lounge for hrs with no information from pm Eventually we board pm and told we are being diverted to Madrid to change crews A hour later we are told we are being booked into a hotel in Madrid for the night and flying home in the morning Then the story changed to the hotel has been cancelled and were booking you into a hotel in Gran Canaria go collect your luggage and meet us At a EasyJet rep told us we cant get you a hotel goodnight and check your app for your rearranged flight home We watched the staff leave for there booked accommodation Unable to find a bed we ended up on a beach for the night Our rearranged flight was originally for but left at After numerous apologies from the captain we was offered a free teacoffee or water as a good will gesture but they had no food left as the plane wasnt restocked Landed hrs later The biggest disgrace is they have denied compensation and blamed air traffic control extraordinary circumstances pp Yet two of us have had different excuses I have ATC report confirming they are not being honest I have ATC report showing every flight landing that evening into Gatwick except only one cancelled was ours including Easyjet flights yet they said it was passenger safety Easyjet are a disgrace

Mandalay International Airport was built at the turn of the st century It serves both domestic and international destinations and is designed like many airports around the world it just works slightly differently somehow Arriving on a domestic flight you are bussed into the single terminal building where you walk passed unmanned Passport Control Desks to one of baggage carousels before having your baggage hand and hold scanned and into a large Arrivals Hall with the usual selection of booths and a small cafshop selling bottled water There are TV Screens showing which flights are coming or going Marble floors and air conditioned Departures start with the need to scan all you bags hand and hold before going to Checkin Counters which are clearly numbered in banks A B C and D After this is the a boarding pass check and into the Departure Hall which is upstairs Checkin and arrivals are on the ground floor There is a large selection of shops and a couple of barcafes not all of which are open for domestic flights Security Scanning is done at the gate and Gate seems to be where all the domestic flights leave from via a pier down to a bus In the Gate area there are no shops or toilet facilities just rows of seats looking out on to the apron and in the distance the runway parallel to the terminal building The airport is larger than the current traffic levels so it does not feel crowded or too busy but it has a new feeling that none of the other airports in Burma Myanmar have

vSay what you may but I have seldom had an issue with this airport In todays world of checking in online just pass the long lines at the checkin desks if not travelling with bags Customs and immigration were quick and professionalno surprises The checkin at both terminals is now airconditioned Dutyfree was typically overpriced Just smile and move on I departed from Terminal A and enjoyed a few overpriced airport beers prior to boarding Heyits an airport Boarding the flight was painless with the bus to the plane I did note however that the staff at the gate were a bit perplexed when I handed them my homeprinted boarding pass All good though On the return flight again through immigration and customs in no time at all Please remember that if you are a citizen or a resident there is a separate aisle for you to the right side of the arrivals hall

Rude treatment of elderly passengers This is not our first time visiting Tbilisi It was always great This year I decided to meet my elderly parents in this city We were flying from America they were from Belarus We had a great time and were inspired by the beauty of Georgia its hospitable people unique culture and great food But all of this was crossed out at the airport Both of my parents are over years old and it shows At the security screening they were never offered help or possibility to skip the line Moreover they were rudely searched and groped and my father was taken to a separate office where he was forced to take off the hernia belt which he never takes off and cannot put back on on his own We got to the airport more than two hours before the flight time However because my parents cannot walk quickly all of this screening took a lot of time They were at the security line past the boarding time Even after their names were announced on the PA system several times they were not allowed to go through passport control without standing in line As the result they were forced to run as fast as they could to get on the plane My parents are very kind people they never complain about anyone and try to stay positive But I see that for a couple of days now they have not been able to recover from this stress I am shocked by this attitude of the airport security and border control staff I am very sorry that airport services demonstrate such treatment towards guests of their country

Arrival at Maputo Airport is via air stairs to the ramp to the terminal There is no covering that I could see in the event of rain Inside the arrival area is what seems to be a mass of confusion at the desk where one collects his visa unless you are one of those coming from a country not requiring a visa Following issuance of the visa one then has to clear immigration to have an entry stamp put in hisher passport This is a slow procedure and one is frequently asked where one will be staying so best to keep a copy of your hotel confirmation with you Customs is simple enough where all baggage is screened in an xray machine Following this you are finished and can exit the terminal Note that there is presently no air conditioning in the terminal and it can be hot Also lighting is rather limited Departure is likewise slow I arrived hours before my flight time and had to sit and wait almost hour for the counter to open Again the terminal lacks air conditioning the story being that the system is under repair Following check in one takes an escalator to an upper floor where one processes through immigration which oddly enough is a fairly fast process The departure area has a few shops and some airline lounges but is otherwise fairly devoid of anything Flights are called over a loudspeaker system and one descends again to the ground level and proceeds out of the building across the tarmac to hisher plane The very worst part of utilizing Maputo Airport is the arrival where it seems that confusion reigns mostly due to the matter of issuance of a visa and having it applied to ones passport This occurs even if one has acquired the previsa on line and involves paying the fee for issuance of the visa Note the visa fee can be paid by cash or credit card Visa Master Card only If you have secured the online previsa be sure to bring a print out of it to show to the visa issuing clerks There are some countries that do not require a visa and apparently this number has just been expanded although the expansion has yet to be implemented as of this writing If you have not secured a previsa and are from a country that requires a visa you can be delayed by this process for as much as hours In my case I asked the tour company with which I arranged my bookings and tours in Mozambique to arrange a meet and assist service for both arrival and departure at Maputo Airport This was a good investment and I tipped to man who assisted me with US I highly recommend this type of service for a firsttime visitor

I showed up to MLU for my morning flight I was there in plenty of time and I have flown out of Monroe multiple times A family in front of me was buying tickets for a flight tomorrow I waited and waited Apparently the woman at the counter the only one working thought I was with the family Once she realized I wasnt with the family she tried to get someone to help me but no one was there I waited long enough to miss the time to check a bag Finally a man came to help but immediately gave me a spill about being on time so I can check my bag next time I was polite but Ive done this many times Lets just say the woman working was not happy with him She tried to help me and I dont think it was her fault that no one was there to help her I had to wait from to catch the next flight I guess it is a small airport so theres not many staff I think the problem could be prevented

Worst airport in all respects Completed recently but very poor build quality with things already breaking down Floors uneven wood lamination splitting apart tiles breaking just after a year uncomfortable seats no duty free shop Felt sad seeing it Loks like corruption had driven down quality all work shoddy

Modern but has poor circulation in and out The wait for immigration was glacial and there was a customs form that wasnt collected The line for the bank to change money was glacial Terminal B the location for the shuttle into the city is really just a kiosk in front of the back entrance for terminal C some distance away The taxi ride from the center was about US plus tolls Departure was relatively easy which may have been a reflection of being a Saturday afternoon although there were few places to sit while waiting for the airline to begin checkin Few places to eat or shop in the departure area Note that there is no exchange after immigration so you must change money when you checkin with the airlinethe selection of goods postimmigration was disappointing and you cannot take water onto flights The lounge used by Star Alliance was ok with a range of things to eat The same vendor runs the lounge for Delta and American which I would assume are similar Bathrooms were in need of better upkeep Not the worst of airports but one Id happily never use again

Things have improved a little arrival is chaotic if a large plane eg from BNE it took an hour from arrival to leaving The money exchange was open you still pay for your visa Checkin was very efficient There is still one shop pre customs and some food available afterwards You do not have to get wet anymore when boarding Domestic more challenging when checking in You do walk to the planes although some covered walk ways Was quick delivering checked bags from internal flight

Lost Luggage AirTag showed bag remained in Florence with the carrier for days Staff is not passionate and it shows Stone faced and rather rude gate agents Very lacklustre Worse than a US based low cost carrier On the plus side the aircraft was clean

Milan Bergamo to Tirana Flight delayed times waiting hrs with no information from airline or airport staff Even one announcement to confirm that our flight will actually happen would be better than sitting in a tiny terminal with one bathroom and a small food kiosk for hours Were not able to leave the terminal Were basically stranded with no plan Horrendous experience Will never fly with this airline

I missed a local flight due to weather conditions and then they wanted to charge an extra for my family and I to get home Bought a cheaper flight with Qantas Trying to get a refund which went nowhere then I tried to get a letter from them that I could send to the travel insurance company This has been ongoing for over a week with several phone calls back to South Africa The most incompetent people I ever dealt with Never flying with them ever again

Extremely unreasonable and rude staff They took away my astringent and toner bottles with just ml liquid each No one till date has done that They are seeing the bottle size and not the amount in them Disgusting treatment of tourists

St Thomas to St Croix We purchased tickets on Seaborne as part of a family Thanksgiving celebration scheduled for Nov My parents have several medical issues availability of medical facilities are a requirement wherever they travel The Virgin Islands were devastated by Hurricanes Irma and Maria in September My personal home was severely damaged our island was destroyed and most importantly the medical facilities and electrical systems were destroyed I requested refunds of travel tickets from both American and Seaborne for the same reasons American refunded my parents tickets within hours Seaborne however has refused to do so citing a provision that it was not their fault and therefore they will offer a yr rebooking option only We are prohibited from even selling the tickets locally to someone else who could use them Needless to say this is not acceptable We are leaving the island we will never be coming back and neither will my parents Seaborne had an opportunity to rise above petty policy provisions and provide for a base of enthusiastic customer support and they have squandered it The adage of a satisfied customer tells people a dissatisfied customer tells holds true in this case I urge any traveler to the area of the USVI who wishes to travel between the islands to use alternate travel modes there are plenty
Dirty and smelly public washrooms Good food and beverage options Long queues at security screening Cramped baggage reclaim area and long wait for baggage to be delivered to the Carousel

No sense of organisation Only few staff for security control and loads of departures at same time slot People arriving to this huge queue minutes before flight departure knowing that will be fast tracked without paying If I knew better I would do the same and arrive late to the airport

Not a good experience Staff seem to be purposefully unhelpful Passport scanning machines only seemed to work of the time after which you are sent to an even bigger wait line When I told the staff I would miss my flight he told me to take it up with the airline which made no sense at all Very little seating in the airport wait for ever to use restrooms and no way near enough staff I only made my flight because people let me jump the line at passport control after waiting hours Would give out of if possible

Plovdiv to Belfast It was a decent airline The seats where mildly uncomfortable though and the free food was disgusting except for the mousse you got in a pot and the lemon muffin as well The flight staff were nice enough they didnt talk much but there was one flight attendant who was nice The food that was actually decent thought was expensive Seriously for a hot beverage and some shortbread and it claims to be competitive prices no way I guess this airline is sort of fly us if you are broke yet want to go on a holiday And they also dont have anywhere to charge your phone and they dont have wifi either Not good Overall if you are flying this airline bring about for the flight because the actually nice food is expensive Maybe would recommend to someone who doesnt have the money to fly with other more expensive airlines

I like this little airport its actually one of my favourites but they cant cope at busy times am on Saturday December three internal flights leaving within minutes of each other huge queue to get baggage dropped and scanned by one machine Equally huge queue though security Just made flight despite arriving well before advertised bagdrop time No time to see or do anything

Flew Myanmar Airways from Mandalay to Yangoon on an A on March Initial flight which was on an older ATR was delayed hours and minutes I was informed about this instantly when arriving at checkin in MDL Upon request I managed to board an earlier flight a more modern and quicker aircraft after a bit waiting at checkin Service impeccable Less than passengers Full catering service including food beer softdrinks and hotdrinks Clean aircraft observant and fast working staff Arrived minutes prior to schedule with the original flight which was said to be likely further delayed They accept special meals and my seafood meal The meal was confirmed but I had upon consent to forsake it as I took an earlier flight Very nice airline and quick operations

What a horrible airport First off theres no proper ventilation Its stuffy as hell Secondly I tried to buy a beer at a bar and was told they only accept Master Card not Visa Then I went to the food court to buy a juice and was told they only accept local cards This airport can definitely not be classified as an international airport

They chose to wait for passengers who were running late for mins and delayed everyone else who was on time for the flight How ridiculous is that If your passengers dont show up you say no show and take their bags on and take off with the people who are on time The people were clearly just caught up shopping I put star as at least plane was clean
Confusing chaotic dirty toilets lack of seating Theres no logic to its layout Id find an alternative next time I love Italy but this is the worst airport ever

I had a round trip scheduled from Jackson to Orlando Two days before my departing flight I received an email stating my flight was cancelled No reason no info on refund nothing other than being told my returning flight was confirmed I called the customer service number attached to the email and it goes straight to someones voicemail I got in touch with the MS airport authorities who contacted ViaAir They were told by a rep to have me contact them through Facebook for a response After two days waiting for a response through all the mediums I contacted them through I received an email simply apologizing for the inconvenience I arrived at the FL airport for my returning flight that I was told was confirmed and waited min at the ViaAir desk and saw not one person I then contact the airport information to be told my returning flight was also cancelled with no reason and this time no email in advance The lady at the information desk told me they didnt even send employees in today for work because they cancelled the flight So no rep to even answer questions available Do not book waste of time and money

It was the most favorite airport I mean was and I am writing about terminal But today I am waiting for my flight which departs at H gates and there is no place to eat at all Just Starbucks and Chinese cafe Before I used to eat and wait for my flight in Burger King but just a half month later suddenly fence appeared So there is no food in Starbucks write now no shops with products and I realize that I still need to wait hours my flight and then spend hours in the plane Why just one month ago there wasnt a fence and now people cant eat anything except Starbucks waiting for a flight from H and G gates And I am sure many flights are more than hours Now its like a prison no place to go in a huge airport

I am not satisfied with the way they handle passengers luggage It was very frustrating when received my luggage bag at Mumbai airport with big cracks in it so here we buy expensive and strong bags just to make sure our things in it remains safe and due to this irresponsible baggage handling policy we have to think twice before we buy such expensive bags again

The vehicles delivering passengers were skewed all over the road and passengers disembarking on the road Had to queue outside the terminal for an hour Had to queue for a further minutes to drop baggage off Then had another minutes for passport control The Greek staff were generally quite rude in their character The terminal announcer gave incorrect gate details twice causing some of the elderly passengers quite a bit of confusion Once on the plane and delayed by an hour the Captain announced he could not yet leave due to no ground staff being available to remove the stairs etc Laughable all the way Will not return

Had a family trip to Bangkok on Biman most recent Dirty interior dirty foodcart accumulated dust gluetape fixed overhead storage and most importantly emergency switch at the mainentry door was broken and covered with a transparent tape Ground handling was also as bad as before and it took at most one hour to receive our luggage Heard that after the interim govt has taken the charge there was a substantial improvement in the airport including ground handling However its all the same old story Authority please take a serious look on this simply just to live on and waste public money
Lost my baggage and took days to retrieve it Ruined my whole holiday Was so hard to even get a single reply Both flights delayed hrs in total Picked up my suitcases with missing wheels Awful Avoid

Despite of being the main international hub of Somaliland Hargeisa Egal International Airport is small and pleasantly old fashioned Arrival was uncomplicated and baggage delivery fast You can buy your local sim card right in front of the only baggage delivery belt For departing passengers there is one waiting room with optional openair seating which is only separated from the apron by a decorated fence Security and immigration are housed in a newer building on the landside There is one coffee outlet a small souvenir shop and two departure gates which are simply different seating areas on the first floor For boarding everybody then walks out onto the apron through the same door All staff including the immigration and security officers were extremely friendly and courteous

Staff and service are unfriendly Trollies arent provided on arrival Waited quite a long time for baggage and we were supposed to rush home for family matters Service was not professional If visitors from international countries sees services like this it would be a shame Other than that I think the airport quality was good

There are two departure terminals One called Billi that is for Easy Jet passages After scanning boarding ticket I went to bag security check that is maybe min away There I needed to scan my boarding pass again when giving my bag Not really efficient in my opinion But my problems started when I was waiting for gates to announce The gates was announced min before the flight and to go to the gates I need to pass passport security And there my fun begin I was waiting in the line for min And than the security guy who was checking my passport and who barely spoke English told me to move in the side of the line to serve others He had issue with my passport I have for almost a year and passport I used to arrive in the country I gave my id to confirm my identity But instead of letting me through he started to scan each page with UV light and checking each page in the scanning system He started to scratch my passport with a nail and drop my id to see how its lands My mother come back checking what take me so long because the airplane company already announced the last call When like min left the manager come check my passport for min and let me pass I was the last one boarding I wonder what would happen if they would keep me longer without explanation Would I need to purchase a new flight ticket because the passport security guy didnt like my passport and id I arrived in the country and been using before to travel to the country

The custom officers were mean and condescending He kept shouting whats wrong with people these days and do you even speak English while we were being nothing but polite and patient even after a long international flight

Paid for pre selected front seats but at check in we were advised those seats not available and were allocated the last seats in the plane After many emails and being informed they would refund our money this still months later has not been honoured Be wary as I believe this is common practice with this airline I have travelled on far better low cost airlines and wouldnt travel Batik Air again

This is a low cost carrier code shared with Vietnam Airlines who own of it It used to be Jetstar We paid for a full service flight with Vietnam but got this instead Bit of a con No inflight entertainment no service except for pay to buy Seats very hard Glad it was only a hour flight Got us there at least Full flight but uneventful

I was charged by wizz air for not checking in online even though i was at the baggage check in as soon as it opened hrs before the flight time I got an email the day before saying check in online but it didnt tell me Id have to pay euros if i didnt check in Huge slap in the face

Terrible experience Our bags fit under our seats in front with room to spare and they still made us pay Rude customer service The way back was fine and the crew did not make us pay for our bags Have a flight booked for spring and they bumped our flight a day out coming home which is going to cost me an extra night hotel childcare and day off work they are unwilling to compensate in any way Will never fly with them again after this trip I would cancel but have a cruise booked They have an average review of for good reason

The staff acts like they understand English but they dont like this they sent us to the transit area while we wanted to explore the city seen our long layover There was no way to get back to the immigration section and when we asked for help the staff was rude and not helping at all Internet doesnt work either so this is definitely the worst airport experience ever

Despite more international flights the terminal still has the feel of a ghost town After a very speedy check through security all domestic passengers are directed to a largish departure area and bussed out to their aircraft The colour coded badges all passengers are required to wear ensure no one gets left behind or attempts to join the wrong aircraft There are more food outlets than my last visit a few years ago sadly the washrooms and the rest of the terminal show no sign of having been properly cleaned since then

The main idea of this airport is to delay and inconvenience Deboarding your plane via finger you then make two steep flight of stairs No lift or escalator can be used due to layout of nonSchengen arrivals Stairs only Then nonEU passport holders are welcomed to the long line served by just one officer for all who arrived EU passports are served by two officers who are now doing nothing since no people are in the corresponding line The only nonEU officer works as slowly as he can spending minutes per head It either means that border control are unable to comprehend that arriving plane can bring pax or they just enjoy seeing that every chance to make things worse is fully used Disgrace

Kona to Honolulu Worst airline Ive ever used First time using them Booked four flights for interisland vacation All four flights were cancelled without notice Online check in did not work Stood in ticket line for over one hour Carryon bag weight limit lbs without notice Gate attendant not friendly No place to buy food or drinks and no vending machines in Kona or Kauai one bar in Honolulu that opened after noon One plane had seats that the cushions were worn so bad me and my wife were sitting on the seat frames metal bars Only good thing was the flight crews were nice

Staff is very unprofessional and rude food and drinks quality is awful being checked and having my baggage checked for times which is obviously not necessary if they think theyre doing their job right from the first time staff in cafes in the seating area always trying to be funny and ending up to be rude baggage helpers bugging and following me to force me to ask for their help and have to pay them money Guiding to gates is very inefficient and need to ask staff members who are rude

Going through security I had a pen in handbag which caused problem even though I have travelled with this for years and had no problem before I didnt mind being stopped for it security is paramountbut the rudeness of the staff there was unforgivable Made to feel bad as I did not understand what was required basically through security once more Just grunted at and very offhand Chap was going on a break it turned out so that was his problem Woman who took over very slightly better Happy going through procedure as should be questionedbut attitude needs sortedafter all we are their bread and butter Politeness goes a long way My scoring only really went down because of securitycafe staff werent friendly either Jet departure on boarding chap was exceptional really customer focused and friendlyperfect for the job
This is my second time in Qatar and the eGate is not working properly The immigration lane is frustrating it took hours just to reach the counter

The whole airport is a disgrace x body and bag checks before I got to my departure gate Everyone is out to scam you from the visas on arrival to the stalls selling water in the departure lounge Shady characters all over the place I saw cleaner toilets out in the desert It really puts me off returning to Hurghada

Scam like practice at the shop near gate no I was charged nearly pounds for a bottle of coke This is the highest price ever I have paid for coke bottle anywhere in the world Airport needs to do something to stop this corrupt practice

Arrival was perfect Departure a different story chaotic queues people crowding everywhere Was given wrong boarding passes for my wife while my wife got hers had to come back and queue again Security did not find a litre bottle of water in my carry on luggage Just one bathroom in service for the whole departure hall

Ive flown with many airlines and this is the worst airline out there Weve been sitting on the plane for over an hour to take off The seats do not recline the staff are rude I would never recommend this airline to anyone I will never in my life fly with this airline again They should be shut down

Poor connection to cities like Trieste Be careful if you wish to take a connection by bus to Trieste as there are very few schedule options and ITABUS will not allow you to buy the ticket on the spot even if the bus is empty I dont know if Flixbus has the same procedure You should always buy the ticket online beforehand otherwise you will be left standing there and likely have to wait four or five hours until the next bus comes which is what happened to me when they refused to let me buy a ticket for the am bus The default answer from the staff is that tickets can only be purchased online but on ITABUS IG page they say it is possible to purchase also by calling their phone line Also the bus stops of ITABUS and Flixbus are not indicated but they stop in the parking lot in front of the regular shuttles that connect to Venice city centre as of november If you are left waiting there at least inside the airport there are mobile charging stations and there is wifi

We recently took internal flights on AirKBZ during our holiday in Myanmar They use mainly ATR aircraft for these flights They serve a snack and a drink on flights longer than hour on shorter flights boiled sweets are served The planes were newish and in reasonable condition At every check in you are given a sticker to identify your destination once onboard these stickers are seen on the backs of every seat and safety cards FAs were professional and pleasant The schedules were punctual as the turnaround time on hopping flights is well under minutes some of the flights left before time as soon as all the passengers were on board
If given the choice I will always fly into Oakland over SFO Its small efficient and flights are most of the time on time With the new BART connector train its super easy to get to

The airport is one of the worst I have encountered so I am unsure how it continues to win awards Competitors must have equally low standards There are no food options before you check in and go through to the departure lounge so you could be starving for hours without respite if they are it is poorly signed bring food people The airport is small and has staff who clearly dont want to talk to you rude and unwelcoming especially the women The toilets are disgusting both in the check in area and post security The doors are not high enough to ensure privacy many times they are not working causing long queues Food options in departure lounge is PATHETIC no authentic Jamaican places so resigned to Wendys at a rip off price There needs to be much more and branch such as Taste Island Grill Starbucks ets Seating area in departure lounge is dirty and needs repainting shops close too early and do not align with flight times

Arrived from London and agree with other reviewers about airport size and lack of walking needed to get through immigration and baggage claim Found immigration hostile to my wife US citizen but OK to me Inane questions and suspicious attitudes are unwelcoming Little choice of food in departures when returning to UK but interesting architecture and layout rivals new T at Heathrow

They cancelled my flight months ago I asked for reimbursement months later my money is not yet reimbursed although I called times One month ago they said they flagged the reimbursement with priority One week ago customer service tells me the reimbursement is done Its a lie the money is not received

The most disorganized and bureaucratic airport I have ever seen I have been there a few years ago but things have changed First we had to line up for an hour to go through the computer kiosk then other line ups to see different custom officers who asked the same questions on the computer printout Total hours later to get out of the airport It seems like they have layers of bureaucracy to keep people employed

I was brought to the airport by a friend There is both adequate paid parking and also free minutes for drop off and pick up The terminal building is a little dated but it functionas well There were a couple of flights being checked in while I arrived and there were sufficient counters open so that queues were reasonable The security check was fast and worked well You then went upstairs where there is a lounge and cafes and space to sit Boarding in my case was on a bus but no problems

Not enough ticket agents to handle queue More security guards standing around talking than ticket agents to help Carrying luggage from basement on overloaded elevator to th floor then down for boarding pass where there were one sometimes boarding pass agents while I queued up By the time I negotiated the airport I missed my flight Malaysian Air scheduled hours between flights Not nearly enough time for getting baggage going up floors then down for the boarding pass International flights a passenger needs at least hours especially at Kuala airport Extremely poor customer service and organization Not yet arrived into the st century

Air India Flight ATQBHX B Dreamliner Seat D InFlight Entertainment Inoperable USB charging port inoperable Seating old dated and showing significant signs of wear tear Reading light inoperable Inflight food poor at best Cabin crew call button inoperable Cabin crew efficient but failed to smile giving the impression they would rather be somewhere else Pointless providing earphones with broken inflight equipment Tray table dirty Rubbish from previous flight in seat pocket The flight landed minutes ahead of schedule The New Air India is still in Phase of their transformational programme and is nowhere near the mark of world class for which they strive There are world class alternatives on this flight sector that involve a short layover that are far more superior to AI who are All talk and no action

We were flying home on July from Hamilton Island Our flight was with Virgin As it was pouring rain we noticed at the airport did not have any cover at all As we noticed Qantas was parked very close to the entry not that far of a walk but still no cover at all for passengers Very disappointed that every single passenger was saturated getting on to the plane Virgin did not park close it parked far away Very disappointed wont be back

Travelling recently from Lbeck on a Ryanair service to Stansted was a pleasant surprise This small regional airport placed in a residential suburb south of Lbeck had five checkin counters open for one departure the staff even smiled regularly and the new temporary departure lounge is roomy The walk to the aircraft isnt long so Stansted is beaten in every category

The whole airport is a disgrace x body and bag checks before I got to my departure gate Everyone is out to scam you from the visas on arrival to the stalls selling water in the departure lounge Shady characters all over the place I saw cleaner toilets out in the desert It really puts me off returning to Hurghada

A good alternative to Manila International airport Used this airport several times now Both domestic and international International flights is very good and fast It is not spacious enough this airport has the potential to be good if upgraded However domestic the flights I used are delayed but nowhere near Manila domestic It lacks food options It is also very basic and hot due to poor airconditioning Philippines should make use of this airport as it has the potential to be the best in the northern Philippines

Less than hours before the flight they moved the flight hours earlier from to which really inconvenienced me since I had plans for the morning before my departure I specifically booked this flight because of the time it was scheduled to fly although there were earlier flights available I have never experience a situation where a flight is moved earlier but also on such a short notice it is just ridiculous I arrived earlier at the airport Boarding started minutes after the plane was scheduled to depart And in the end the take off was delayed for hours

Flew out from Senegal to Madrid Check in is clean bright and very efficient at the Iberia desk security was rigorous but very well mannered Passport control wasnt quick Airside not too bad range of shops but the cafe sells the worst coffee I have ever drunk For some reason all European flights take off late at night but save that we took off only minutes late Been to far worse American airports than this Promise of a new airport seems some way off but would not be adverse to departing from there again

The airport advertises Verified Traveller program and has signage but this option didnt exist I was shunted into regular lineup When I asked the security guard about it he shrugged told me to empty out everything and looked away until I started doing it As I was packed for the express line and they are very old school wanting belts etc off laptops in their own tray I ended up using trays Grateful I didnt have kids with me

Absolute shambles Closed the runway as we were taxying the runway due to staff shortage Only set of steps which led to a delay loading the plane I have never arrived or departed this airport on time or had so many cancelled flights We was looking to move here but until the airport shambles is fixed Ill stay in London

Very small airport in Spanish African city of Melilla Service seems to be limited to flights to Malaga Madrid or Granada In April only eight departures all day Choice of airlines was either Air Europa or Iberia Exceptionally easy to check in The two airline counters for Air Europa were staffed for the upcoming ATR flight to Malaga As such maybe or so folks would be expected even for a full flight Checkin took all of two minutes In the end only about half the flight was full Prices to Malaga were about a person Airport had a small cafeteria shop and some related businesses After check in one security gate to navigate then to a holding room for both airport gates and then a walk out to the tarmac No fuss on the plane within to minutes

This whole airport experience was a complete and utter joke The debacle began the second we left the plane where we were subjected to long queues and no apparent wifi connectivity The staff slap a sticker on you without consent and herd you like cattle to the transit area The best description of the transit area is a skeleton Yes it is modern and clean with the initial appearance of many shops and restaurants but spend more than minutes there and you will realise there is hardly anywhere to eat where the food is inedible and there is hardly anywhere to shop and the staff dont speak English So to pass the time we decided to splurge on entry into the airport lounge However we were told in broken English that they only accept Chinese yuan for entry Slightly annoyed we asked where we could withdraw cash or exchange foreign currency the staff member advised there was no ATMs nor currency exchange outlets in the airport So if you want to spend more than minutes in a place with barely any edible food a smoking room resembling a scene from Black Mirror Gulaglike environment covered with security cameras and that simply makes you hate life then I recommend a transit at Shanghai Pudong

My wife and I flew VLM from Southampton to Antwerp return on a Fokker Left and arrived on time both ways Only about half full on way out and three quarters on the return Had a free beer and snack Fokker is on a par with more modern turbo props on these short flights Antwerp airport is a breeze in a rental car and away within minutes of landing

They took our money canceled our flight and we are still waiting for a refund Every week they give a new lie as to why we have not received our refund While they were just down by the Costa Rican government they were still booking flights and charging people for flights they knew they were never going to be able to make

The airline counter had not opened when I arrived and was able to find a seat until it opened The Finnair desk was staffed with English speaking agents who issued me the boarding pass for my flight to Helsinki and also for my onward journey from there I was directed to the priority security lines which were only a few feet away The security check was a breeze I was the only person in this line Right in front was an elevator to take me to the business lounge which was a perfect place to relax and catch up on my emails The exit from the security area also leads to shops which one has to pass through before reaching the gates The airport is dated After the boarding passes were checked at the gate we walked down flights of concrete stairs to the tarmac where a bus was waiting to take us to the ATR propeller aircraft parked remotely in mid field We boarded the plain by stairs through the rear The airport was easy to use though I hope the stairs will be replaced by jetways soon

I boarded the aircraft and there was no space for my standard cabin luggage of kg It was full of backpacks which usually must be placed under the seat but the cabin staff didnt bother to remove any of the backpacks and a stewardess was trying to explain to me that space for cabin luggage is not as per the standards I had seat at row and finally they found a space above seat which is not acceptable since upon landing I had to walk against the other passengers in order to collect my cabin luggage or to wait all passengers to leave the aircraft Unfortunately this is the only airline which you can use for local flights in Bulgaria Poor quality service and unreasonably high air tickets

Shambolic Small regional airport convenient for Messina but badly run Despite being only flight to arrive passport control took over an hour On departure we arrived hours early and stood queuing for Checkin security and finally passport control for hours minutes Others were further back in the queue and so we took off hour later than scheduled Never again

By far the worst Caribbean airport I have had the misfortune to ever visit Arrived with Monarch unfortunately Monarch Cabin crew wrongly advised passengers with children under they only had to fill one immigration form with the childs details on the back which is what the form says Having queued for over mins to be told we needed to fill a form for each person multiply that to times on our flight chaos ensued One fan in that whole arrivals hall had youngsters fainting after the hour flight When we got past passport control we got to baggage reclaim with the fastest belt I have ever seen great that allowed quick retrieval of cases only to join another queue to get our luggage Xrayed the same cases that were xrayed at Gatwick as we waited the baggage belt overfilled with the passengers from row back to row on the plane jammed at the exit door and piled into each other causing a jam with no airport staff to be seen a passenger eventually hit the stop button We eventually got out after hours the airport maybe be able to handle endless ATRs from Trinidad but not an A and Monarch have been going there since at least when I was in transit from Grenada I love the Island but would never come back through the airport where no welcome was given anyone tourist or resident

Astana Airport feels more like a bus station than an international airport Its tiny That said staff are friendly and will go out of their way to help you buy and install a Sim card There are a few of the usual taxi touts but not too many and they accept no There are a few shops but none of those annoying overpriced boutiques which is a good thing Wifi appeared to work

Like many other domestic airports in Nepal Bharatpur airport offers very basic facilities only Check in counters dedicated to the serving airlines security check little parking area few basic seating chairs in a small area toilets not so clean though no AC For arrival a small baggage collection counter outside The airport currently operates flights to Kathmandu and Pokhara Sauraha a tourist spot is nearby this airport

For an airport which only had flights in and out on the days I travelled through it is amazing It has a large waiting area shop and small cafeteria The only down side is that you are made to queue between glass walls while you wait to get to the plane On the very sunny day I was there this became an oven even though we were only there for minutes

Huge airport serving the cities of Leipzig and Halle and good connections to Berlin as well roughly hour by express train Oversized shiny modern Due to its huge size one has to walk quite far through the whole airport to reach the rail station oversized as well which is located at the opposite end of the arrivals departure hall Good and fast connection to the city centres of Halle and Leipzig but very unfairly calculated fare they let you cross several fare zones so you have to pay more than for comparable distances in that region Because of new restrictions for landing and taking off after pm interestingly there are NO restrictions for cargo flights many budget airlines have cancelled their services to this airport and now only few major European cities are still served by nonstop flights Very sad since the alternatives now are Altenburg Airport or one of the Berlin airports However having to go there first from Leipzig or Halle increases the overall time of your journey massively

I booked a return flight from Lima to Cuzco two days ago and made the mistake of booking February March instead of March I called yesterday within hours and was advised that LATAMs policy was there is no penalty but I would have to pay the fare difference This sounded fair Especially as the fare online at their website was exactly the same for both trip dates Then they advised that the fare difference was USD I said this was almost exactly the same as the fare to book a new ticket so it is a penalty They said no it is just the change I called back to see if a more knowledgeable representative would get this right And got the same result Next as I live in Toronto Canada and the eticket was issued at their office here I walked over to their office the address on the web and on the ticket To my surprise LAN Air has never been there In fact the suite number they said they were at did not exist I will not rebook with LAN or ever fly with them again It will cost more but I will book with Avianca I fly more segments a year and will never fly on LAN again unless I absolutely have to I am glad that I learned this lesson on such a cheap fare Be sure to get your online booking right as my experience would show that there is no reasonable ability to adjust after you push enter

It would be bad citizenship if I dont write about my experience with Turkish airline If you plan to book a trip in which ones possible airline option is Turkish please make sure you have adjusted expectations I travel often from the US to middle east and tried different airlines This time I chose Turkish because it has sightly shorter duration on the longer leg compared to other service providers in the region Qatar Emirates etc But unfortunately I didnt get what I wanted shorter trip and also missed some other standard benefits With Turkish airlines you can happily book a flight and make travel plans accordingly But the airline doesnt feel obliged to commit to that booking They very very often cancel some legs of your flight likely due to the fact that the leg is not being fully booked This selfish cost saving approach wont stop there In my case it led to a major layover duration increase hr to hr And as you may have guessed they dont care for your time and wont even mention a penalty Having a hr layover I decided to book a lounge at Istanbul airport I wont bother readers with describing quality and variety of accommodations at the lounge But its good to change your expectation about a lounge if you think its supposed to be a comfy area for resting and good food If you could find a spot to rest like taking a nap you should be proud of yourself And lastly after all the misery we arrived at the destination Newark NJ with two out of five checked luggages missing Again it might be surprising to a regular reader but its very usual for Turkish airline staff if you ask them The airline had only seven hours to transfer our luggages and this is indeed error prone You may be more lucky with hr layovers next time Why am I writing this Just to vent a little Im sure the effect would be minimal But I also hope this helps some future travelers to dodge the bullet if they have other options
