Kangerlussuaq is where you enter Greenland on Air Greenland flights you arrive here from Copenhagen on their A and continue on board smaller planes to towns around this massive land Airport is very relaxed on domestic flights there is no security check so you simply arrive checkin your luggage and off you go The only flight you have security check is the one to Copenhagen Terminal is very small it has couple of shops and cafes and also an outdoor terrace where anyone can enter and watch the airplanes There is only one tiny luggage belt on arrival so when A arrives its very packed and for some reason it took about half an hour for our luggage to arrive They are now expanding airports in the capital Nuuk and also in the main tourist destination Ilulissat to receive larger aircraft so future of Kangerlussuaq is a bit cloudy

Very limited seating while waiting for a flight In addition it seems that all the flights are scheduled out of the same gate area which causes the congestion Also has poor information on how to get from terminal to terminal However when you do figure out how to get to the next terminal the tram is an easy experience

I have flown with Bahamas air to Nassau at least time It was the first time we flew on a two engine prop plane The plane was not the issue It was boarding the plane We entered the normal location then had to decline stairs The problem was with our carry on baggage There was no attendant at the top of the stairs I saw a shoot beside the stairs and placed my bag on the shoot I had not looked to the bottom and had not realized someone was removing their bag at the bottom I trust the sound of my bag travelling down the shoot caused her to look up and remove her arm before my bag slammed into hers She looked up and was not happy There needs to be attendant at the top to monitor when a bag can be place on the shoot which also runs very fast and could damage items in the bag On our return to Tampa we departed on the ground and walked to another staircase which would take us the normal departure level From prior experience I knew it was stairs to the top I am with a heart problem and my wife is in her s I was not going to carry our carry on up stairs There was no attendant present I told the security guard I was not going to carry the bags up the stairs The guard tried calling someone without success There where two ground crew standing by the plane which she approached and one came to take the bags to the to the top
Have flown PRGTXLPRG both ways on time The net flight time was only min so the staff had to be quick to serve us some drinks and snacks The service was professional Will use them again

Sadly had to spend hours in the check in area at Antigua airport awaiting a transatlantic flight not a pleasant experience No really worth going off site or so we thought Scarcely any seats and those available were not suitable for long delays but nothing else was available The tiny cafe closed about ten minutes after our arrival midafternoon The excuse given was its Sunday No water machine or vending machine available The AC worked over efficiently and it was bitterly cold After an efficient check in and passage through normal airport procedures enter into the departure area This is large and open with the potential for many outlets and stores However very few are in use really no more than were in the original old terminal We were told that rents are excessive and that is why few are in use Prices were excessive for a small bottle of water In summary the airport works efficiently as far as boarding airplanes is concerned but not for passengers with long waits either inside or outside departures WiFi is very good

Cusco to Lima On October I approached the desk of Peruvian air to ask if I could fly on that day instead of the ticket date the attendant said there is no problem and directed me to their office At the airport I went there and the clerk said there is no problem she informed me that I would have to pay a dollar rebooking fee to which I agreed soon after she spoke to a supervisor she ask me to comeback at PM and confirm the flight I agreed even though I wanted to pay for the rebooking then and there she refused to accept my payment and asked me to come back at two because there was a probability that the flight was going to be cancelled I came back five minutes to two and waited finally after I went the front desk and asked for assistance they told me that the person at the office was late coming back from lunch so I waited and the clerk showed at PM and went in to his office to open the computer site It took about ten minutes and mind you the flight was to depart around Pm he spent about minutes supposingly checking the flight load factor He finally told me that the flight was fully booked and there were two unclaimed seats that he could book me on if I pay extra dollars I paid up Proceeded to the gate went onboard sat in the assigned seat and waited to feel how lucky I had been to get a seat not minding the price I had to pay Waiting for the door to close and the rest to the people come on board I was surprised that the aircraft was over half empty

In the past Ive been very happy with Munich airport and have recommended it to other travellers for being wellorganized and relatively peaceful for an airport But that opinion is no more following our experience of almost missing our flight to Toronto due to superslow security lines My husband has Star Alliance gold status which in the past has entitled us to a faster trip through security However yesterday the security agents told us no Star Alliance gold card holders or business class travellers could be processed through a faster lane Usually buying a business class fare or being a Star Alliance card holder does give one that benefit We were at the airport nearly hrs before our flight having been concerned about slowdowns on the S line to the airport But it was the security at the airport that let us down we made our flight by only minutes Spending that much time in lines for security wending our way through arbitrary crowd control gating is unacceptable for anyone let alone frequent travellers

I want to caution potential travelers on this Swiss Air route My recommendation is to not book with Swiss air because if they cancel a flight and you agree to take a refund youll go through many months of stress if you are treated the same way Swiss air is treating me We booked with Swiss and Lufthansa in the past because they have a premium economy option which is nice on long haul flights and I have absolutely no problem with the flights or staff on the flights We are regular travelers on the DublinJohannesburg route and our last trip was for family members on separate booking references Without fail the long haul flights between the EU FrankfurtZurich and Johannesburg have been cancelled and we were told to rebook I was first and the only online option I had was to cancel the flight and book a new one under a new booking reference number That was in Oct I got an email days later that I qualify for a full refund happy days I booked another flight with Swiss Air on a new booking reference It is now Feb and I still havent received the refund despite many phone calls and many online forms and many emails between us What the call center agents tell me is that there was a technical problem when the refund was processed and hence the case is closed on their system regardless of the fact that the payment didnt do through which she could also confirm I actually dont know how to resolve this The time I invested and the phone calls are also adding up I advised my other family members to phone the call center to rebook their flights and to not give Swiss air the option to refund them

Vienna to Bologna Dont ask for water on the plane Horrible experience on Laudamotion but this is what you get if you pay for a ticket We got stuck after boarding and I was thirsty basically I had to ask three times while stuck on the ground for a bottle of water at am once Ive obtained the water I wanted to pay by card but this was not possible just in the air I would have had the chance to pay and when I handled the only cash note a it was refused by the staff and I had to wait until we took off to pay Once we were landing I saw that my seat was falling apart in the back Of course If I can last minute afford another carrier with still a cheap flight ticket I do

I purchased a one way flight with Jetstar Pacific at a total cost of A to fly from Da Nang to Sydney on for Xmas The first leg involved a domestic flight to HCMC where I was to connect to the international flight to Sydney My flight was due to depart Ho Chi Minh City at pm At pm I was advised that the flight had been delayed until am the next day After much trouble I managed to change my flight to the same flight departing at pm on I had to outlay for taxis and a hotel On I checked in and was waiting to board when we were advised that the flight had been cancelled We were subsequently advised by an Information officer no Jetstar rep met with us at the boarding gate that all Jetstar flights had be cancelled and that we were to find and fund our own way to Sydney We then paid for taxis to a hotel paid for by Jetstar I booked a flight with AirAsia to Sydney for the December at a total cost of Today January I contacted Jetstar seeking a full refund and was advised that they would only refund because were really unable to process a full refund for your flight since you took the first flight log transcript This is how Jetstar Pacific treat their customers absolute disgrace

Purchased a book of flight vouchers for the Phoenix to Show Low route in December Boutique dropped this route in July and are dragging their feet on refunding my unused vouchers Have spoken with customer service twice in July and September and been told they would be refunded but as of October they have not

Lagos to Accra From my experience today at Arik Air I can describe the airline as being terribly inefficient and best avoided The flight was delayed first for hours with excuses of the plane developing a fault Later a staff came to tell us after hours that the plane was now on ground and they were running some checks on it After another mins another staff came to tell us that actually the plane has not yet landed and they will give us an update in about minutes time No one is telling us anything and so we do not know whether we will still travel tonight or not On informing someone about my predicament I was told I made a mistake by buying an Arik Air ticket that this is their usual practice I would not advise anyone to travel with this airline

This is the second time I have used Knock It is a bit out of the way and coach connections are not very good But the timings of flights suited me better than the ones on offer to Shannon or Dublin so I used Knock My flight yesterday was the last time ever They do charge a departure tax of euro which I had no idea about until I got there Annoying but you can put up with this This time I had to spend three hours in the departure lounge as coaches were either arriving too early or too late to catch flight Never mind I thought I can relax They are doing repair work in the departure lounge which is minute The noise was horrendous Walls were being knocked down sawing hammering etc All in a small area and three groups of workers spread around the room All wearing ear protection so they were really enjoying themselves making as much noise as they could it seemed I asked if there was anywhere quiet we could sit and a staff member told me we have to put up with this all day Try the bar The bar a small area in one corner So not much help there I have tried to find who to complain to but no one seems interested My point is my flight was the last one of the day So they had many hours when work could be done to not inconvenience travellers It is a very small area where everyone sits The food selection is the worst I have seen so all in all a miserable three hours Never again I have two other airports to use both have been good in the past Passengers have a choice and my choice is never to use Knock again I warn anyone else to think again Staff seem fed up and Ireland has such a brilliant reputation for their hospitality it is a great shame

When we purchased our ticket online we were not informed that we would be flying direct from Victoria Falls to Johannesburg however it was explained to us at airport checkin that the flight was was Victoria Falls Bulawayo Joburg The flight was delayed about minutes in Vic Falls and we deplaned when we arrived at Bulawayo Airport and eventually reboarded a larger plane Communication wasnt great but we spoke with another passenger who took this flight more regularly and this was apparently the norm Aside from the fact that it was free seat meaning pick any available seat regardless of what was indicated on boarding pass the flight went well I would not recommend this flight if you have a tight connection it would be wise to leave yourself sufficient room for delays Most countries charge a departure tax when leaving by air Often the tax is automatically added to the airline ticket price but not always as is the case with Air Zimbabwe so be prepared to pay USD cash before going through security

I can share a few cautionary anecdotes with you regarding Viva Air Its hard to understate the kindness courtesy and helpfulness of every Colombian Ive met in Medellin Guatape and Santa Marta That impression was tarnished when my husband and I presented our passports to the woman at the baggage drop desk She told us that contrary to the information Id received from the platform on which Id purchased our tickets we were not checked in for our flight However the real problem was not that wed arrived too late for our flight The Viva representative informed us that she would not be able to allow us on the flight because we had arrived minutes after the cut off time for check in For check in Please note that this is a small airport where ordinarily only minutes are necessary to get from the entrance through security to the gate But no matter how we pleaded our case neither the woman behind the counter nor her bureaucratic martinet of a supervisor would budge It was not merely that we Guess what Theres a first time for everything They were about to charge me for my yoga mat bag as well when out of shock I dropped my water bottle and it broke spilling all over the floor I didnt plan it as a distraction I really liked that water bottle but it did save us another ridiculous fee

My recent visit to Tivat Airport left me utterly disappointed and frustrated to say the least From the moment I arrived until the moment I finally boarded my flight the experience was nothing short of a chaotic nightmare Understaffed and Overcrowded Upon entering the airport it became immediately apparent that the facility was severely understaffed There was only one person checking flight tickets leading to an outrageously long queue that snaked through the terminal To exacerbate matters there was also just one queue for both hand luggage and personal control causing massive congestion and delays No Relief from Crowds and Heat The airport quickly filled with travelers waiting in line and the atmosphere became stifling There was a complete lack of adequate air conditioning or ventilation making it unbearable to stand in the packed queues The lack of seating aggravated the situation leaving elderly passengers and families with young children particularly vulnerable and uncomfortable Unprofessional and Unhelpful Staff Adding insult to injury the airport staff were shockingly unprofessional and downright rude They displayed a complete lack of courtesy and seemed indifferent to the plight of passengers struggling with the chaotic conditions Requests for assistance were met with dismissive gestures or simply ignored further deepening the sense of frustration among travelers Overall Impression In summary my experience at Tivat Airport was one of the worst I have encountered in my travels The combination of understaffing overcrowding lack of basic amenities and unprofessional staff created an environment that was not only unpleasant but also distressing For an international airport these conditions are simply unacceptable and reflect poorly on the management and operational standards If you have the option to avoid Tivat Airport or choose an alternative route I strongly recommend doing so

We entered terminal where we dropped a friend off to their flight Terminal was lovely Air conditioned and seemed like there were no queues Then we walked towards where terminal was this was where our flight was leaving from There were queues outside the airport for what we thought was the baggage drop off was We queued for over half an hour before realising this wasnt the queue for the easy jet flights The signage was atrocious there was nothing to say that this was the baggage checkin for Ryan air We then went into the building knowing we had wasted over half an hour On entry to the building we were greeted by yet more queues We queued for about half an hour just to get the bags weighed only to be given our bags back to then queue again with our bags This next queue was like the herding of cattle into a milking parlour It was horrific People were so squashed together now trying to funnel through a small space like sand in an old fashioned sand timer We then queued for another hour to place our bags about m from where they were weighed By this time we had only minutes to get to our flight and we hadnt even gone through security yet Thankfully the rest of the process went more smoothly if it hadnt we wouldnt have made the flight The whole experience was stressful and a horrible end to our lovely holiday Shambolic The staff were overwhelmed and couldnt help The system was archaic and reminded me of family holidays over years ago Appalling

Arrived at Edinburgh airport to fly with Ryanair for a am flight to Alicante Chaos from start to finish We checked in at one location then had to drop bags at a different location which took minutes The queue to reach security was all the way outside and took minutes to get up the escalator When up stairs there were hundreds of people with no queue system in place where absolute chaos ensued There was a lack of staff and systems in place to ensure a smooth transition and to make sure everyone caught their flight I have never in over years of travel witnessed anything so unorganised and absolute mayhem We over heard a member of staff saying it takes minutes to get through security eventually after minutes we asked a member of staff after showing our boarding passes were we hoping to miss our final call she let us skip a bit of the queue but we still had to queue and by the time we got through the security queue the flight had closed for boarding The swissport staff stated the bus had departed to take passengers to the flight and we could not board despite the flight still waiting for take off The member of staff was not helpful and directed us to Ryanair check in which we did to be told to go to the Swissport desk who then told us to go back to Ryanair check in desk We insisted on speaking to their manager who was helpful and we then had to go back to Ryanair check in who arranged a flight the next day for pounds each My partner and I had to book an airport hotel that night this terrible experience cost over more and we lost days from our holiday My advice is avoid Edinburgh airport if possible there are too many early morning flights which they are unable to accommodate due to staffing and chaotic systems in place Shocking service and staff ranged from very helpful to incompetent and those who simply did not care and were uninterested

This case seems warranted as a warning to anyone with a disability and related service dog After calling Porter to report traveling with a service animal a month in advance submitting appropriate documentation and being approved to travel with said dog I arrived at the Toronto airport to check in and was told no service dog was on record I provided my printed documentation which was scoured for the next minutes Finally the check in assistant approved my paperwork and added a service dog to my reservation They checked my bags printed my boarding passes and we proceeded to the gate to wait for boarding to begin When the gate attendant scanned my ticket I was moved to the side so Porter could finish boarding Porter employees then proceeded to close the gate and inform me I was barred from boarding the flight because my service dog was not documented Considering we fly together on flights a year I thought there must be some mistake Much to my dismay Porter both gate attendant and disability help line told me they couldnt point me in the direction of assistance refund me or help me in any way shape or form beyond their toll free customer service number hr estimated hold time They said they didnt have my documentation in their call center so I was not allowed to fly I was instructed to go back out of TSA security pick up my checked bags on a carrousel and wait hours after resubmitting my service dogs paperwork to try and rebook Sweat tears and hours later AirCanada got me a flight on the spot accepted the same paperwork and did not discriminate against me for having a disability which requires me to travel with an animal trained to attend to my medical needs

There is not a lot of options besides Tropic air or Maya Island Air for local travel in Belize Ive flown both and I would say that Tropic Air was a disappointment I booked a flight with family from Belize City to Dangriga and was dropped off at Placencia Tropic Air said that they could not land in Dangriga due to issues with the airport at that time Tropic Air could not schedule another flight that day due to no other scheduled flights leaving that day but it was only pm so does the airport only run for half a day Also Tropic Air did not offer another flight the following day so my family was basically stranded in Palencia My familys minute flight from Belize City to Dangriga turned into hour ordeal to get to Dangriga minute flight to Placencia hour at the Placencia airport trying to figure out how to get to Dangriga hour bus ride to Dangriga We did ask for a refund for that portion of the flight because we paid for a flight to Dangriga but Tropic Air refused as we did fly in their plane regardless of where we intended to go In the end we spent more than hour more on transportation cancelled paid reservations from being late paid for additional bus fare and were refused a refund from Tropic Air Tropic Air is not a reputable business as they will take your money without fulfilling their obligation to transport you to your destination They can literally drop you off anywhere and still take your money because they only care that you got on the plane

My fiancee and I flew in from Cape Town and had a hour layover at this airport prior to taking our next flight to our first bush camp in Kanana So we strolled outside to do some souvenir shopping and get some refreshments at the cafe just outside the airport On the way there I stopped at the smokers hut and had a cigarette Obviously I pulled my mask down in order to smoke When I finished I threw my cigarette butt away in the provided trash can and adjusted a few items in my backpack about seconds had passed bw my throwing away my cigarette butt and thats when Maun airport police officer approached me He rudely asked Why are you not wearing your mask I replied I just finished a cigarette He even more rudely said to me And that is your defense I replied Well it is my reason I pulled the mask up he scowled at me I expect this sort of behavior when I go to the post office or to renew my drivers license but I would imagine the city of Maun the airport and definitely the many bush camps in the region largely benefit from tourism that comes to the area and those tourists do have a choice One disgruntled mans actions will harm an entire region and people and that would be a shame

This airline must be avoided at all costs I made a mistake in the name and within minutes of noticing the mistake I phoned HK Express They told me I had to pay pesos for the change despite the speed at which I noticed the mistake Next the website did not accept my credit card if this was not bad enough they then wanted me to read my details over the phone The airline drama did not end here when checking in the hand luggage could not have wheels This is a low cost airline with low cost morals even on appealing the cost I was charged

We were flying to Larnaca from Prague and had a connecting flight through Dusseldorf We arrived on time everything was OK as we didnt expect anything negative First surprise was that in order to pass the passport control you needed to take the stairs and no elevator available nearby so we had to carry our bags The passport control was OK and then we had to take bother stairs down but we kind of got used already to the comfort provided by the airport Finally we found our gate and decided to get some snack The only tiny little counter with brezels and only sparkling water was not working The coffee machine was out of order too There was a notice that the next snack stand was nearby by it was not true in this area around gates A and it was the only one There was also a machine that was supposed to be selling drinks but it was out of order as well I would not be surprised if the lavatory would be unavailable as well So we spent nice hours waiting for our connecting flight and I will make sure not to get tickets through this airport anymore Weve never experienced anything like this before I would be glad to read some positive review about this airport one day But I doubt it could happen

On August my flight from Catania to Rome was scheduled for am but delayed initially till am then two more times until and again until am Ground Staff provided no explanation and were totally unhelpful Boarding the plane was a frustrating experience with only two buses provided to take the passengers out to the plane requiring four trips to move the passengers to the tarmac causing further delay when the flight finally opened Once on board it took an inordinate amount of time to seat passengers due to the airlines unallocated seating policy as passengers were moved removed and moved again for o apparent reason We eventually took off at arriving in Rome too late to catch connecting flights to England All in all a very negative frustrating and unsatisfactory experience and one which will ensure I never fly Blu express ever again Whatever value for money offered by low cost fares is more than offset in inconvenience and not getting to your destination on time

The Airport is one of the easiest to get in and out of The only problem the airport has is in planning and building a convenient location for taxi transportation This problem did prevail when the airport was built There was no taxi designated location The one the taxis are situated now was an improvised one out of necessity Once again with the addition of terminal C which is far away from the present taxi stand is too far for seniors and others Something has to be done to improve this
Really bad experience One hour late minutes in a bus waiting to enter in the plane never again Avoid this Company the customer Is not important for them

Manchester to Erbil We checked in with our luggage and showed that two of the female passengers also held a small handbags with them we showed this at the check in with no problem When at the gate to board in one of the female passengers went on board with another family to help them since the family was of one mother and children When my self and my wife went to the gate to board they stopped us telling us we had to pay extra for the handbag that was our daughters handbag we were holding for her They told us we either had to pay cash or they would throw out things away or they would not let us board the plane They would not accept my card payment at all even though thats what I wanted to pay with They also refused to give us any receipt Never travel Iraqi Airways again

Clean and modern Queues at immigration especially when you find no one helping however the immigration officer was polite and friendly Airport is isolated outside Alexandria The only way to go to Alexandria is Taxi who normally abuse that they are the only way to leave the airport and charge too much

Flight cancelled when we are at the airport Charged for a coach bus ride from San Sebastin to Barcelona No compensation whatsoever for the loss I would never fly with these guys again and I would actively discourage anybody I know from doing so as well

Moscow to St Petersburg Flight was OK food was better than MANY airlines for flights that short check in for the flight was awfully organized Several registration points were shared between a number of UTAir flights but obviously werent enough as there were crowds of passengers The personnel were slow I spent about minutes in line The business class point was empty but the lady who worked there refused to register anyone else even late passengers and just kept reading something It was not before people had started calling for the representative realizing they were being late for boarding that the situation improved more or less I arrived hours before the flight and finally managed to register only minutes before the registration was closed

One of the worst airlines I traveled and I do travel a lot First of all ATITUDE of ITA flight attendants are absolutelly horrible You have a feeling that they doing you a huge favor averytime you see them Never ever I met such posh acting flight attendants Second beds in busimess class are very uncomfortable will not go nicely flat its more of bumpy type Third customer service over charging you for a business class and not having your seat available is very common thing at ITA Airways And last but not least food quality is lower than an avarage which was a big dissapointment since I have not expected it from Italians I hope I will never ever fly ITA Airways again

I was disgusted by the way I was treated as someone who needed help to access the plane As a full time wheelchair user I was belittled and made to feel a nuisance by staff who didnt know what equipment to use and the safest way of using it I was eventually after a lot of arguments forced to try and walk to my seat as there was no suitable transfer chair available that would fit into the aircraft At one point the staff actually tried to manhandle me despite me telling them that to do so would cause me immense amounts of pain and damage All of this was despite having booked full assistance and carriage of my electric wheelchair in advance

We arrived into the nonSchengen area of G and left the plane at am which was a late arrival We had to catch the flight to Oslo from BD D at pm Based on our experience it is normally possible to make such connection in other big airports eg Heathrow Frankfurt Schiphol if you follow signs walk fast and make an effort to skip lines at the passport control security using short connection as an excuse The BD transfer signs in G quickly brought us to the security check and then onto a shuttle bus which took us on a minute journey with the following itinerary GACTerminal and finally BD When we left the shuttle bus we still had hopes but our optimism started to fade when signs guided us to the second security check after the border control In the end we had made it to the gate by pm it had closed minutes prior to that and missed the flight It would have taken us up to rather than minutes with normal walking pace and no cheating in the lines Now the most important thing AF are all connected by pedestrian corridors which would allow you to both skip the ridiculous shuttle bus journey and reduce the number of security checks to one If you walk fast you will then make the connection Having said that you will never figure it out unless you are very familiar with CDG Dont repeat out error Dont trust the signs

I arrived at the airport and my flight was delayed My Delta app notified me I could switch flights for free so I did switch so that I could catch my second flight from Seattle to Redmond My first flight was Boston to Seattle This second flight was delayed and my app notified me I could switch flights for free and so I switched to my original flight from Boston to Seattle with a later flight from Seattle to Redmond When my flight was finally ready for boarding hours after expected time I tried to scan my physical boarding pass and was told I could not board the flight I figured this was just because I switched flights in the app so I showed them my boarding pass in the app They said I did not have an eticket despite my app showing my itinerary and that I would not be allowed to board I asked to speak to a manager and she told me since I didnt have an eticket I would not be on the flight nor could I transfer to another flight or receive a refund I showed them my original boarding pass my flight receipt my app boarding pass my app itinerary and my baggage status showing my bags were on that flight in the app They let me watch my flight take off without me I was able to book a flight with United later in the day and that flight went smoothly I still have yet to see if my checked baggage makes it to Redmond the Delta app says its on the plane but who knows They didnt let me on my flight that I paid for and they might lose my baggage

Arrival is a bit strange taxi wise because if you are single they want to find more people Thought I was going to have to wait Departure American Airlines should add another kiosk as the kiosk was very slow No TSA precheck but they will give you an expedite notice I have artificial legs so always a trial for me However must point out the security was definitely above average Comfortable waiting area and restaurant I did not eat there This is a walk on tarmac airport

Shanghai to Guilin The company cancelled their st October flight without reason on September th evening few hours before departure Only option proposed was to take a flight on October rd instead days of holidays ruined We finally decided to cancel the whole trip as it did not make much sense and we were asked to pay for the cancellation fee of the return ticket Just unbelievable

Surprisingly the flight wasnt as bad as I expected There is some legroom but unfortunately there are still reclining seats If airlines are going to reduce legroom in economy class they should at least remove the ability to recline And then there is the luggage situation They advertise a normal hand baggage limit for passengers flying with luggage As opposed to those who fly with just a toothbrush First the airlines limited the amount of hand luggage you could take in the overhead bins then they started limiting the size of the bag you could put under the seat Now its kg Also the flight arrived at T which wasnt mentioned anywhere on the ticket or reservation Which was a pain getting into the city especially in a country where public WiFi is limited and there are no maps at all at bus stops The departure terminal in Berlin on the other hand was clearly marked everywhere Its not that hard to make this customerfriendly change

This airline is a scam Cancelled our flight with little notice then when you try to obtain a refund thy refuse to reply to emails or answer whatapp messages I have emailed them over a dozen times and left numerous messages and no response Have since found out that this happens all the time with this airline They cancel flight and then just ignore any attempts get a refund Its apparently a well known scam they are running Do not book with this airline

Jakarta Halim Airport is a secondary airport after Soekarno Hatta Airport with a lot of Citilink and Batik Air flights The terminals here were converted from the airports International terminal and the result for me is a bit pathetic No clear signs on what to do on transiting or where you should go instead you have to go to the arrivals area and reenter the departures area There are a lot of FBs and shops outside the terminal but the numbers decreased inside the terminal The cleanliness is good WiFi was adequate signs were adequate but the airport seating layout was pathetic There were gates and wheres Overall I do think that this is an adequate airport but it is not recommended for transiting Staffs were like most Indonesian airports friendly and fast

Terrible place On arrival waited mins around a baggage claim carousel that displayed the flight for it to change to the other one yes only claim belts in an arrivals hall So not a problem you may think wrong Literally hundreds of people One full British flight and one full Russian flight shoved in one room waiting for their luggage at the right belt then for it to be switched at the last minute is not a good combination On return flight check in speedy and good overweight baggage didnt stir an eyebrow to my advantage but then the fun commenced A queue stretching around the departure lounge and back again for security checks and the reason one person at the control desk There were at least flights due to leave according to the flight board Everyone queuing to get through but the queue just grew longer and longer as the names of flights were shouted out to try push past everyone in an attempt to make their flight we arrived in ample time thanks to our tour operator Utter unorganised chaos And all this in sweltering heat as very little in the way of airconditioning

First they delayed the flight but I see that this is the norm for Thai Lion Air I was charged k THB for the luggage at the counter youll think why dont you take online before going to airport because I checked on the website under manage your booking and the only options was to buy an insurance no seat selection or baggage allowance Please avoid if not necessary is really a very bad managed company

As an Indonesian expat looking to visit my hometown I needed quite a lot of baggage room to bring various gifts and knick knacks I was pleasantly surprised when I found that Garuda Indonesia had a promotion that seemed perfect for my needs I would pay for a mixed class flight from Amsterdam to Jakarta and from there to my hometown to Surabaya with a total allowance of kg flying with Etihad and Singapore airlines worked out to around the same pricewith additional baggage but I thought Id support the underdog airline To my dismay the ticket Id received only a kg allowance I hurriedly went back to the carrier to make sure Id bought the right tickets It turns out that I had Reaching out to Garuda Indonesia customer service was a nightmare I was initially told that the tickets where final and that there was nothing they could do about it I sent a screenshot of the promotion on their website and was eventually told after several hours of going back and forth and being tossed from one department to another that it was a confirmed IT system fault and that they could not do anything about it Resignedly I asked for a refund at which I was told that I would only receive of my ticket Excuse me this was clearly a garuda fault and false advertising They escalated it further and Id finally received an offer of full refund a day or so before the flight date With no possibility to delay my flight date and fearing tickets with other airlines were expensive I felt I had no choice but to take the flight I tried getting a reimbursement for the extra luggage I had to take but Garuda would only point at KLM the operating carrier of the first leg for a reimbursement of the luggage despite it being Garuda ticketing fault without being offered a solution or recourse The most frustrating thing of the experience was that ever email reply I sent was dealt by a different customer service representative who replied with boilerplate and excuses whereby I had to explain the whole situation again to get anything going Frankly the whole customer service runaround felt intentional Despite all this I felt that the cabin staff and service on both legs of the flight were pleasant In the future I definitely wont be flying with them again

I love arriving at Canberra airport light and bright The luggage belt is designed so its easy to lift off your bag Departure was a bit of a mess You have this spacious airport but the two security lines are too close together which is compounded by the extra line up for body scanning You have to shove your way through that line up to put your things on the belt then join a line up of others to go through the body scanner Meanwhile your most valuable possessions are just sitting out there vulnerable to theft

Larnaca to Gatwick In flight was OK what youd expect from a budget airline In flight entertainment via their website to your device was an unexpected bonus and worked well for me but I was the exception as a lot of passengers complained they were unable to connect However this airline has woeful customer service and the online check in procedure simply doesnt work For customer service you have to wait for a call back that never comes tried to have a name changed on the ticket but they refuse to do this unlike other airlines were it wasnt an issue just went on line and altered it You cant add baggage via website either you have to do this by phone Come on Cobalt take a look at the competition and make improvements I wouldnt use this airline again their procedures are too clunky and not customer friendly and they simply ripped us off as we had to purchase another ticket rather than let us change the name

A small provincial airport serving Bangkok DMG Two airlines serve the airport NOK Air and Air Asia Avoid using Air Asia if I were you A couple of food outlets selling snacks and water Well set up and very efficient I have used the airport on many occasions I get collected when I use the airport so not sure what the Taxi connections are like

The design of this airport makes almost no sense I only came on and off domestic flights in Chile well beside my entry flightbut I am talking about legs domestically Its the arrival that is the problem For example for domestic flights in the US you come out of your gate and even if you have checked baggage you can proceed directly to your next gate or go to baggage claim Yes depending on where the gate is or in the rare situation that you have to proceed to another terminal it could take a while but I have never walked more than mins ever in any US airport You come off of your domestic flight and whether you are connecting or not everyone is funneled out into a separate hall and during my domestic arrivals the walk to baggage was at least mins and I am a spry yo guyjust glad I only had my computer bag and not a carry on roller I cant imagine the difficulty the elderly or handicapped have to go through to get to their connecting gate or even just to baggage claim And on one of my arrivals I still had to wait another mins to see any bags from our flight coming out on the carousel

Rome to Paris No entertainment on board no food Not even a snack for a hours flight Only water or coffee The cabin was cold and they do not give you blanket The crew was young and seemed not serious in their post Overall not satisfied

The prices for food and drinks are eye watering The duty free prices are higher than our high street shop prices They have the worst WIFI of any airport I have ever been to You cant get on it for love nor money Shame really Its a lovely airport

This is a very small airport serving the island of Pulau Redang in Malaysia It resembles an airstrip more than an airport and serves only one airline Berjaya Air There is also only building with separate arrival and departure halls and small commercial shops selling souvenirs There is no airconditioning The baggage crew will collect the baggages from the plane and trolley them to the arrival hall where you would have to claim them There are no baggage belts Coaches would be waiting right outside the doorsteps once you clear immigration to transport you to your prebooked resorts Journey is about minutes from the airport to Berjaya Redang Resort where most people travelling via Berjaya Air would end up

Small functional airport No frills Arrived at about am from London Not many passengers on the flight Everything went smoothly and we were through immigration baggage and customs in no time Once landside I realised my cell phone had fallen out of my pocket probably on the plane A member of the BMI ground staff called the plane who found the phone and brought it to me If arriving at Bishkek always make sure you are being collected at the airport by someone you trust and dont rely on taxis at the airport Check in on the return trip at about am was trouble free if a little slow on account of no online check in for my Turkish Airlines flight and painfully sluggish check in and security check staff Travelled Business Class Dont expect much from the BC lounge Tired sandwiches and cake very limited choice of beverages and staff who were more interested in keeping up their conversation with each other to be bothered with the customers Overall the airport did its job Dont expect much and you wont be disappointed

vouchers for taxis that I declined as my son was prepared to drive an hour to pick me up at in the morning would have cost far more than the voucher they were offering I was out of pocket for my prepurchased train tickets booked for Sunday th and I lost two days of work Whilst waiting for information on when my newly arranged flight would be leaving they could not even be bothered to contact me After an abortive trip to the airport after we found online my boarding pass which had been changed telling me my flight was now at Monday morning and a call to Qatar Airlines who told me they did not know arrived at airport to find out that there was no flight Their response was oh your contact details is a UK mobile number As if that made any difference in these circumstances Eventually after Amsterdam to Stuttgart Good flight and a friendly staff Airplane departed and arrived on time I booked a Smart ticket I was able to select a seat without additional charge and they offered a snack and drink on board The only negative part of the flight was the snack It contains a very small sandwich a small bottle of water and something sweet The taste of the snack was bad even for airplane food

Terrible staff We were people waiting for baggage after a flight from Dakar We had been waiting for two hours trying to ask them where is our luggage They were smoking looking annoyed for being disrupted Luggage arrived two hours and half later Would never choose this airport for my flights again Try to avoid it

Tehran to Amsterdam via Istanbul with Atlasglobal Their service was nothing above mediocre There is no inflight entertainment at all Seats are not comfortable especially in their A fleet They offer good prices but my last flight which was in December got cancelled and a refund was just offered after two months

My recent experience at this airport was frustrating and highlighted a severe lack of planning and maintenance particularly in the international arrivals section Despite having numerous immigration counters less than were staffed This resulted in long unnecessary queues with travelers left waiting while the majority of counters remained empty The air conditioning system was either ineffective or nonexistent Passengers already fatigued from travel were left sweating in the stifling heat while standing in linea basic comfort that any international airport should provide Bottleneck at Hand Baggage Screening After clearing immigration the ordeal continued With only one hand baggage screening machine operational travelers faced an additional minute delay This level of inefficiency is inexcusable Customs officers use white chalk to mark bags for random checks which is not only outdated but also damages the appearance and material of luggage This approach is disrespectful to passengers who expect their belongings to be handled with care Many trolleys were in poor condition with misaligned wheels requiring significant effort to push This made an already unpleasant experience even worse for those managing heavy luggage Passengers must walk a considerable distance from the arrivals terminal to reach the taxi stand While there are assistants available to help with baggage many of them demand tips despite claiming the service is freea practice that reflects poorly on the airports management To top it all off the airport offers limited direct connections especially to Europe making it an unattractive hub for international travelers Overall the airport fails to meet even the basic standards expected of an international gateway The inefficiencies poor facilities and lack of passenger care make this one of the worst arrival experiences I have had Serious improvements are needed to elevate it to acceptable global standards

In full global pandemic Ajaccio airport boarding zone was over crowded with passengers on the top of each other waiting for their flight to board but several were delayed as ours by at least an hour Did anyone attempt to manage the crowd and stop the check ins so the number of persons piling up in a small hall breathing over each other despite wearing the mask was made No Even the police could see how unsafe the situation was but did not intervene The hall was hot making breezing with masks difficult very little chairs available and a couple of duty free shop with the most rude staff with zero sympathy Ajaccio airport is a very small airport that can not cope with high number of tourists during summer Very disappointing I truly hope everyone was safe and no one was infected by COVID while waiting in such overfilled facilities

The check in process was horrible The business class counter was busy serving economy class I was asked by the staff to check in at the premium economy counter I had booked a flexible business class ticket and my luggage allowance was kg The checkin employee working at premium economy did not understood the luggage allowance for business class and asked me to pay extra for being over kg luggage I showed him my tickets and the kg luggage allowance was clearly mentioned but he still did not understood He pressurised me to pay extra for the luggage I refused to be checked in and spoke to the staff and went back to the really long queue waiting at business class counter During checkin at the business class counter I was informed that the premium economy checkin person has already added an overweight luggage alert to my ticket and I will have to pay extra even though I was well within the allowed luggage allowance More than hour was already wasted in this process and I was getting late for the flight The premium economy check inperson left his desk and approached me and asked me to pay in cash and no receipt was provided I asked to speak to a senior or a customer complaints team member but this premium economy person informed that if I wanted to lodge a complaint I could email the customer care I had to pay him cash to clear the overweight alert and to process my boarding pass Overall an absolutely absolutely disgusting experience with Air India business class

Fort Myers airport is so poorly equipped with bathrooms enough restaurants stores that are open and places to watch TV There is not one TV in the waiting areas If there is a delay there just are no seats available Breakfast food was not available at am They were out of both breakfast food and coffee by am The lines for pre packaged food were people long They need to visit an airport like Grand Rapids MI to get it right Grand Rapids is the same size town and so much more efficient and consumer friendly than this Fort Myers airport Fortunately the staff were friendly

Taipei TSA Tainan TNN in economy class on A I made the reservation for me and my children by phone the day before At the airport ground staff was efficient and polite but they all forgot their smile After giving the reservation code we received without any problems our boarding tickets and I paid with my credit card Our flight was delayed for minutes due to late arrival of the aircraft Although the flight was fully booked the boarding went smoothly Before entering the plane one had a choice between several Taiwanese newspapers Most of them were in Chinese but there were also a few copies of English written Taiwan news and Taipei times The one class cabin was clean and bright and the seats were very comfortable I was amazed by the amount of legroom It was much more than I have experienced on several international flights There was IFE useless for such a short flight minutes Commercials were shown all the way during the flight The FA made the announcements in Mandarin Taiwanese dialects and in English Both the FAs and the captain had good English skills There were female FA young and polite but like the ground staff they didnt bring their smile to work The inflight service was a disappointment Although it was a very short flight I was at least expecting a snack especially since it was a late afternoon departure All we got however was the choice between coffee and tea in a paper cup When I took a picture of the cabin a FA knocked that this was not allowed After announcing the approach into Tainan the crew didnt bother to check the seat belts or the position of the seats and table trays In Tainan we were bussed to the terminal where after a few minutes our luggage arrived Before leaving the terminal a ground staff of TransAsia checked whether the luggage identification tag matched so that no one could leave with the wrong suitcase

This airport has improved significantly over the last years It was badly damaged during the troubles The only facilities were a partly destroyed hanger Now the main terminal has been refurbished it is quite respectable Arrival is easy enough You will need to be firm with the baggage handlers They have been clamped down on recently but they will still try there best to relieve you of a few If you let them one will carry your bags to the door another for a few more feet etc Just say no and try not to look as if it is your first visit Once you have got your bags you have to visit the customs bench You will now need transport to Freetown which is the other side of a large estuary There are helicopters a ferry and a hovercraft Take the Paramount helicopter the other two take too long and are unreliable It is cheap on my recent visit You may have to change this into the local Leones before buying the ticket There is an exchange office which gives respectable rates The helicopter departure area is the old hanger that used to be the main terminal It is dirty and hot so try to get the first helicopter These are old but reliable Russian MIs You will arrive at the Mammy Yoko heliport Here you will most likely be met by your local agency or whoever you are visiting If not local taxis are available A trip to most parts of Freetown should cost no more than Le If you do not have accommodation booked go to the Cape Sierra Hotel or Bintumani Hotel which are very close On the way back the helicopters leave about hours before the time of departure You then wait outside the Lungi terminal for an hour or more before suffering the long and bureaucratic check in procedure This is typically African and can take an hour The main lounge is air conditioned There is also a very good duty free shop and a reasonable restaurant upstairs You will probably not be hassled by airport officials for bribes unlike other countries in the region

Id love to able to write something positive about this my local airport but alas this isnt the occasion Travelling with my son who is autistic but in no way challenging in his behaviour we came up against the most officious security officer in the passenger search area My son was wearing his highly visible autism puzzles wristband which proclaims they are working in partnership with Cardiff Airport All was progressing well until the officer demanded my son push a tray being used by another passenger forward into the search machine My son had already pushed his own tray forward and was confused by this brusque instruction and when I interceded the officers response was it wasnt his job to do this He then petulantly turned on me demanding I empty my pocket as this sharp eyed Sherlock had observed a handkerchief which he insisted must be xrayed This experience encapsulates the mountain CWL have to climb to rid themselves of the entitled and self important attitude which is now all pervasive since they were recipients of the ill judged handout from the Welsh government It is difficult to avoid the conclusion that CWLs desire to facilitate the travel of disabled passengers is nothing more than a shallow marketing exercise which clearly hasnt been communicated effectively to their staff

You might pay a little less but they will be very attentive about finding ways to charge you for everything They measure your bags and suitcases check that you dont have anything you havent paid for even baby carriers On my UIOLIMA flight everything went quite well but on the LIMASCL flight it was a different story Even if you ask for water theyll only give it to you if you pay for it But something very particular happened to me They didnt let me board the flight because they said in Lima that I needed to show my return ticket from Chile to Quito They say that theyre clear about this on their website because they tell you if youre traveling to Chile as a tourist remember that according to immigration requirements you need to have a return flight Make sure you meet this condition before your trip I had my return ticket but it wasnt clear that you have to present your ticket before boarding Since the internet at the Lima airport doesnt work well only WhatsApp it wouldnt let me download it and they didnt let me board They left me there saying theyd bring a letter so I could leave the airport but it never arrived I had to go to immigration and ask them to force JetSmart to send me the letter Then I waited until am for their doors to open they obviously opened later around am and they didnt know how to solve the issue in any way except asking me to pay the fine for being rebooked on the next flight They said they didnt have agreements with other airlines and that the only way was to pay the fine Zero empathy Think twice before flying with JetSmart You might save a few cents but its not worth all the obstacles they put in your way to get you to pay a little more They even charge you for the boarding pass if you dont have it printed but they do warn you on the website A terrible user experience just a lowcost faade to charge you wherever they can

British Virgin Islands to Santo Domingo via San Juan with Seaborne Airlines This is by far the worse airline I have ever flown on Our captain after delaying our flight minutes on a minute flight decided that the luggage they demanded we all check in was too heavy for the flight Instead of asking anyone to rebook to a later flight they decided to leave everyones luggage in BVI without informing the passengers However we paid the for our bags to be checked After clearing customs in Puerto Rico everyone sat in the luggage carousel area waiting to clear our luggage for our connecting flights After an hour a member of Seaborne staff told us what happened and told us to go online to file out a claim as he had no forms He did provide us a business card with a telephone number and email address for the online claim process Off we headed to finish our vacation in the Dominican Republic with the clothes on our back an iPad and our passports and wallet how long could it take to get our bags back really I mean BVI is a stones throw from The Dominican Republic Well numbers given to contact baggage claim did not work One was out of service and the other went to a person who kept hanging up after saying he doesnt deal with bags hours of international calls on hold to customer service and other numbers I managed to get someone and after hours of begging and several emails with no response and our bags arrived That we paid to book our bags what are the odds we will be getting that back Never book on Seaborne buyer beware I guess

I booked Air New Zealand after reading positive reviews online but my experience was completely the opposite I would not recommend them especially for anyone traveling with family and an infant During the checkin process it took the agent almost an hour to issue our boarding passes due to a technical issue This left my wife standing with our monthold baby and me with five pieces of luggage stuck in the same spot What was most disappointing is that no Air New Zealand staff showed the courtesy to suggest that my wife sit somewhere more comfortable with our newborn After some time I had to request assistance myself and only then were they allowed to sit Meanwhile I stood waiting for an hour for tickets I had already purchased online Boarding the plane was no better There was no separate line or prioritization for families with infants or elderly passengers something Ive consistently seen handled much better by airlines like Air Canada Based on this experience I dont think Ill be flying with Air New Zealand again

Airline checkin at Heathrow was long winded due to current Chinese Govt regulations namely there is no transit available in Shenzhen passengers must clear immigration and customs For nonChinese this necessitates obtaining Chinese day visa on arrival free of charge As I was travelling to Cambodia the airline had to check that visa on arrival was available to me Staff were courteous throughout Despite Covid free certification required for entry into China the airlines are not required to check and nobody in Shenzhen customs or immigration checked for this either Still its a big risk not to have this There is an online Chinese customshealth declaration form that must be completed before arrival in Shenzhen To be blunt this is a total nightmare for people in transit as it asks questions like wherewith whom are you staying in Shenzhen Whats the address Whats the phone number Truly Baffling as you must fill these in Flight to Shenzhen was good Staff were friendly and helpful Food good Beverages were a little limited soft drinks wine and beer More could be obtained on request IFE In Flight Entertainment in English was a little limited just about enough for hour flight The terrible Chinese online health declaration had to be completed again for Shenzhen to Phnom Penh flight Nightmare Smaller Aircraft Snack boxes and beverage No IFE Staff again friendly Shenzhen Airlines websites are terrible No better than useless Customer service via email if youre lucky enough to find one also useless Overall flight very good value for money but its not Air New Zealand or Qatar Airways

The staff at this airport were rude unhelpful and uninformed Both security and passport control were extremely slow We arrived hours mins before departure would have been earlier but the signage to get back to car hire drop off was poorconfusing and still nearly missed our flight Security was a shambles badly laid out with bottlenecks that slowed the process down Passport control was obviously understaffed with just desks open There was a large queue downstairs to get to an escalator that took you upstairs to the passport control hall where there was another large queue Passengers were being held downstairs to prevent overcrowding upstairs Our gate had already been announced by the time we cleared security so we went straight to the back of this first queue We were still in this first queue when our flight status moved from boarding to closing When we asked the staff holding the queue in place what we should do we were met with shrugs and a what do you want us to do about itwe dont care attitude Worried about missing our flight we found a lift that bypassed the first queue and got up to the passport control hall where one of the desks was being used to fasttrack certain flights We made the flight and had to wait for other held up passengers so the flight was delayed The BA crew were great and apologetic even though the situation was beyond their control It sounded like parr for the course for Lyon Im surprised BA and other airlines put up with such a terrible airport that treats their customers appealingly

I truly believe that the woman at Passport Control saved my life on Thursday July After being the last to disembark from a British Airways flight from London I mustered up what little strength I had as I approached Passport Control The woman at the entrance to Passport Control took one look at me and said You are having a medical emergency Come with me to the wheelchair line She whisked me to the front of that line and waited for the EMT staff to wait on me I was taken to the Banner Medical Center via ambulance where we discovered I had an acute case of Pulmonary Embolism I was going to try to push through my final flight to Tucson and get tomy home city Had she not recognized the acute state of emergency I was in and taken me to get care I may well have died I will never forget her

Rude treatment of elderly passengers This is not our first time visiting Tbilisi It was always great This year I decided to meet my elderly parents in this city We were flying from America they were from Belarus We had a great time and were inspired by the beauty of Georgia its hospitable people unique culture and great food But all of this was crossed out at the airport Both of my parents are over years old and it shows At the security screening they were never offered help or possibility to skip the line Moreover they were rudely searched and groped and my father was taken to a separate office where he was forced to take off the hernia belt which he never takes off and cannot put back on on his own We got to the airport more than two hours before the flight time However because my parents cannot walk quickly all of this screening took a lot of time They were at the security line past the boarding time Even after their names were announced on the PA system several times they were not allowed to go through passport control without standing in line As the result they were forced to run as fast as they could to get on the plane My parents are very kind people they never complain about anyone and try to stay positive But I see that for a couple of days now they have not been able to recover from this stress I am shocked by this attitude of the airport security and border control staff I am very sorry that airport services demonstrate such treatment towards guests of their country
